    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS pr
      ON pr.productnumber = i.new_productcode AND pr.new_system_energy > 0
    WHERE
      i."new_qty" > 0
      AND s."statecode" = 0
      AND CAST(s."new_shipping2_date" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  ), actual_result AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 AND BOOL_AND(NOT needs_snapshot) AND BOOL_AND(fact_copies = 1)
        THEN SUM(metric_value) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL)
      END AS "YWLN_M0006"
    FROM actual_lines
    WHERE
      (
        (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM selected_period
        ) IS NULL
        OR fact_date >= (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM selected_period
        )
      )
      AND (
        (
          SELECT
            end_at
          FROM selected_period
        ) IS NULL
        OR fact_date < (
          SELECT
            end_at
          FROM selected_period
        )
      )
  ), target_months AS (
    SELECT
      t.new_targetid,
      MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS target_month,
      v.power
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_rank.*
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __x360_base.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY COALESCE(
              NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
              CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
            ), __x360_base.new_year
            ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS version_rn
        FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
      ) AS __x360_rank
      WHERE
        __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
    ) AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1_power),
        (2, t.new_month2_power),
        (3, t.new_month3_power),
        (4, t.new_month4_power),
        (5, t.new_month5_power),
        (6, t.new_month6_power),
        (7, t.new_month7_power),
        (8, t.new_month8_power),
        (9, t.new_month9_power),
        (10, t.new_month10_power),
        (11, t.new_month11_power),
        (12, t.new_month12_power)
    ) AS v(month_no, power)
    WHERE
      t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL AND TRUE AND t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
  ), target_result AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(power) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0007"
    FROM target_months
    WHERE
      (
        (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM selected_period
        ) IS NULL
        OR target_month >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM selected_period
        )))
      )
      AND (
        (
          SELECT
            end_at
          FROM selected_period
        ) IS NULL
        OR target_month < CASE
          WHEN (
            SELECT
              end_at
            FROM selected_period
          ) IS NOT NULL
          THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', (
            SELECT
              start_at
            FROM selected_period
          )) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
        END
      )
  )
  SELECT
    a."YWLN_M0006",
    t."YWLN_M0007"
  FROM actual_result AS a
  CROSS JOIN target_result AS t

WITH __x360_card_pending_filter(v) AS (

 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D017*/ UNION ALL

), __x360_card_pie_filter(v) AS (
 SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D051*/ UNION ALL
 SELECT CASE v WHEN 'overdue_pending' THEN '超期订未发' WHEN 'normal_pending' THEN '正常订未发' ELSE v END
 FROM unnest(ARRAY[:shipment_pie_states]::text[]) x(v) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D051*/

 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
),
__bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM __requested),
__flt_YWLN_D002(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:product_lines] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/),
__flt_YWLN_D003(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:product_types] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/),
__flt_YWLN_D004(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE

__flt_YWLN_D005(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE

/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_ids] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/),
__flt_YWLN_D045(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D045*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:anomaly_flags] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D045*/),
__order_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,so.ordernumber::text AS order_no,
 so.customerid::text AS customerid,NULLIF(btrim(so.new_customeridname::text),'') AS customer_name,so.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,
 so.ownerid::text AS ownerid,so.new_amount::numeric AS order_amount,so.createdon::timestamp AS createdon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so CROSS JOIN __bounds b
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.statecode=0 AND so.createdon::timestamp<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
 AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR (so.createdon::timestamp>=b.start_at AND so.createdon::timestamp<b.end_at))
),
__orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,MIN(order_no) AS order_no,MIN(customerid) AS customerid,MIN(customer_name) AS customer_name,
 MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunityid,MIN(ownerid) AS ownerid,MIN(order_amount) AS order_amount,
 COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue FROM __order_raw GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__line_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderdetailid::text AS salesorderdetailid,l.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,
 l.new_product_id::text AS new_product_id,l.lineitemnumber,l.new_opportunity_id::text AS new_opportunity_id,
 l.quantity::numeric AS quantity,l.new_productnumber::text AS product_code,l.uomid::text AS uom_id,l.requestdeliveryby::timestamp AS requestdeliveryby,
 l.modifiedon::timestamp AS modifiedon,l.new_effectivedate::timestamp AS new_effectivedate FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=l.salesorderid::text)
),
__line_ranked AS (
 SELECT l.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY salesorderdetailid ORDER BY modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __line_raw l WHERE l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL AND l.modifiedon<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__line_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderdetailid,MIN(salesorderid) AS salesorderid,MIN(new_product_id) AS new_product_id,
 MIN(lineitemnumber) AS lineitemnumber,MIN(new_opportunity_id) AS new_opportunity_id,
 MIN(quantity) AS quantity,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,MIN(requestdeliveryby) AS requestdeliveryby,
 MIN(new_effectivedate) AS new_effectivedate,COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue
 FROM __line_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY salesorderdetailid
),
__active_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.* FROM __line_latest l WHERE (l.new_effectivedate IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
 
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=l.salesorderid)
),
__order_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
 BOOL_OR(source_issue OR quantity IS NULL OR quantity<0) OR SUM(quantity)<=0 AS quantity_issue,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),''))=1 THEN MIN(NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),'')) END AS unique_opportunityid
 FROM __active_lines GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__shipment_header_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.new_ord_shipmentid,s.new_shipping2_date,s.statecode,s.modifiedon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
),
__shipment_item_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid,i.new_ord_shipment_id,i.new_ord_salesorder_id,i.new_seq,
 i.new_product_id,i.new_productcode,i.new_uom_id,i.new_qty,i.statecode,i.modifiedon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=i.new_ord_salesorder_id::text)
),
__actual_header_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentid::text AS shipment_id,new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS shipped_at,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_header_source
),
__actual_header_ranked AS (
 SELECT s.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY shipment_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_header_distinct s WHERE shipment_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT shipment_id,MIN(shipped_at) AS shipped_at,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_header_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY shipment_id
),
__actual_item_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS item_id,new_ord_shipment_id::text AS shipment_id,
 new_ord_salesorder_id::text AS order_id,new_seq::text AS seq_raw,new_product_id::text AS product_id,
 new_productcode::text AS product_code,new_uom_id::text AS uom_id,new_qty::numeric AS shipped_qty,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_item_source
),
__actual_item_ranked AS (
 SELECT i.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_item_distinct i WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_items AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT item_id,MIN(shipment_id) AS shipment_id,MIN(order_id) AS order_id,MIN(seq_raw) AS seq_raw,
 MIN(product_id) AS product_id,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,
 MIN(shipped_qty) AS shipped_qty,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_item_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY item_id
),
__actual_joined AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,s.shipment_id AS matched_header_id,s.shipped_at,s.statecode AS header_state,
 s.version_issue AS header_version_issue,
 CASE WHEN btrim(i.seq_raw) ~ '^[0-9]+([.]0+)?$' THEN btrim(i.seq_raw)::numeric END AS normalized_seq
 FROM __actual_items i JOIN __orders o ON o.salesorderid=i.order_id
 LEFT JOIN __actual_headers s ON s.shipment_id=i.shipment_id
),
__actual_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND header_state=0 AND shipped_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.item_id,COUNT(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_matches,
 MIN(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_id,MIN(l.uom_id) AS line_uom_id
 FROM __actual_eligible i LEFT JOIN __line_latest l ON l.salesorderid=i.order_id
 AND l.lineitemnumber::numeric=i.normalized_seq
 AND (l.new_product_id=i.product_id OR NULLIF(btrim(i.product_code),'')=NULLIF(btrim(l.product_code),''))
 GROUP BY i.item_id
),
__actual_linked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,m.line_matches,m.line_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'')=NULLIF(btrim(m.line_uom_id),''),FALSE) AS same_uom
 FROM __actual_eligible i JOIN __actual_matches m ON m.item_id=i.item_id
),
__actual_problem_rows AS (
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 WHEN line_matches<>1 THEN '发货明细无法唯一关联订单行'
 WHEN NOT same_uom THEN '发货与订单计量单位不一致或缺失'
 WHEN shipped_qty IS NULL THEN '实际发货数量缺失' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_linked
 WHERE version_issue OR header_version_issue OR line_matches<>1 OR NOT same_uom OR shipped_qty IS NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN matched_header_id IS NULL THEN '发货明细找不到可用发货主表'
 WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 ELSE '有效发货单缺实际发货时间' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND
 (matched_header_id IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR (header_state=0 AND shipped_at IS NULL))
),
__actual_bad_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,string_agg(DISTINCT reason,'、' ORDER BY reason) AS reason
 FROM __actual_problem_rows GROUP BY order_id
),
__actual_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,SUM(shipped_qty) AS net_shipped_qty,
 BOOL_OR(shipped_qty IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR NOT same_uom) AS source_issue
 FROM __actual_linked WHERE line_matches=1 GROUP BY line_id
),
__line_balances AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.quantity AS ordered_qty,
 COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0) AS net_shipped_qty,b.reason AS actual_problem,
 l.source_issue OR COALESCE(s.source_issue,FALSE) OR b.order_id IS NOT NULL
 OR l.quantity IS NULL OR l.quantity<0 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)<0
 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)>l.quantity AS quantity_issue
 FROM __active_lines l LEFT JOIN __actual_by_line s ON s.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __actual_bad_orders b ON b.order_id=l.salesorderid
),
__pending_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty END AS pending_qty,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE net_shipped_qty END AS net_shipped_qty,
 quantity_issue,actual_problem,FALSE AS energy_product_issue,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue OR ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty>0 THEN 1::bigint END AS plan_rows
 FROM __line_balances
),
__opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
 WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_risklevel::text AS risk_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o
),
__accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS customer_name,
 MIN(a.new_accountlevel)::text AS customer_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'')
),
__team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.teamid::text AS team_id,t.name::text AS team_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t.teamid=tm.teamid
),
__owner_teams AS (
 SELECT owner_id,string_agg(DISTINCT team_name,'、' ORDER BY team_name) AS team_names FROM __team_members GROUP BY owner_id
),
__line_base AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.salesorderid AS order_id,l.new_product_id AS product_id,
 l.quantity AS ordered_qty,l.requestdeliveryby AS due_at,l.requestdeliveryby::date AS due_date,l.source_issue AS line_issue,
 so.order_no,so.customerid,so.order_amount,so.source_issue AS order_issue,ot.total_quantity,ot.quantity_issue AS order_quantity_issue,
 o.d002,o.d003,a.customer_level AS d005,COALESCE(o.owner_id,so.ownerid) AS owner_id,so.customer_name AS d006,CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.d005 IN ('0','1','2') OR o.risk_level IN ('1','2'),FALSE) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS anomaly_flag,p.pending_qty,p.net_shipped_qty,p.actual_problem,p.quantity_issue AS pending_quantity_issue,p.plan_rows,NULL::numeric AS unit_energy_kwh,FALSE AS product_issue
 FROM __active_lines l JOIN __orders so ON so.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 JOIN __order_totals ot ON ot.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __pending_by_line p ON p.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 
 LEFT JOIN __opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.new_opportunity_id),''),ot.unique_opportunityid,NULLIF(btrim(so.opportunityid),''))
 LEFT JOIN __accounts a ON a.customer_name=so.customer_name
),
__line_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,team.team_names AS d004,
 CASE WHEN due_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'overdue_pending' WHEN due_at>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'normal_pending' END AS status_code,
 CURRENT_DATE-due_date AS overdue_days,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND order_amount IS NOT NULL AND ordered_qty>=0 AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*ordered_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS allocated_order_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND pending_qty>0 AND ordered_qty>0 AND pending_qty<=ordered_qty AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*pending_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS pending_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND NOT product_issue
 AND pending_qty>0 AND (ordered_qty IS NULL OR pending_qty<=ordered_qty)
 THEN pending_qty*unit_energy_kwh END AS pending_energy_kwh
 FROM __line_base f LEFT JOIN __owner_teams team ON team.owner_id=f.owner_id
),
__line_scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.* FROM __line_facts f WHERE TRUE
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D002) OR (f.d002 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D002)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D003) OR (f.d003 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D003)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __team_members tm WHERE tm.owner_id=f.owner_id AND (tm.team_name IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR tm.team_id IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004)))))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR (f.d005 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR CASE f.d005 WHEN '0' THEN '核心大客户' WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' ELSE f.d005 END IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR (f.d006 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR f.customerid IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D045) OR (f.anomaly_flag IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D045)))

),
__pending_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.* FROM __line_scope f WHERE f.plan_rows IS NOT NULL
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pending_filter)
      OR f.status_code IS NULL OR f.status_code IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pending_filter))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pie_filter)
      OR CASE f.status_code WHEN 'overdue_pending' THEN '超期订未发' WHEN 'normal_pending' THEN '正常订未发' END
         IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pie_filter))
),
__totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code IS NULL) AS missing_due_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS overdue_amount_valid_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS normal_amount_valid_rows,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_amount,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_amount,
 SUM(pending_energy_kwh) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_energy
 FROM __pending_scope
),
__denominator AS (
 SELECT SUM(allocated_order_amount) FILTER(WHERE allocated_order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND (plan_rows IS NULL OR (pending_amount IS NOT NULL AND status_code IS NOT NULL))) AS order_amount
 FROM __line_scope
)
SELECT CASE WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 AND t.normal_rows=0 AND t.missing_due_rows>0 THEN NULL WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE t.overdue_amount/100000000::numeric END AS "M0143",
(CASE WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 AND t.normal_rows=0 AND t.missing_due_rows>0 THEN NULL WHEN t.overdue_rows=0 THEN 0::numeric ELSE t.overdue_amount/100000000::numeric END)/NULLIF(d.order_amount/100000000::numeric,0) AS "YWLN_M_OVERDUE_PENDING_AMOUNT_SHARE"
FROM __totals t CROSS JOIN __denominator d

WITH __x360_gov_source_11 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."salesorderid",__x360_raw."new_changetype",__x360_raw."new_changestatus",__x360_raw."new_salesordertype",__x360_raw."new_order_category",__x360_raw."new_ord_oa_state",__x360_raw."new_salesorderid",__x360_raw."ownerid",__x360_raw."name",__x360_raw."opportunityid",__x360_raw."customerid",__x360_raw."statecode",__x360_raw."createdon",__x360_raw."new_approval_time",__x360_raw."new_amount" AS "order_amount_rmb_ex_tax" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH time_input AS (
  SELECT NULL::timestamp AS current_start, NULL::timestamp AS current_end, 0 AS priority
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/ UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp), CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp), 1 /*TIME_END*/
), request_bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT current_start,current_end,
    COALESCE(current_start,DATE_TRUNC('year',NOW())::timestamp)-INTERVAL '1 year' AS reference_start,
    COALESCE(current_end,DATE_TRUNC('year',NOW())::timestamp+INTERVAL '1 year')-INTERVAL '1 year' AS reference_end
  FROM time_input ORDER BY priority DESC LIMIT 1
), reference_label AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN reference_start=DATE_TRUNC('year',reference_start)
      AND reference_end=reference_start+INTERVAL '1 year'
      THEN TO_CHAR(reference_start,'YYYY')||'年'
    WHEN reference_start=DATE_TRUNC('month',reference_start)
      AND reference_end=reference_start+INTERVAL '1 month'
      THEN TO_CHAR(reference_start,'YYYY年FMMM月')
    ELSE TO_CHAR(reference_start,'YYYY-MM-DD')||'至'||TO_CHAR(reference_end-INTERVAL '1 day','YYYY-MM-DD')
  END AS period_label,
  (reference_start=DATE_TRUNC('year',reference_start) AND reference_end=reference_start+INTERVAL '1 year') AS is_full_year
  FROM request_bounds
), order_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid AS fact_id,so.createdon::timestamp AS fact_date,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.ownerid AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_so.name::text),'') AS d006,

WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn

    ), opportunity_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (

            AND (

          )

    ), candidate_fact_ids AS MATERIALIZED (

    ), opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (

              THEN 'BG大客户'

          ) = ANY(
            r.customer_levels
          )
        )
        AND (
          r.customer_ids IS NULL OR CAST(f.d006 AS TEXT) = ANY(
            r.customer_ids
          )
        )
    ), selected_facts AS (
      SELECT

      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/

        WITH sign_order_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (

              ord_line.new_opportunity_id || ''
            ) AS opportunityid,
            (
              so.salesorderid || ''
            ) AS salesorderid,
            (
              so.new_salesorderid || ''
            ) AS new_salesorderid,

        ), sign_cancel_rows_once AS MATERIALIZED (

          SELECT
            so.*,
            c.opportunityid AS selected_opportunityid
          FROM sign_order_source_once AS so
          FULL JOIN (

            ON c.opportunityid = so.opportunityid
        ), candidate_orders AS MATERIALIZED (

        FROM signed_scope_bridge AS f

          ) IN (:sign_statuses)

)

, scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM metric_facts f WHERE 1=1
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ AND f.fact_date>=CAST(:start_date AS timestamp) AND f.fact_date<CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/

 WHERE tm."systemuserid"=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/

WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), requested AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM requested
), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(accountid AS TEXT),
    CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT),
    CAST(name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    t.team_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
  JOIN __teams AS t
    ON t.teamid = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM __owner_team_candidates
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
      t.new_year,
      CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
      t.new_month1_power,
      t.new_month2_power,
      t.new_month3_power,
      t.new_month4_power,
      t.new_month5_power,
      t.new_month6_power,
      t.new_month7_power,
      t.new_month8_power,
      t.new_month9_power,
      t.new_month10_power,
      t.new_month11_power,
      t.new_month12_power,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
        ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE
      b.start_at IS NULL OR t.new_year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT)
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    ranked.rn = 1
), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
      THEN '其他'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS d003
  FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
    t.target_id || ':' || CAST(v.month_no AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
    CASE
      WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
      THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
    END AS fact_date,
    CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
    FALSE AS invalid,
    t.d002,
    COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
    c.customer_level AS d005,
    c.customer_name AS d006,
    (
      SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
          THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
        END
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
      WHERE
        CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
    ) AS d004
  FROM __target_latest AS t
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
  CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
  LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
    ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
  LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
    ON c.accountid = t.account_id
  WHERE
    t.target_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL
      OR (
        CASE
          WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
          THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
        END >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at)
        AND CASE
          WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
          THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
        END < CASE
          WHEN b.end_at IS NOT NULL
          THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
        END
      )
    )
), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __target_facts
), checked AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
  FROM facts AS f
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
  FROM checked AS f
  WHERE
    f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND f.d004 IN (:team_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND (
      f.d005 IN (:customer_levels)
      OR (
        CASE f.d005
          WHEN '0'
          THEN '核心大客户'
          WHEN '1'
          THEN '战略大客户'
          WHEN '2'
          THEN '重要大客户'
          WHEN '3'
          THEN '一般客户'
          WHEN '4'
          THEN 'BG大客户'
          ELSE f.d005
        END
      ) IN (:customer_levels)
    ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
), aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh
  FROM scoped AS f
)
SELECT
  a.target_gwh AS "YWLN_M0007"
FROM aggregated AS a

WITH __dashboard_combo_period AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
),
__dashboard_combo_ywln_d002 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[:product_lines]::text[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
),
__dashboard_combo_ywln_d003 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[:product_types]::text[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
),
__dashboard_combo_ywln_d004 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[:team_ids]::text[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
),
__dashboard_combo_ywln_d005 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_LEVEL_FILTER_V1*/ SELECT COALESCE(level_map.code,requested_level.v) FROM unnest(ARRAY[:customer_levels]::text[]) AS requested_level(v) LEFT JOIN (VALUES ('1','战略大客户'),('2','重要大客户'),('3','一般客户'),('4','BG大客户')) AS level_map(code,label) ON requested_level.v=level_map.code OR requested_level.v=level_map.label /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
),
__dashboard_combo_ywln_d006 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[:customer_ids]::text[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
),
account_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (a.accountid||'') AS accountid,(a.new_accountlevel||'') AS account_level,NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS customer_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a
), opportunity_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (o.opportunityid||'') AS opportunityid,(o.parentaccountid||'') AS parentaccountid,
        (o.new_salesbg||'') AS d002,
        CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
        (o.ownerid||'') AS owner_id,(o.new_accountlevel||'') AS d005,
        (o.new_opportunitystatus='0' AND o.new_approvalstatus='3') AS is_eligible
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o
), order_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (so.salesorderid||'') AS salesorderid,(so.opportunityid||'') AS opportunityid
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so
), product_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (p.productid||'') AS productid,p.new_electricquantity ,p."productnumber",p."new_system_energy" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" p
), selected_team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT (tm."systemuserid"||'') AS owner_id
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE t."name"::text IN (SELECT value FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d004 WHERE value IS NOT NULL)
), shipment_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (s.new_ord_shipmentid||'') AS shipment_id,(s.new_salesorderid||'') AS salesorderid,
 (s.new_account_id||'') AS accountid,(s.new_product_id||'') AS productid,(s.ownerid||'') AS shipment_owner_id,
 s.new_totalqty,s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS fact_date
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0
 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=NOW()
), shipment_period_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM shipment_source s WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM __dashboard_combo_period) IS NULL OR
 (s.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM __dashboard_combo_period) AND s.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM __dashboard_combo_period)))
), shipment_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.shipment_id,s.productid,s.new_totalqty,o.d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE o.d003 END AS d003,
 COALESCE(o.owner_id,s.shipment_owner_id) AS owner_id,a.account_level AS d005,a.customer_name AS d006
 FROM shipment_period_source s
 LEFT JOIN order_source so ON so.salesorderid=s.salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN opportunity_source o ON o.opportunityid=so.opportunityid
 LEFT JOIN account_source a ON a.accountid=s.accountid
), selected_shipments AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.shipment_id,f.productid,f.new_totalqty FROM shipment_dimensions f WHERE TRUE
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d002 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.d002 IN (SELECT value FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d002))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d003 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.d003 IN (SELECT value FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d003))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d004 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.owner_id IN (SELECT owner_id FROM selected_team_members))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.d005 IN (SELECT value FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.d006 IN (SELECT value FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006))
), shipment_item_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (i.new_ord_shipmentitemid||'') AS item_id,(i.new_ord_shipment_id||'') AS shipment_id,
 (i.new_product_id||'') AS productid,i.new_qty
 ,i."new_productcode" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i WHERE i.new_qty>0
), synthetic_collision_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.item_id FROM shipment_item_source i
 WHERE i.item_id LIKE 'MISSING_LINE:%'
 AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM shipment_source s
   WHERE s.shipment_id=substring(i.item_id FROM 14)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_item_source present_item WHERE present_item.shipment_id=s.shipment_id)
 )
), item_raw_measures AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT COALESCE(i.item_id,'MISSING_LINE:'||s.shipment_id) AS fact_id,
 i.new_qty*p.new_system_energy AS energy_kwh,
 (i.item_id IS NULL OR p.new_system_energy IS NULL OR p.new_system_energy<=0
   OR i.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM synthetic_collision_ids)) AS source_invalid,(p.new_system_energy>0) AS energy_covered
 FROM selected_shipments s
 LEFT JOIN shipment_item_source i ON i.shipment_id=s.shipment_id
 LEFT JOIN product_source p ON p.productnumber=i.new_productcode AND p.new_system_energy>0
), item_measures AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT fact_id,energy_kwh::numeric/1000000::numeric AS energy_value,(source_invalid OR energy_kwh IS NULL) AS invalid,energy_covered
 FROM item_raw_measures
), item_checked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT energy_value,(invalid OR COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id)>1) AS invalid,energy_covered FROM item_measures
), header_raw_measures AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.shipment_id AS fact_id,
 s.new_totalqty*p.new_electricquantity AS energy_kwh,
 (s.new_totalqty IS NULL OR s.new_totalqty<0 OR p.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR p.new_electricquantity<=0) AS source_invalid
 FROM selected_shipments s LEFT JOIN product_source p ON p.productid=s.productid
), header_measures AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT fact_id,energy_kwh::numeric/1000000::numeric AS energy_value,(source_invalid OR energy_kwh IS NULL) AS invalid
 FROM header_raw_measures
), item_total AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(invalid) FILTER(WHERE energy_covered),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(energy_value) FILTER(WHERE energy_covered) END AS energy_value,COALESCE(bool_and(energy_covered IS TRUE),FALSE) AS coverage_complete FROM item_checked GROUP BY ()
), header_total AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(invalid),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(energy_value) END AS energy_value FROM header_measures GROUP BY ()
), selected_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT o.opportunityid,o.d002,o.d003,o.owner_id,o.d005,a.customer_name AS d006
 FROM opportunity_source o LEFT JOIN account_source a ON a.accountid=o.parentaccountid
 WHERE o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND o.is_eligible
), scoped_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.opportunityid FROM selected_opportunities f WHERE TRUE
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d002 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.d002 IN (SELECT value FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d002))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d003 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.d003 IN (SELECT value FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d003))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d004 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.owner_id IN (SELECT owner_id FROM selected_team_members))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.d005 IN (SELECT value FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR f.d006 IN (SELECT value FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006))
), month_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT (m.new_oppmonthid||'') AS fact_id,(m.new_opportunity_id||'') AS opportunityid,(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000) AS energy_mwh
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb" m
 WHERE m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL
 AND m.statecode=0 AND m.new_approvalstatus::text IN ('1','2','3') AND (m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000) IS NOT NULL
 AND ((SELECT start_at FROM __dashboard_combo_period) IS NULL OR
 (m.new_accountdate::timestamp>=(SELECT start_at FROM __dashboard_combo_period) AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp<(SELECT end_at FROM __dashboard_combo_period)))
), monthly_joined AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.fact_id,m.energy_mwh,o.opportunityid AS matched_opportunityid
 FROM month_source m FULL JOIN scoped_opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=m.opportunityid
), denominator AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT SUM(m.energy_mwh ORDER BY m.fact_id)/1000::numeric AS energy_value
 FROM monthly_joined m WHERE m.fact_id IS NOT NULL AND m.matched_opportunityid IS NOT NULL
), combined AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.energy_value AS item_energy,CASE WHEN i.coverage_complete THEN h.energy_value-i.energy_value END AS header_minus_item,h.energy_value AS planned_energy
 FROM item_total i CROSS JOIN header_total h
)
SELECT c.item_energy AS "YWLN_M0144",c.header_minus_item AS "YWLN_M0145",
 c.planned_energy/NULLIF(d.energy_value,0) AS "YWLN_M_SHIPMENT_ENERGY_PCT",
 c.planned_energy AS "YWLN_M_SHIPMENT_FUNNEL_ENERGY"
FROM combined c CROSS JOIN denominator d
description: 发货看板：已发货电量、未发货电量、发货电量百分比、发货漏斗电量；复用单指标口径，支持通用统计期间和普通维度筛选。

WITH __x360_gov_source_1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."project_name",__x360_raw."input_time",__x360_raw."energy_mwh",__x360_raw."is_awarded",__x360_raw."winner_announce_time",__x360_raw."remark",__x360_raw."seq_no" AS "bid_record_id",__x360_raw."bid_amount" AS "bid_amount" FROM ded_public."p_fm_bid_project_info" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.energy_mwh)::numeric/1000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((FALSE),FALSE) OR (f.energy_mwh) IS NULL) AS invalid,(FALSE) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,to_jsonb(f)->>'helmet_status' AS helmet_status,CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_uncompleted','overdue_completed') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('imminent_uncompleted','normal_uncompleted','normal_completed') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_flag FROM (
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT b.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_name ORDER BY input_time::timestamp DESC,bid_record_id DESC) AS rn
 FROM __x360_gov_source_1 b WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name ~ '[^[:space:]]'
 AND bid_record_id IS NOT NULL AND input_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND input_time::timestamp<=NOW()
), linked AS (
 SELECT b.*,mx.matches,mx.opportunity_id FROM ranked b
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches,MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunity_id
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT opportunityid FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" p WHERE p.name=b.project_name AND p.opportunityid IS NOT NULL) z) mx ON TRUE
 WHERE b.rn=1
)
 SELECT DISTINCT b.bid_record_id::text AS fact_id,b.input_time::timestamp AS fact_date,b.input_time::timestamp,b.winner_announce_time::timestamp,
 b.energy_mwh,CASE WHEN (to_jsonb(b)->>'bid_amount') ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (to_jsonb(b)->>'bid_amount')::numeric END AS amount_yuan,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.new_accountlevel::text IN ('1','2') OR o.new_risklevel::text IN ('1','2'),FALSE) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS anomaly_flag,(SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a WHERE a.accountid::text=o.parentaccountid::text) AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN (TRUE) AND b.input_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.input_time::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL OR (b.winner_announce_time::timestamp>=b.input_time::timestamp AND b.winner_announce_time::timestamp<=NOW())) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-b.input_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-b.input_time::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-b.input_time::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.winner_announce_time::date-b.input_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.winner_announce_time::date-b.input_time::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM (SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v) p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D022') AS helmet_status,
 FALSE AS source_issue,b.matches AS opportunity_matches,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" sx WHERE sx.opportunityid=o.opportunityid AND sx.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND sx.new_salesordertype::text='1' AND sx.new_order_category::text IN ('1','3') AND (sx.statecode=0 AND NOT (sx.statecode=2 OR COALESCE((TRUE AND sx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND sx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" cx WHERE cx.new_salesorderid=sx.salesorderid AND cx.salesorderid<>sx.salesorderid
 AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()))) AND sx.new_ord_oa_state::text='5' AND sx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()) AS has_signed,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') LIKE '%弃标%') AS abandoned,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%' AND b.winner_announce_time::timestamp<=NOW() AND b.is_awarded IN ('是','1')) AS won,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%' AND b.winner_announce_time::timestamp<=NOW() AND b.is_awarded IN ('否','0')) AS lost,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%' AND (b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL OR b.winner_announce_time::timestamp>NOW())) AS in_progress
 FROM linked b LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=b.opportunity_id AND b.matches=1
) f WHERE f.energy_mwh>0
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D045*/ AND f.anomaly_flag IN (:anomaly_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D045*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D022*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D022*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_BID_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:bid_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_BID_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003", (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scoped x WHERE x.measure_tag='m0' AND x.poison_time AND x.d003 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.d003) OR COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0027" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.d003
) AS __x360_gov_result

WITH __order_number_rows AS (
WITH __x360_gov_source_11 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."salesorderid",__x360_raw."new_changetype",__x360_raw."new_changestatus",__x360_raw."new_salesordertype",__x360_raw."new_order_category",__x360_raw."new_ord_oa_state",__x360_raw."new_salesorderid",__x360_raw."ownerid",__x360_raw."name",__x360_raw."ordernumber",__x360_raw."opportunityid",__x360_raw."customerid",__x360_raw."statecode",__x360_raw."createdon",__x360_raw."new_customeridname",__x360_raw."new_prod_type",__x360_raw."new_dept_idname",__x360_raw."new_approval_time",__x360_raw."new_amount" AS "order_amount_rmb_ex_tax" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH __order_detail_period AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), __order_detail_cancelled AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT salesorderid,new_salesorderid,new_changetype,new_changestatus,new_approval_time
 FROM __x360_gov_source_11
 WHERE TRUE AND TRUE
   AND new_changestatus='8' AND new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()
), __order_detail_reduced_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT salesorderid,salesorderdetailid,quantity,new_changepostqty,new_effectivedate,new_expirydate
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb"
 WHERE salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0
   AND TRUE AND TRUE
   AND (new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR new_effectivedate::timestamp<=NOW())
   AND (new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR new_expirydate::timestamp>NOW())
),
__order_detail_ywln_d002 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[:product_lines]::text[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
),
__order_detail_ywln_d003 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[:product_types]::text[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
),
__order_detail_ywln_d004 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[:team_ids]::text[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
),
__order_detail_ywln_d005 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CASE v WHEN '核心大客户' THEN '0' WHEN '战略大客户' THEN '1' WHEN '战略客户' THEN '1' WHEN '重要大客户' THEN '2' WHEN '重要客户' THEN '2' WHEN '一般客户' THEN '3' WHEN 'BG大客户' THEN '4' WHEN 'BG客户' THEN '4' ELSE v END FROM unnest(ARRAY[:customer_levels]::text[]) t(v) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
),
__order_detail_ywln_d006 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[:customer_ids]::text[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
),
__order_detail_ywln_d016 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D016*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CASE status_input.status_value
        WHEN '正常订单' THEN 'normal_order'
        WHEN '订单变更' THEN 'order_change'
        WHEN '已变更订单' THEN 'order_change'
        WHEN '订单取消' THEN 'order_cancel'
        WHEN '已取消订单' THEN 'order_cancel'
        ELSE status_input.status_value
      END FROM unnest(ARRAY[:order_states]::text[]) AS status_input(status_value) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D016*/
),
__order_detail_ywln_d049 AS (
 SELECT NULL::text AS value
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D049*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[:order_numbers]::text[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D049*/
),
__order_customer_levels AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS customer_name,
        MIN(a.new_accountlevel)::text AS customer_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'')
), __shared_order_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid AS fact_id,NULLIF(btrim(so.ordernumber::text),'') AS d049,so.createdon::timestamp AS fact_date,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN btrim(so.new_prod_type::text) IN ('100000000','100000001','100000004','100000005','100000006','100000013') THEN '电芯'
      WHEN btrim(so.new_prod_type::text)='100000002' THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 NULLIF(btrim(so.new_dept_idname::text),'') AS order_team,cl.customer_level AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(so.new_customeridname::text),'') AS d006,
 CASE WHEN so.statecode=2 THEN 'order_cancel' WHEN so.statecode=0 AND so.new_changestatus='8' THEN 'order_change' WHEN so.statecode=0 THEN 'normal_order' END AS status_code, CASE WHEN ((to_jsonb(so."order_amount_rmb_ex_tax")#>>'{}'))::text ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN ((to_jsonb(so."order_amount_rmb_ex_tax")#>>'{}'))::numeric END AS amount_yuan
 FROM __x360_gov_source_11 so
 LEFT JOIN __order_customer_levels cl ON cl.customer_name=NULLIF(btrim(so.new_customeridname::text),'')
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=so.opportunityid
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
),
__shared_order_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS copies FROM __shared_order_distinct
),
__order_energy AS (
WITH orders AS (SELECT * FROM __shared_order_headers)
, fact_distinct AS (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(l.salesorderdetailid,'MISSING_LINE:'||r.fact_id) AS fact_id,r.fact_date,r.status_code,
 r.d002,r.d003,r.order_team,r.d005,r.d006,r.d049,CASE WHEN (so.statecode=0 AND NOT COALESCE((so.statecode=2 OR
      (so.new_changetype='4' AND so.new_changestatus='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_cancelled cx
        WHERE cx.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND cx.salesorderid<>so.salesorderid
          AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW())),FALSE)) AND so.new_changestatus='8' AND so.new_changetype IN ('1','3','6','8') AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW() AND l.quantity>0 AND l.new_changepostqty>=0 AND l.new_changepostqty<l.quantity AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=NOW()) AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>NOW()) THEN energy_calc.base_energy_kwh*l.new_changepostqty/NULLIF(l.quantity,0) ELSE energy_calc.base_energy_kwh END AS metric_value,r.copies AS source_copies
 FROM orders r JOIN __x360_gov_source_11 so ON so.salesorderid=r.fact_id
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l ON l.salesorderid=r.fact_id
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" pr ON pr.productid=l.new_product_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT CASE
   WHEN l.quantity IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric
   WHEN pr.new_system_energy>0 THEN l.quantity*pr.new_system_energy
   WHEN pr.new_voltage>0 AND pr.new_capacity>0
    THEN l.quantity*pr.new_voltage*pr.new_capacity/1000::numeric
   ELSE NULL::numeric
  END AS base_energy_kwh
 ) energy_calc
 WHERE r.status_code IN ('normal_order','order_change','order_cancel') AND so.new_ord_oa_state='5' AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=NOW()) AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>NOW())), metric_facts AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS metric_copies FROM fact_distinct)
, scoped AS (SELECT f.*,f.order_team AS d004 FROM metric_facts f WHERE 1=1
  AND ((SELECT start_at FROM __order_detail_period) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=CAST((SELECT start_at FROM __order_detail_period) AS timestamp) AND f.fact_date<CAST((SELECT end_at FROM __order_detail_period) AS timestamp))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d002 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d002 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d002))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d003 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d003 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d003))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d004 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.order_team IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d004))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d005 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d005 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d005))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d006 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d006 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d006))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d049 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d049 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d049))) 
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d016 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.status_code IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d016))) )
SELECT f.d049 AS "YWLN_D049",f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003", f.d004 AS "YWLN_D004", f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005", f.d006 AS "YWLN_D006", f.status_code AS "YWLN_D016", SUM(f.metric_value / NULLIF(f.metric_copies,0))/1000000::numeric AS "YWLN_M0032" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.d003,f.d004,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.d049
),__order_amount AS (
WITH orders AS (SELECT * FROM __shared_order_headers)
, fact_distinct AS (SELECT *,amount_yuan AS metric_value,(amount_yuan IS NULL) AS needs_value FROM orders WHERE status_code IN ('normal_order','order_change','order_cancel')), metric_facts AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS metric_copies FROM fact_distinct)
, scoped AS (SELECT f.*,f.order_team AS d004 FROM metric_facts f WHERE 1=1
  AND ((SELECT start_at FROM __order_detail_period) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=CAST((SELECT start_at FROM __order_detail_period) AS timestamp) AND f.fact_date<CAST((SELECT end_at FROM __order_detail_period) AS timestamp))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d002 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d002 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d002))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d003 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d003 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d003))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d004 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.order_team IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d004))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d005 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d005 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d005))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d006 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d006 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d006))) 
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d049 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.d049 IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d049))) 
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __order_detail_ywln_d016 WHERE value IS NOT NULL) OR (f.status_code IN (SELECT value FROM __order_detail_ywln_d016))) )
SELECT f.d049 AS "YWLN_D049",f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003", f.d004 AS "YWLN_D004", f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005", f.d006 AS "YWLN_D006", f.status_code AS "YWLN_D016", SUM(f.metric_value / NULLIF(f.metric_copies,0))/100000000::numeric AS "YWLN_M0033" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.d003,f.d004,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.d049
),__order_keys AS (SELECT "YWLN_D003","YWLN_D004","YWLN_D005","YWLN_D006","YWLN_D016","YWLN_D049" FROM __order_energy UNION SELECT "YWLN_D003","YWLN_D004","YWLN_D005","YWLN_D006","YWLN_D016","YWLN_D049" FROM __order_amount)
SELECT k."YWLN_D003",k."YWLN_D004",CASE k."YWLN_D005" WHEN '0' THEN '核心大客户' WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' ELSE k."YWLN_D005" END AS "YWLN_D005",k."YWLN_D006",k."YWLN_D016",k."YWLN_D049",e."YWLN_M0032",a."YWLN_M0033" FROM __order_keys k LEFT JOIN __order_energy e ON jsonb_build_array(e."YWLN_D003",e."YWLN_D004",e."YWLN_D005",e."YWLN_D006",e."YWLN_D016",e."YWLN_D049")=jsonb_build_array(k."YWLN_D003",k."YWLN_D004",k."YWLN_D005",k."YWLN_D006",k."YWLN_D016",k."YWLN_D049") AND e."YWLN_D003" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D003" AND e."YWLN_D004" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D004" AND e."YWLN_D005" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D005" AND e."YWLN_D006" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D006" AND e."YWLN_D016" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D016" AND e."YWLN_D049" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D049" LEFT JOIN __order_amount a ON jsonb_build_array(a."YWLN_D003",a."YWLN_D004",a."YWLN_D005",a."YWLN_D006",a."YWLN_D016",a."YWLN_D049")=jsonb_build_array(k."YWLN_D003",k."YWLN_D004",k."YWLN_D005",k."YWLN_D006",k."YWLN_D016",k."YWLN_D049") AND a."YWLN_D003" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D003" AND a."YWLN_D004" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D004" AND a."YWLN_D005" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D005" AND a."YWLN_D006" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D006" AND a."YWLN_D016" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D016" AND a."YWLN_D049" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D049"
) AS __x360_gov_result
)

 STRING_AGG(DISTINCT detail."YWLN_D004"::text,'、' ORDER BY detail."YWLN_D004"::text) AS "YWLN_D004",
 CASE MIN(CASE detail."YWLN_D005"
  WHEN '核心大客户' THEN 0 WHEN '0' THEN 0

  WHEN '重要大客户' THEN 2 WHEN '重要客户' THEN 2 WHEN '2' THEN 2
  WHEN '一般客户' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 3

  WHEN 0 THEN '核心大客户'
  WHEN 1 THEN '战略大客户'
  WHEN 2 THEN '重要大客户'
  WHEN 3 THEN '一般客户'
  WHEN 4 THEN 'BG大客户'

 END AS "YWLN_D005",
 STRING_AGG(DISTINCT detail."YWLN_D006"::text,'、' ORDER BY detail."YWLN_D006"::text) AS "YWLN_D006",
 STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE detail."YWLN_D016" WHEN 'order_cancel' THEN '订单取消' WHEN 'order_change' THEN '订单变更' WHEN 'normal_order' THEN '正常订单' ELSE detail."YWLN_D016" END,'、' ORDER BY CASE detail."YWLN_D016" WHEN 'order_cancel' THEN '订单取消' WHEN 'order_change' THEN '订单变更' WHEN 'normal_order' THEN '正常订单' ELSE detail."YWLN_D016" END) AS "YWLN_D016",
 detail."YWLN_D049" AS "YWLN_D049",
 SUM(detail."YWLN_M0032") AS "YWLN_M0032",
