WITH __x360_card_pending_filter(v) AS (
 SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D017*/ UNION ALL
 SELECT CASE v WHEN '超期订未发' THEN 'overdue_pending' WHEN '正常订未发' THEN 'normal_pending' ELSE v END
 FROM unnest(ARRAY[:pending_states]::text[]) x(v) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D017*/
), __x360_card_pie_filter(v) AS (
 SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D051*/ UNION ALL
 SELECT CASE v WHEN 'overdue_pending' THEN '超期订未发' WHEN 'normal_pending' THEN '正常订未发' ELSE v END
 FROM unnest(ARRAY[:shipment_pie_states]::text[]) x(v) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D051*/
),
__requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
),
__bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM __requested),
__flt_YWLN_D002(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:product_lines] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/),
__flt_YWLN_D003(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:product_types] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/),
__flt_YWLN_D004(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:team_ids] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/),
__flt_YWLN_D005(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_levels] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/),
__flt_YWLN_D006(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_ids] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/),
__flt_YWLN_D045(v) AS (SELECT NULL::text WHERE FALSE
/*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D045*/ UNION ALL SELECT unnest(CAST(ARRAY[:anomaly_flags] AS text[])) AS v /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D045*/),
__order_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,so.ordernumber::text AS order_no,
 so.customerid::text AS customerid,NULLIF(btrim(so.new_customeridname::text),'') AS customer_name,so.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,
 so.ownerid::text AS ownerid,so.new_amount::numeric AS order_amount,so.createdon::timestamp AS createdon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so CROSS JOIN __bounds b
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.statecode=0 AND so.createdon::timestamp<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
 AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR (so.createdon::timestamp>=b.start_at AND so.createdon::timestamp<b.end_at))
),
__orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,MIN(order_no) AS order_no,MIN(customerid) AS customerid,MIN(customer_name) AS customer_name,
 MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunityid,MIN(ownerid) AS ownerid,MIN(order_amount) AS order_amount,
 COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue FROM __order_raw GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__line_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderdetailid::text AS salesorderdetailid,l.salesorderid::text AS salesorderid,
 l.new_product_id::text AS new_product_id,l.lineitemnumber,l.new_opportunity_id::text AS new_opportunity_id,
 l.quantity::numeric AS quantity,l.new_productnumber::text AS product_code,l.uomid::text AS uom_id,l.requestdeliveryby::timestamp AS requestdeliveryby,
 l.modifiedon::timestamp AS modifiedon,l.new_effectivedate::timestamp AS new_effectivedate FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=l.salesorderid::text)
),
__line_ranked AS (
 SELECT l.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY salesorderdetailid ORDER BY modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __line_raw l WHERE l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL AND l.modifiedon<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__line_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderdetailid,MIN(salesorderid) AS salesorderid,MIN(new_product_id) AS new_product_id,
 MIN(lineitemnumber) AS lineitemnumber,MIN(new_opportunity_id) AS new_opportunity_id,
 MIN(quantity) AS quantity,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,MIN(requestdeliveryby) AS requestdeliveryby,
 MIN(new_effectivedate) AS new_effectivedate,COUNT(*)>1 AS source_issue
 FROM __line_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY salesorderdetailid
),
__active_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.* FROM __line_latest l WHERE (l.new_effectivedate IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
 
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=l.salesorderid)
),
__order_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT salesorderid,SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
 BOOL_OR(source_issue OR quantity IS NULL OR quantity<0) OR SUM(quantity)<=0 AS quantity_issue,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),''))=1 THEN MIN(NULLIF(btrim(new_opportunity_id),'')) END AS unique_opportunityid
 FROM __active_lines GROUP BY salesorderid
),
__shipment_header_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.new_ord_shipmentid,s.new_shipping2_date,s.statecode,s.modifiedon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
),
__shipment_item_source AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid,i.new_ord_shipment_id,i.new_ord_salesorder_id,i.new_seq,
 i.new_product_id,i.new_productcode,i.new_uom_id,i.new_qty,i.statecode,i.modifiedon
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __orders o WHERE o.salesorderid=i.new_ord_salesorder_id::text)
),
__actual_header_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentid::text AS shipment_id,new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS shipped_at,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_header_source
),
__actual_header_ranked AS (
 SELECT s.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY shipment_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_header_distinct s WHERE shipment_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT shipment_id,MIN(shipped_at) AS shipped_at,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_header_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY shipment_id
),
__actual_item_distinct AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS item_id,new_ord_shipment_id::text AS shipment_id,
 new_ord_salesorder_id::text AS order_id,new_seq::text AS seq_raw,new_product_id::text AS product_id,
 new_productcode::text AS product_code,new_uom_id::text AS uom_id,new_qty::numeric AS shipped_qty,
 statecode,modifiedon::timestamp AS modified_at FROM __shipment_item_source
),
__actual_item_ranked AS (
 SELECT i.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
 FROM __actual_item_distinct i WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_items AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT item_id,MIN(shipment_id) AS shipment_id,MIN(order_id) AS order_id,MIN(seq_raw) AS seq_raw,
 MIN(product_id) AS product_id,MIN(product_code) AS product_code,MIN(uom_id) AS uom_id,
 MIN(shipped_qty) AS shipped_qty,MIN(statecode) AS statecode,COUNT(*)>1 AS version_issue
 FROM __actual_item_ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 GROUP BY item_id
),
__actual_joined AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,s.shipment_id AS matched_header_id,s.shipped_at,s.statecode AS header_state,
 s.version_issue AS header_version_issue,
 CASE WHEN btrim(i.seq_raw) ~ '^[0-9]+([.]0+)?$' THEN btrim(i.seq_raw)::numeric END AS normalized_seq
 FROM __actual_items i JOIN __orders o ON o.salesorderid=i.order_id
 LEFT JOIN __actual_headers s ON s.shipment_id=i.shipment_id
),
__actual_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND header_state=0 AND shipped_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
),
__actual_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.item_id,COUNT(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_matches,
 MIN(l.salesorderdetailid) AS line_id,MIN(l.uom_id) AS line_uom_id
 FROM __actual_eligible i LEFT JOIN __line_latest l ON l.salesorderid=i.order_id
 AND l.lineitemnumber::numeric=i.normalized_seq
 AND (l.new_product_id=i.product_id OR NULLIF(btrim(i.product_code),'')=NULLIF(btrim(l.product_code),''))
 GROUP BY i.item_id
),
__actual_linked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,m.line_matches,m.line_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND NULLIF(btrim(i.uom_id),'')=NULLIF(btrim(m.line_uom_id),''),FALSE) AS same_uom
 FROM __actual_eligible i JOIN __actual_matches m ON m.item_id=i.item_id
),
__actual_problem_rows AS (
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 WHEN line_matches<>1 THEN '发货明细无法唯一关联订单行'
 WHEN NOT same_uom THEN '发货与订单计量单位不一致或缺失'
 WHEN shipped_qty IS NULL THEN '实际发货数量缺失' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_linked
 WHERE version_issue OR header_version_issue OR line_matches<>1 OR NOT same_uom OR shipped_qty IS NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN matched_header_id IS NULL THEN '发货明细找不到可用发货主表'
 WHEN version_issue OR header_version_issue THEN '发货版本冲突'
 ELSE '有效发货单缺实际发货时间' END AS reason
 FROM __actual_joined WHERE statecode=0 AND
 (matched_header_id IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR (header_state=0 AND shipped_at IS NULL))
),
__actual_bad_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,string_agg(DISTINCT reason,'、' ORDER BY reason) AS reason
 FROM __actual_problem_rows GROUP BY order_id
),
__actual_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,SUM(shipped_qty) AS net_shipped_qty,
 BOOL_OR(shipped_qty IS NULL OR version_issue OR header_version_issue OR NOT same_uom) AS source_issue
 FROM __actual_linked WHERE line_matches=1 GROUP BY line_id
),
__line_balances AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.quantity AS ordered_qty,
 COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0) AS net_shipped_qty,b.reason AS actual_problem,
 l.source_issue OR COALESCE(s.source_issue,FALSE) OR b.order_id IS NOT NULL
 OR l.quantity IS NULL OR l.quantity<0 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)<0
 OR COALESCE(s.net_shipped_qty,0)>l.quantity AS quantity_issue
 FROM __active_lines l LEFT JOIN __actual_by_line s ON s.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __actual_bad_orders b ON b.order_id=l.salesorderid
),
__pending_by_line AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT line_id,CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty END AS pending_qty,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue THEN NULL ELSE net_shipped_qty END AS net_shipped_qty,
 quantity_issue,actual_problem,FALSE AS energy_product_issue,
 CASE WHEN quantity_issue OR ordered_qty-net_shipped_qty>0 THEN 1::bigint END AS plan_rows
 FROM __line_balances
),
__product_raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT p.productid::text AS productid,
 CASE WHEN p.new_system_energy>0 THEN p.new_system_energy::numeric
      WHEN p.new_voltage>0 AND p.new_capacity>0 THEN p.new_voltage::numeric*p.new_capacity::numeric/1000::numeric
 END AS unit_energy_kwh
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" p
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __active_lines l WHERE l.new_product_id=p.productid::text)
), __product_energy AS (
 SELECT productid,MIN(unit_energy_kwh) AS unit_energy_kwh,
 COUNT(*)>1 OR BOOL_OR(unit_energy_kwh IS NULL OR unit_energy_kwh<=0) AS source_issue
 FROM __product_raw GROUP BY productid
),
__opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunityid,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
 WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_risklevel::text AS risk_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o
),
__accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS customer_name,
 MIN(a.new_accountlevel)::text AS customer_level
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'')
),
__team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.teamid::text AS team_id,t.name::text AS team_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t.teamid=tm.teamid
),
__owner_teams AS (
 SELECT owner_id,string_agg(DISTINCT team_name,'、' ORDER BY team_name) AS team_names FROM __team_members GROUP BY owner_id
),
__line_base AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.salesorderdetailid AS line_id,l.salesorderid AS order_id,l.new_product_id AS product_id,
 l.quantity AS ordered_qty,l.requestdeliveryby AS due_at,l.requestdeliveryby::date AS due_date,l.source_issue AS line_issue,
 so.order_no,so.customerid,so.order_amount,so.source_issue AS order_issue,ot.total_quantity,ot.quantity_issue AS order_quantity_issue,
 o.d002,o.d003,a.customer_level AS d005,COALESCE(o.owner_id,so.ownerid) AS owner_id,so.customer_name AS d006,CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.d005 IN ('0','1','2') OR o.risk_level IN ('1','2'),FALSE) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS anomaly_flag,p.pending_qty,p.net_shipped_qty,p.actual_problem,p.quantity_issue AS pending_quantity_issue,p.plan_rows,pr.unit_energy_kwh,(pr.productid IS NULL OR pr.source_issue) AS product_issue
 FROM __active_lines l JOIN __orders so ON so.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 JOIN __order_totals ot ON ot.salesorderid=l.salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __pending_by_line p ON p.line_id=l.salesorderdetailid
 LEFT JOIN __product_energy pr ON pr.productid=l.new_product_id
 
 LEFT JOIN __opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.new_opportunity_id),''),ot.unique_opportunityid,NULLIF(btrim(so.opportunityid),''))
 LEFT JOIN __accounts a ON a.customer_name=so.customer_name
),
__line_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,team.team_names AS d004,
 CASE WHEN due_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'overdue_pending' WHEN due_at>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'normal_pending' END AS status_code,
 CURRENT_DATE-due_date AS overdue_days,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND order_amount IS NOT NULL AND ordered_qty>=0 AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*ordered_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS allocated_order_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT order_issue AND NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(order_quantity_issue,TRUE)
 AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND pending_qty>0 AND ordered_qty>0 AND pending_qty<=ordered_qty AND total_quantity>0
 THEN order_amount*pending_qty/NULLIF(total_quantity,0) END AS pending_amount,
 CASE WHEN NOT line_issue AND NOT COALESCE(pending_quantity_issue,FALSE) AND NOT product_issue
 AND pending_qty>0 AND (ordered_qty IS NULL OR pending_qty<=ordered_qty)
 THEN pending_qty*unit_energy_kwh END AS pending_energy_kwh
 FROM __line_base f LEFT JOIN __owner_teams team ON team.owner_id=f.owner_id
),
__line_scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.* FROM __line_facts f WHERE TRUE
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D002) OR (f.d002 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D002)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D003) OR (f.d003 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D003)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __team_members tm WHERE tm.owner_id=f.owner_id AND (tm.team_name IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004) OR tm.team_id IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D004)))))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR (f.d005 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005) OR CASE f.d005 WHEN '0' THEN '核心大客户' WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' ELSE f.d005 END IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D005)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR (f.d006 IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006) OR f.customerid IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D006)))
AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __flt_YWLN_D045) OR (f.anomaly_flag IN (SELECT v FROM __flt_YWLN_D045)))

),
__pending_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.* FROM __line_scope f WHERE f.plan_rows IS NOT NULL
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pending_filter)
      OR f.status_code IS NULL OR f.status_code IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pending_filter))
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_card_pie_filter)
      OR CASE f.status_code WHEN 'overdue_pending' THEN '超期订未发' WHEN 'normal_pending' THEN '正常订未发' END
         IN (SELECT v FROM __x360_card_pie_filter))
),
__totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code IS NULL) AS missing_due_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS overdue_amount_valid_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending' AND pending_amount IS NOT NULL) AS normal_amount_valid_rows,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_amount,
 SUM(pending_amount) FILTER(WHERE status_code='normal_pending') AS normal_amount,
 SUM(pending_energy_kwh) FILTER(WHERE status_code='overdue_pending') AS overdue_energy
 FROM __pending_scope
),
__denominator AS (
 SELECT SUM(allocated_order_amount) FILTER(WHERE allocated_order_amount IS NOT NULL
 AND (plan_rows IS NULL OR (pending_amount IS NOT NULL AND status_code IS NOT NULL))) AS order_amount
 FROM __line_scope
)

WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
)
SELECT
  team_rows.*
FROM (
  WITH __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      start_at,
      end_at
    FROM __ont_bounds
  ), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
      MAX(end_at) AS end_at
    FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
  )
  SELECT
    __x360_period_result.*
  FROM (
    WITH __customer_target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        ranked.*
      FROM (
        SELECT
          original.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY COALESCE(
              NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
              CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
            ), original.new_year
            ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS __customer_target_rn
        FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
      ) AS ranked
      WHERE
        ranked.__customer_target_rn = 1
    )
    SELECT
      customer_target_result.*
    FROM (
      WITH __x360_gov_source_7 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          __x360_raw."new_targetid",
          __x360_raw."ownerid",
          __x360_raw."statecode",
          __x360_raw."new_account_id",
          __x360_raw."new_marketing_center",
          __x360_raw."new_month1",
          __x360_raw."new_month10",
          __x360_raw."new_month11",
          __x360_raw."new_month12",
          __x360_raw."new_month2",
          __x360_raw."new_month3",
          __x360_raw."new_month4",
          __x360_raw."new_month5",
          __x360_raw."new_month6",
          __x360_raw."new_month7",
          __x360_raw."new_month8",
          __x360_raw."new_month9",
          __x360_raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __x360_raw."new_year",
          __x360_raw."new_month1_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month10_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month11_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month12_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month2_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month3_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month4_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month5_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month6_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month7_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month8_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month9_power",
          __x360_raw."new_target_type",
          CAST(__x360_product_type."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) AS "new_accproducttype"
        FROM (
          SELECT
            __x360_rank.*
          FROM (
            SELECT
              __x360_base.*,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY COALESCE(
                  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
                  CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
                ), __x360_base.new_year
                ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
              ) AS version_rn
            FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
            WHERE
              TRUE
          ) AS __x360_rank
          WHERE
            __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
        ) AS __x360_raw
        LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS __x360_product_type
          ON __x360_product_type."new_product_typeid" = __x360_raw."new_producttype_id"
      )
      SELECT
        *
      FROM (
        WITH __account_once AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT
            (
              a.accountid || ''
            ) AS accountid,
            (
              a.name || ''
            ) AS name,
            a.new_accountlevel
          FROM __ont_accounts AS a
        ), __month_once AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT
            (
              m.new_oppmonthid || ''
            ) AS new_oppmonthid,
            (
              m.new_opportunity_id || ''
            ) AS new_opportunity_id,
            m.new_accountdate,
            m.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
            m.new_whprice,
            m.__ont_energy_mwh,
            m.new_year,
            m.new_month,
            m.statecode,
            (
              m.new_approvalstatus || ''
            ) AS new_approvalstatus
          FROM (
            SELECT
              __latest."new_accountdate",
              __latest.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
              __latest."new_approvalstatus",
              __latest.__ont_energy_mwh,
              __latest."new_month",
              __latest."new_oppmonthid",
              __latest."new_opportunity_id",
              __latest."new_whprice",
              __latest."new_year",
              __latest."statecode"
            FROM (
              SELECT
                __raw."createdon",
                __raw."modifiedon",
                __raw."new_accountdate",
                __raw.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
                __raw."new_approvalstatus",
                __raw.__ont_energy_mwh,
                __raw."new_month",
                __raw."new_oppmonthid",
                __raw."new_opportunity_id",
                __raw."new_whprice",
                __raw."new_year",
                __raw."statecode",
                1 AS __x360_period_latest_rn
              FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
              WHERE
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
                AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
                AND (
                  (
                    SELECT
                      start_at
                    FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
                  ) IS NULL
                  OR (
                    CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                      SELECT
                        start_at
                      FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
                    )
                    AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                      SELECT
                        end_at
                      FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
                    )
                  )
                )
            ) AS __latest
            WHERE
              __latest.__x360_period_latest_rn = 1
          ) AS m
          WHERE
            m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        ), __target_once AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT DISTINCT ON ((
              t.new_targetid || ''
          ))
            (
              t.new_targetid || ''
            ) AS new_targetid,
            (
              t.ownerid || ''
            ) AS ownerid,
            (
              t.new_marketing_center || ''
            ) AS new_marketing_center,
            (
              t.new_accproducttype || ''
            ) AS new_accproducttype,
            (
              t.new_account_id || ''
            ) AS new_account_id,
            t.new_year,
            t.statecode,
            t.new_target_type,
            t.new_month1,
            t.new_month2,
            t.new_month3,
            t.new_month4,
            t.new_month5,
            t.new_month6,
            t.new_month7,
            t.new_month8,
            t.new_month9,
            t.new_month10,
            t.new_month11,
            t.new_month12,
            t.new_month1_power,
            t.new_month2_power,
            t.new_month3_power,
            t.new_month4_power,
            t.new_month5_power,
            t.new_month6_power,
            t.new_month7_power,
            t.new_month8_power,
            t.new_month9_power,
            t.new_month10_power,
            t.new_month11_power,
            t.new_month12_power
          FROM __x360_gov_source_7 AS t
          WHERE
            TRUE
          ORDER BY
            (
              t.new_targetid || ''
            )
        ), __dashboard_combo_period AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            start_at,
            end_at
          FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d002 AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
          /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            UNNEST(CAST(ARRAY[:product_lines] AS TEXT[])) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d003 AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
          /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            UNNEST(CAST(ARRAY[:product_types] AS TEXT[])) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d004 AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
          /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            UNNEST(CAST(ARRAY[:team_ids] AS TEXT[])) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005 AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
          /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            UNNEST(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_levels] AS TEXT[])) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
        ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006 AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
          /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            UNNEST(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_ids] AS TEXT[])) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
        ), __team_month_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            m.new_oppmonthid
          FROM __month_once AS m
          WHERE
            m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __dashboard_combo_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR (
                CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                  SELECT
                    start_at
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                )
                AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                  SELECT
                    end_at
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                )
              )
            )
        ), __month_selected_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT
            m.*,
            i.new_oppmonthid AS selected_key
          FROM __month_once AS m
          FULL JOIN __team_month_ids AS i
            ON i.new_oppmonthid = m.new_oppmonthid
        ), __team_month_source AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT
            m.new_oppmonthid,
            m.new_opportunity_id,
            m.new_accountdate,
            m.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
            m.new_whprice,
            m.__ont_energy_mwh,
            m.new_year,
            m.new_month,
            m.statecode,
            m.new_approvalstatus
          FROM __month_selected_bridge AS m
          WHERE
            m.selected_key IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        ), __team_opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            (
              o.opportunityid || ''
            ) AS opportunityid,
            CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP),
            CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
            CASE
              WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
              THEN NULL
              WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
              THEN '其他'
              WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('1', '电芯')
              THEN '电芯'
              WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('2', 'PACK')
              THEN 'PACK'
              ELSE '其他'
            END AS d003,
            (
              o.ownerid || ''
            ) AS owner_id,
            (
              SELECT
                team_name
              FROM __ont_owner_teams AS ot
              WHERE
                ot.ownerid = CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT)
            ) AS team_name,
            CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
            NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS status_code
          FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
          LEFT JOIN __account_once AS acc_o
            ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
          WHERE
            o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
            AND EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __team_month_source AS ms
              WHERE
                ms.new_opportunity_id = o.opportunityid
            )
        ), __team_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT
            *,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY opportunityid) AS copies
          FROM __team_opportunity_distinct
        ), __team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            (
              tm."systemuserid" || ''
            ) AS owner_id,
            (

WITH __helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v
),
__first_ship AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT i2.new_ord_salesorder_id AS new_salesorderid,MIN(s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp) AS shipped_at FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s2 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i2 ON i2.new_ord_shipment_id=s2.new_ord_shipmentid WHERE TRUE AND s2.statecode=0 AND s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(i2.new_ord_salesorder_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i2.new_ord_salesorder_id
),
requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.energy_kwh)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((f.energy_issue),FALSE) OR (f.energy_kwh) IS NULL) AS invalid,(FALSE) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.helmet_status AS helmet_status FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text,'MISSING_LINE:'||s.new_ord_shipmentid::text) AS fact_id,
 s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS fact_date,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 COALESCE(o.ownerid,s.ownerid)::text AS owner_id,c.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_s.name::text),'') AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN ((so.statecode=0 AND NOT (so.statecode=2 OR COALESCE((so.new_changetype::text='4' AND so.new_changestatus::text='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)
 OR COALESCE(so.salesorderid IN (SELECT cx.new_salesorderid FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" cx
        WHERE TRUE AND cx.salesorderid<>cx.new_salesorderid
          AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)))) AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL OR (first_ship.shipped_at>=so.new_approval_time::timestamp AND first_ship.shipped_at<=NOW())) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM __helmet_cfg p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D024') AS helmet_status,
 i.new_qty*pr.new_system_energy AS energy_kwh,i.new_amount::numeric AS amount_yuan,
 (i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NULL) AS source_issue,
 (pr.new_system_energy IS NULL OR pr.new_system_energy<=0) AS energy_issue
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_s ON acc_s.accountid = s.new_account_id
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i ON i.new_ord_shipment_id=s.new_ord_shipmentid AND i.new_qty>0
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" pr ON pr.productnumber=i.new_productcode AND pr.new_system_energy>0
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so ON so.salesorderid = i.new_ord_salesorder_id
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=(SELECT MIN(d.new_opportunity_id) FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" d WHERE d.salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id)=1)
 LEFT JOIN __first_ship first_ship ON first_ship.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid

 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" c ON c.accountid=s.new_account_id
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=NOW()
) f WHERE TRUE
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_LEVEL_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d005::text IN (:customer_levels) OR (CASE f.d005::text WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' WHEN '战略大客户' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '重要大客户' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '一般客户' THEN '一般客户' WHEN 'BG大客户' THEN 'BG大客户' END) IN (:customer_levels)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_NAME_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d006::text IN (:customer_ids) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" customer_filter WHERE customer_filter.accountid::text=f.d006::text AND NULLIF(btrim(customer_filter.name::text),'') IN (:customer_ids))) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D024*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D024*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:shipment_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT f.d003 AS "D003", f.period_key AS "YWLN_D044", (CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0006" FROM (SELECT s.*, to_char(s.fact_date,'YYYY-MM') AS period_key FROM scoped s) f GROUP BY f.d003, f.period_key

WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
)
SELECT
  combo."YWLN_D005",
  combo."YWLN_M0024",
  combo."YWLN_M0075",
  combo."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
  combo."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ENERGY_GAP",
  combo."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
FROM (
  WITH __x360_risk_selected_prediction_request AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
    /*TIME_BEGIN*/
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
      CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
  ), __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
      MAX(end_at) AS end_at
    FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_request
  )
  SELECT
    __x360_risk_period_result.*
  FROM (
    WITH __customer_target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        ranked.*
      FROM (
        SELECT
          original.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY COALESCE(
              NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
              CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
            ), original.new_year
            ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS __customer_target_rn
        FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
      ) AS ranked
      WHERE
        ranked.__customer_target_rn = 1
    )
    SELECT
      customer_target_result.*
    FROM (
      WITH __x360_gov_source_7 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          __x360_raw."new_targetid",
          __x360_raw."ownerid",
          __x360_raw."createdon",
          __x360_raw."statecode",
          __x360_raw."new_account_id",
          __x360_raw."new_marketing_center",
          __x360_raw."new_month1",
          __x360_raw."new_month10",
          __x360_raw."new_month11",
          __x360_raw."new_month12",
          __x360_raw."new_month2",
          __x360_raw."new_month3",
          __x360_raw."new_month4",
          __x360_raw."new_month5",
          __x360_raw."new_month6",
          __x360_raw."new_month7",
          __x360_raw."new_month8",
          __x360_raw."new_month9",
          __x360_raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __x360_raw."new_year",
          __x360_raw."new_month1_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month10_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month11_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month12_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month2_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month3_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month4_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month5_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month6_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month7_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month8_power",
          __x360_raw."new_month9_power",
          __x360_raw."new_target_type",
          __x360_raw."new_product_id",
          CAST(__x360_product_type."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) AS "new_accproducttype"
        FROM (
          SELECT
            __x360_rank.*
          FROM (
            SELECT
              __x360_base.*,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY COALESCE(
                  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
                  CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
                ), __x360_base.new_year
                ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
              ) AS version_rn
            FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
          ) AS __x360_rank
          WHERE
            __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
        ) AS __x360_raw
        LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS __x360_product_type
          ON __x360_product_type."new_product_typeid" = __x360_raw."new_producttype_id"
      )
      SELECT
        *
      FROM (
        /* CUSTOMER_LEVEL_CODES_V1 */
        SELECT
          CASE CAST(view_rows."YWLN_D005" AS TEXT)
            WHEN '战略大客户'
            THEN '1'
            WHEN '战略客户'
            THEN '1'
            WHEN '重要大客户'
            THEN '2'
            WHEN '重要客户'
            THEN '2'
            WHEN '一般客户'
            THEN '3'
            WHEN 'BG大客户'
            THEN '4'
            WHEN 'BG客户'
            THEN '4'
            ELSE CAST(view_rows."YWLN_D005" AS TEXT)
          END AS "YWLN_D005",
          view_rows."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ENERGY_GAP",
          view_rows."YWLN_M0024",
          view_rows."YWLN_M0075",
          view_rows."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
          view_rows."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
        FROM (
          WITH __dashboard_combo_period AS (
            SELECT
              CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
              CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
            WHERE
              FALSE
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
              start_at,
              end_at
            FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
          ), __dashboard_customer_level_inputs AS (
            SELECT
              CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
            /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/
            WHERE
              FALSE
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
              UNNEST(CAST(ARRAY[:customer_levels] AS TEXT[])) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
          ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005 AS MATERIALIZED (
            SELECT DISTINCT
              expanded.value
            FROM __dashboard_customer_level_inputs AS input
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
              VALUES
                (input.value),
                (
                  CASE input.value
                    WHEN '核心大客户'
                    THEN '0'
                    WHEN '战略大客户'
                    THEN '1'
                    WHEN '重要大客户'
                    THEN '2'
                    WHEN '一般客户'
                    THEN '3'
                    WHEN 'BG大客户'
                    THEN '4'
                  END
                ),
                (
                  CASE input.value
                    WHEN '0'
                    THEN '核心大客户'
                    WHEN '1'
                    THEN '战略大客户'
                    WHEN '2'
                    THEN '重要大客户'
                    WHEN '3'
                    THEN '一般客户'
                    WHEN '4'
                    THEN 'BG大客户'
                  END
                )
            ) AS expanded(value)
            WHERE
              expanded.value IS NOT NULL
          ), __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006 AS (
            SELECT
              CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
          ), __base_customer_metrics AS MATERIALIZED (
            WITH __grouped_metric_1 AS (
              WITH requested AS (
                SELECT
                  CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
                  CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
                WHERE
                  FALSE
                UNION ALL
                SELECT
                  CAST((
                    SELECT
                      start_at
                    FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                  ) AS TIMESTAMP),
                  CAST((
                    SELECT
                      end_at
                    FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                  ) AS TIMESTAMP)
              ), bounds AS (
                SELECT
                  MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
                  MAX(end_at) AS end_at
                FROM requested
              ), measure_rows AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                  CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
                  CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
                  CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
                  CAST((
                    1
                  ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
                  (
                    COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR COALESCE((
                      FALSE
                    ), FALSE)
                  ) AS invalid,
                  (
                    FALSE
                  ) AS poison_time,
                  f.d002,
                  f.d003,
                  f.owner_id,
                  f.d005,
                  f.d006,
                  f.status_code,
                  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status
                FROM (
                  SELECT
                    CAST(c.accountid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
                    CAST(c.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
                    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d002,
                    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d003,
                    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
                    CAST(c.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
                    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS status_code,
                    FALSE AS source_issue
                  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" AS c
                  WHERE
                    c.accountid IS NOT NULL
                ) AS f
                WHERE
                  TRUE
              ), checked AS (
                SELECT
                  *,
                  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
                FROM measure_rows
              ), scoped AS (
                SELECT
                  f.*,
                  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
                FROM checked AS f
                WHERE
                  (
                    (
                      SELECT
                        start_at
                      FROM bounds
                    ) IS NULL
                    OR (
                      f.fact_date >= (
                        SELECT
                          start_at
                        FROM bounds
                      )
                      AND f.fact_date < (
                        SELECT
                          end_at
                        FROM bounds
                      )
                    )
                    OR f.poison_time
                  )
                  AND (
                    NOT EXISTS(
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                      WHERE
                        value IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    OR (
                      f.d005 IN (
                        SELECT
                          value
                        FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                      )
                    )
                  )
                  AND (
                    NOT EXISTS(
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                      WHERE
                        value IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    OR (
                      f.d006 IN (
                        SELECT
                          value
                        FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                      )
                    )
                  )
              )
              SELECT
                f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005",
                (
                  CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(BOOL_OR(f.invalid) FILTER(WHERE
                      f.measure_tag = 'm0'), FALSE)
                    THEN NULL
                    ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT f.fact_id) FILTER(WHERE
                      f.measure_tag = 'm0')
                  END
                ) AS "YWLN_M0075"
              FROM scoped AS f
              GROUP BY
                f.d005
            ), __grouped_metric_2 AS (
              WITH requested AS (
                SELECT
                  CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,

                WHERE
                  FALSE
                UNION ALL
                SELECT
                  CAST((
                    SELECT
                      start_at

                  ) AS TIMESTAMP),
                  CAST((
                    SELECT
                      end_at
                    FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                  ) AS TIMESTAMP)
              ), bounds AS (
                SELECT
                  MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
                  MAX(end_at) AS end_at
                FROM requested
              ), measure_rows AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                  CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
                  CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
                  CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
                  CAST((
                    f.energy_kwh
                  ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
                  (
                    COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE)
                    OR COALESCE((
                      f.energy_issue
                    ), FALSE)
                    OR (
                      f.energy_kwh
                    ) IS NULL
                  ) AS invalid,
                  (
                    FALSE
                  ) AS poison_time,
                  f.d002,
                  f.d003,
                  f.owner_id,

                  f.d006,

                FROM (

                    ) AS fact_id,
                    CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
                    CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
                    CASE
                      WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
                      THEN NULL
                      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
                      THEN '其他'
                      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
                      THEN '电芯'
                      WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
                      THEN 'PACK'
                      ELSE '其他'
                    END AS d003,
                    CAST(COALESCE(o.ownerid, s.ownerid) AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
                    CAST(c.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
                    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS status_code,
                    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status,
                    i.new_qty * pr.new_system_energy AS energy_kwh,
                    CAST(i.new_amount AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
                    (
                      i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NULL
                    ) AS source_issue,
                    (

                  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" AS s
                  LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" AS i

                  JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS pr

                  LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
                    ON so.salesorderid = s.new_salesorderid
                  LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" AS o
                    ON o.opportunityid = so.opportunityid
                  LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" AS c
                    ON c.accountid = s.new_account_id
                  WHERE
                    s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL
                    AND s.statecode = 0
                    AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
                    AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    AND (
                      (
                        SELECT
                          start_at

                      ) IS NULL
                      OR (
                        CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                          SELECT
                            start_at
                          FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                        )
                        AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                          SELECT

                        )
                      )
                    )
                    AND (
                      NOT EXISTS(
                        SELECT
                          1
                        FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                        WHERE

                      )
                      OR CAST(c.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN (
                        SELECT
                          value

                      )
                    )
                    AND (
                      NOT EXISTS(
                        SELECT
                          1
                        FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                        WHERE

                      )
                      OR NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c.name AS TEXT)), '') IN (
                        SELECT
                          value
                        FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                      )
                    )
                ) AS f
                WHERE
                  f.d006 IS NOT NULL
              ), checked AS (
                SELECT
                  *,
                  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
                FROM measure_rows
              ), scoped AS (
                SELECT
                  f.*,
                  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
                FROM checked AS f
                WHERE
                  (
                    (
                      SELECT
                        start_at
                      FROM bounds
                    ) IS NULL
                    OR (
                      f.fact_date >= (
                        SELECT
                          start_at
                        FROM bounds
                      )
                      AND f.fact_date < (
                        SELECT
                          end_at
                        FROM bounds
                      )
                    )
                    OR f.poison_time
                  )
                  AND (
                    NOT EXISTS(
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                      WHERE
                        value IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    OR (
                      f.d005 IN (
                        SELECT
                          value
                        FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                      )
                    )
                  )
                  AND (
                    NOT EXISTS(
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                      WHERE
                        value IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    OR (
                      f.d006 IN (
                        SELECT
                          value
                        FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                      )
                    )
                  )
              )
              SELECT
                f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005",
                (
                  CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(
                      BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies > 1) FILTER(WHERE
                        f.measure_tag = 'm0'),
                      FALSE
                    )
                    THEN NULL
                    ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
                      f.measure_tag = 'm0')
                  END
                ) AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY"
              FROM scoped AS f
              GROUP BY
                f.d005
            ), __grouped_metric_3 AS (
              WITH requested AS (
                SELECT
                  CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
                  CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
                WHERE
                  FALSE
                UNION ALL
                SELECT
                  CAST((
                    SELECT
                      start_at
                    FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                  ) AS TIMESTAMP),
                  CAST((
                    SELECT
                      end_at
                    FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                  ) AS TIMESTAMP)
              ), bounds AS (
                SELECT
                  MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
                  MAX(end_at) AS end_at
                FROM requested
              ), measure_rows AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                  CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
                  CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
                  CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
                  CAST((
                    f.energy_mwh
                  ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
                  (
                    COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR COALESCE((
                      FALSE
                    ), FALSE)
                  ) AS invalid,
                  (
                    FALSE
                  ) AS poison_time,
                  f.d002,
                  f.d003,
                  f.owner_id,
                  f.d005,
                  f.d006,
                  f.status_code,
                  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status
                FROM (
                  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.new_targetid, v.n)
                    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) || ':' || CAST(v.n AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
                    CASE
                      WHEN TRIM(CAST(t.new_year AS TEXT)) ~ '^[0-9]{4}$'
                      AND TRIM(CAST(t.new_year AS TEXT)) <> '0000'
                      THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(TRIM(CAST(t.new_year AS TEXT)) AS INT), v.n, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
                    END AS fact_date,
                    CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
                    CASE
                      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
                      THEN '其他'
                      WHEN CAST(t.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
                      THEN '电芯'
                      WHEN CAST(t.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
                      THEN 'PACK'
                      ELSE '其他'
                    END AS d003,
                    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
                    CAST(c.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
                    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS status_code,
                    CAST(v.power AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
                    FALSE AS source_issue
                  FROM __x360_gov_source_7 AS t
                  LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" AS c
                    ON c.accountid = t.new_account_id
                  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                    VALUES
                      (1, t.new_month1_power),
                      (2, t.new_month2_power),
                      (3, t.new_month3_power),
                      (4, t.new_month4_power),
                      (5, t.new_month5_power),
                      (6, t.new_month6_power),
                      (7, t.new_month7_power),
                      (8, t.new_month8_power),

                  ) AS v(n, power)
                  WHERE
                    t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL AND TRUE
                  ORDER BY
                    t.new_targetid,
                    v.n
                ) AS f
              ), checked AS (
                SELECT
                  *,
                  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
                FROM measure_rows
              ), scoped AS (
                SELECT
                  f.*,
                  CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
                FROM checked AS f
                WHERE
                  (
                    (
                      SELECT
                        start_at
                      FROM bounds
                    ) IS NULL
                    OR (
                      f.fact_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', (
                        SELECT
                          start_at
                        FROM bounds
                      ))
                      AND f.fact_date < CASE
                        WHEN (
                          SELECT
                            end_at
                          FROM bounds
                        ) IS NOT NULL
                        THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', (
                          SELECT
                            start_at
                          FROM bounds
                        )) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
                      END
                    )
                    OR f.poison_time
                  )
                  AND (
                    NOT EXISTS(
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                      WHERE
                        value IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    OR (
                      f.d005 IN (
                        SELECT
                          value

                      )
                    )
                  )
                  AND (
                    NOT EXISTS(
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                      WHERE
                        value IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    OR (
                      f.d006 IN (
                        SELECT
                          value
                        FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                      )
                    )

              )
              SELECT
                f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005",
                SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
                  f.measure_tag = 'm0') AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
              FROM scoped AS f
              GROUP BY
                f.d005
            ), __grouped_keys AS (
              SELECT
                "YWLN_D005"
              FROM __grouped_metric_1
              UNION
              SELECT
                "YWLN_D005"
              FROM __grouped_metric_2
              UNION
              SELECT
                "YWLN_D005"
              FROM __grouped_metric_3
            )
            SELECT
              k."YWLN_D005" AS "YWLN_D005",
              __grouped_metric_1."YWLN_M0075" AS "YWLN_M0075",
              __grouped_metric_2."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY" AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
              __grouped_metric_3."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
            FROM __grouped_keys AS k
            LEFT JOIN __grouped_metric_1
              ON __grouped_metric_1."YWLN_D005" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D005"
            LEFT JOIN __grouped_metric_2
              ON __grouped_metric_2."YWLN_D005" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D005"
            LEFT JOIN __grouped_metric_3
              ON __grouped_metric_3."YWLN_D005" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k."YWLN_D005"
          ), cancelled_order_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
            SELECT DISTINCT
              (
                cx.new_salesorderid || ''
              ) AS salesorderid
            FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS cx
            WHERE
              TRUE
              AND cx.salesorderid <> cx.new_salesorderid

          ), signed_opportunity_ids AS MATERIALIZED (

            LEFT JOIN cancelled_order_ids AS cx
              ON cx.salesorderid = so.salesorderid

              TRUE
              AND so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
              AND so.new_salesordertype = '1'
              AND so.new_order_category IN ('1', '3')
              AND so.statecode = 0
              AND NOT COALESCE(

                  so.statecode = 2
                  OR (

                    AND so.new_changestatus = '8'
                    AND CAST(so.new_approval_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                  )
                  OR FALSE
                ),

              )
              AND so.new_ord_oa_state = '5'
              AND CAST(so.new_approval_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          ), opportunity_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (

              CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,

                THEN '其他'

                THEN '电芯'
                WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('2', 'PACK')

              o.d002,
              o.d003,

              COALESCE(CAST(acc_o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT), o.d005) AS d005,

              CASE
                WHEN signed.opportunityid IS NOT NULL

                ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
              END AS status_code
            FROM opportunity_filtered AS o
            LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" AS acc_o
              ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
            LEFT JOIN signed_opportunity_ids AS signed
              ON signed.opportunityid = o.opportunityid
          ), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
            SELECT
              od.*,
              COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY od.opportunityid) AS source_copies
            FROM opportunity_distinct AS od
          ), count_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
            SELECT
              o.*,
              COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.opportunityid) AS fact_copies
            FROM opportunities AS o
            WHERE
              TRUE
          ), opportunity_counts AS (
            SELECT
              f.d005,
              COUNT(DISTINCT f.opportunityid) AS opportunity_count
            FROM count_facts AS f
            WHERE
              (
                (
                  SELECT
                    start_at
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_period
                ) IS NULL
                OR (
                  TRUE AND TRUE
                )
              )
              AND (
                NOT EXISTS(
                  SELECT
                    1
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                  WHERE
                    value IS NOT NULL
                )
                OR f.d005 IN (
                  SELECT
                    value
                  FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                )
              )
            GROUP BY
              f.d005
          ), grouped_keys AS (
            SELECT
              "YWLN_D005" AS d005
            FROM __base_customer_metrics
            UNION
            SELECT
              d005
            FROM opportunity_counts
          )
          SELECT
            CASE k.d005
              WHEN '0'
              THEN '核心大客户'
              WHEN '1'
              THEN '战略大客户'
              WHEN '2'
              THEN '重要大客户'
              WHEN '3'
              THEN '一般客户'
              WHEN '4'
              THEN 'BG大客户'
              ELSE k.d005
            END AS "YWLN_D005",
            (
              customer."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" - customer."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY"
            ) AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ENERGY_GAP",
            opportunity.opportunity_count AS "YWLN_M0024",
            customer."YWLN_M0075" AS "YWLN_M0075",
            customer."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY" AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
            customer."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
          FROM grouped_keys AS k
          LEFT JOIN __base_customer_metrics AS customer
            ON customer."YWLN_D005" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.d005
          LEFT JOIN opportunity_counts AS opportunity
            ON opportunity.d005 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.d005
          ORDER BY
            CASE k.d005 WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3' THEN 3 WHEN '4' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,
            k.d005
        ) AS view_rows
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(view_rows."YWLN_D005"), '') IS NOT NULL
      ) AS __x360_gov_result
    ) AS customer_target_result
  ) AS __x360_risk_period_result
