WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __inline_0 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t."statecode",
    t."new_changestatus",
    t."new_salesordertype",
    t."new_order_category",
    (
      t."salesorderid" || ''
    ) AS "salesorderid",
    t."new_ord_oa_state",
    (
      t."new_salesorderid" || ''
    ) AS "new_salesorderid",
    (
      t."opportunityid" || ''
    ) AS "opportunityid",
    t."new_approval_time",
    t."new_changetype"
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS t
), __inline_1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t."enabled",
    t."config_value",
    t."updated_at",
    t."config_group",
    t."indicator_code",
    t."dimension_code",
    t."config_set",
    t."value_unit",
    t."notes",
    t."period_key",
    t."config_key",
    t."config_label"
  FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config" AS t
), __inline_2 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
    (
      t."new_forecast_amt_rmb" / NULLIF(t."new_whprice", 0) / 1000000
    ) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    t."statecode",
    t."new_accountdate",
    t."new_approvalstatus",
    (
      t."new_oppmonthid" || ''
    ) AS "new_oppmonthid",
    t."new_month",
    (
      t."new_opportunity_id" || ''
    ) AS "new_opportunity_id",
    t."new_year"
  FROM __ont_forecast AS t
), __inline_3 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t."new_stage5enddate",
    t."new_approvalstatus",
    t."new_salesbg",
    (
      t."parentaccountid" || ''
    ) AS "parentaccountid",
    (
      t."ownerid" || ''
    ) AS "ownerid",
    t."createdon",
    (
      t."opportunityid" || ''
    ) AS "opportunityid",
    t."new_accproducttype",
    t."new_opportunitystatus",
    t."new_accountlevel",
    t."new_risklevel"
  FROM __ont_opportunity AS t
), __inline_4 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      t."accountid" || ''
    ) AS "accountid",
    (
      t."name" || ''
    ) AS "name"
  FROM __ont_accounts AS t
), __inline_5 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      t."teamid" || ''
    ) AS "teamid",
    (
      t."systemuserid" || ''
    ) AS "systemuserid"
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS t
), __inline_6 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      t."teamid" || ''
    ) AS "teamid",
    (
      t."name" || ''
    ) AS "name"
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
), __audit_signed_896a6fa2cfd9_cancelled AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cx.new_salesorderid AS order_id
  FROM __inline_0 AS cx
  WHERE
    cx.salesorderid <> cx.new_salesorderid
), __audit_signed_896a6fa2cfd9_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sx.opportunityid
  FROM __inline_0 AS sx
  WHERE
    sx.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      NOT (
        sx.statecode = 2
        OR COALESCE((
          CAST(sx.new_changestatus AS TEXT) = '8'
        ), FALSE)
        OR COALESCE(
          sx.salesorderid IN (
            SELECT
              order_id
            FROM __audit_signed_896a6fa2cfd9_cancelled
          ),
          FALSE
        )
      )
    )
), __helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    dimension_code,
    cycle_target_days,
    imminent_days,
    (
      cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
      AND cycle_target_days >= 0
      AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL
      AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days
    ) AS enabled
  FROM (
    SELECT
      dimension_code,
      MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
        config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
      MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
        config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
    FROM __inline_1
    WHERE
      config_set = 'MOCK'
      AND period_key = 'GLOBAL'
      AND config_group = 'HELMET'
      AND enabled
    GROUP BY
      dimension_code
  ) AS v
), requested AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM requested
), measure_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
    CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
    CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
    CAST((
      f.energy_mwh
    ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
    (
      COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR COALESCE((
        FALSE
      ), FALSE)
    ) AS invalid,
    (
      FALSE
    ) AS poison_time,
    f.d002,
    f.d003,
    f.owner_id,
    f.d005,
    f.d006,
    f.status_code,
    f.helmet_status AS helmet_status
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
        THEN NULL
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
          WHERE
            __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
        )
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS status_code,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN (
              TRUE
            )
            AND CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            AND (
              CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR (
                CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP)
                AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              )
            )
            AND p.enabled
            AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
            THEN CASE
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE)
              ) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
              THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE)
              ) > p.imminent_days
              THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS DATE) - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_completed'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS DATE) - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) <= p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'normal_completed'
            END
          END
        FROM __helmet_cfg AS p
        WHERE
          p.dimension_code = 'YWLN_D020'
      ) AS helmet_status,
      (
        CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
        OR CAST(o.new_risklevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
      ) AS is_key,
      CAST(m.__ont_energy_mwh AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
      m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan,
      TRUE AS amount_period_valid,
      FALSE AS source_issue
    FROM __inline_2 AS m
    JOIN __inline_3 AS o
      LEFT JOIN __inline_4 AS acc_o
        ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
      ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  ) AS f
  WHERE
    f.energy_mwh IS NOT NULL
), checked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
  FROM measure_rows
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
  FROM checked AS f
  WHERE
    (
      (
        SELECT
          start_at
        FROM bounds
      ) IS NULL
      OR (
        f.fact_date >= (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM bounds
        )
        AND f.fact_date < (
          SELECT
            end_at
          FROM bounds
        )
      )
      OR f.poison_time
    )
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND  f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND  f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND  EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM __inline_5 AS tm
      JOIN __inline_6 AS t
        ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
      WHERE
        CAST(tm."systemuserid" AS TEXT) = f.owner_id
        AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) IN (:team_ids)
    ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND  /* YWLN_CUSTOMER_LEVEL_FILTER_V1 */ (
      CAST(f.d005 AS TEXT) IN (:customer_levels)
      OR (
        CASE CAST(f.d005 AS TEXT)
          WHEN '0'
          THEN '核心大客户'
          WHEN '1'
          THEN '战略大客户'
          WHEN '2'
          THEN '重要大客户'
          WHEN '3'
          THEN '一般客户'
          WHEN '4'
          THEN 'BG大客户'
          WHEN '战略大客户'
          THEN '战略大客户'
          WHEN '重要大客户'
          THEN '重要大客户'
          WHEN '一般客户'
          THEN '一般客户'
          WHEN 'BG大客户'
          THEN 'BG大客户'
        END
      ) IN (:customer_levels)
    ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND  /* YWLN_CUSTOMER_NAME_FILTER_V1 */ (
      CAST(f.d006 AS TEXT) IN (:customer_ids)
      OR EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __inline_4 AS customer_filter
        WHERE
          CAST(customer_filter.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(f.d006 AS TEXT)
          AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(customer_filter.name AS TEXT)), '') IN (:customer_ids)
      )
    ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/ AND  f.status_code IN (:sign_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D020*/ AND  f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D020*/
)
SELECT
  f.helmet_status AS "YWLN_D020",
  (
    SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
      f.measure_tag = 'm0')
  ) AS "YWLN_M0022"
FROM scoped AS f
GROUP BY
  f.helmet_status

WITH requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (
 SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested
), __x360_gov_source_6 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT d.new_model,d.new_productpower,d.new_quoteapply_id,d.new_product_id,d.new_opportunity_id,
  CASE WHEN d.new_seq IS NOT NULL THEN ROW(d.new_quoteapply_id,d.new_seq)::text
       WHEN NULLIF(btrim(d.new_name::text),'') IS NOT NULL THEN ROW(d.new_quoteapply_id,d.new_name)::text END AS new_quoteapplydetailid
 FROM (
  SELECT raw.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER (
   PARTITION BY raw.new_quoteapply_id,
    CASE WHEN raw.new_seq IS NOT NULL THEN ROW(raw.new_quoteapply_id,raw.new_seq)::text
         WHEN NULLIF(btrim(raw.new_name::text),'') IS NOT NULL THEN ROW(raw.new_quoteapply_id,raw.new_name)::text END
   ORDER BY raw.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST
  ) AS latest_rank
  FROM (
   SELECT DISTINCT new_quoteapply_id,new_seq,new_name,new_product_id,new_opportunity_id,
    new_model,new_productpower,NULLIF(btrim(modifiedon::text),'')::timestamp AS modifiedon
   FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb" WHERE statecode=0
  ) raw
 ) d WHERE latest_rank=1
)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT q.new_quoteapplyid AS quote_id,q.new_approvalstatus::text AS approval,
 NULLIF(btrim(q.new_oaquoteid::text),'') AS oa_no,NULLIF(btrim(q.createdon::text),'')::timestamp AS quote_created,NULLIF(btrim(q.new_oasubmitdate::text),'')::timestamp AS submitted_at,
 NULLIF(btrim(q.new_approved_time::text),'')::timestamp AS approved_at,q.ownerid AS quote_owner
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb" q
 WHERE q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL AND q.new_approvalstatus::text IN ('2','3','6')
 AND NULLIF(btrim(q.createdon::text),'')::timestamp<=NOW()
), quote_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT d.new_quoteapplydetailid::text AS fact_id,d.new_opportunity_id,
 d.new_product_id,d.new_model::text AS cell_model,NULLIF(btrim(d.new_productpower::text),'')::numeric AS energy_kwh,
 h.quote_id,h.oa_no,h.approval,h.quote_created,h.submitted_at,h.approved_at,h.quote_owner
 FROM __x360_gov_source_6 d
 JOIN quote_headers h ON h.quote_id=d.new_quoteapply_id

), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT o.opportunityid,o.new_opportunitystatus::text AS opportunity_status,
 o.new_approvalstatus::text AS opportunity_approval,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
 WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
 WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.ownerid,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,o.parentaccountid
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o
 WHERE o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM quote_candidates d WHERE d.new_opportunity_id=o.opportunityid)
), linked_pick AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.new_opportunity_id) d.new_opportunity_id,d.quote_id
 FROM quote_candidates d JOIN opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 WHERE o.opportunity_status='0' AND o.opportunity_approval='1'
 ORDER BY d.new_opportunity_id,d.quote_created DESC,d.quote_id DESC
), selected_details AS (
 SELECT d.* FROM quote_candidates d
 WHERE d.new_opportunity_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM linked_pick p WHERE p.new_opportunity_id=d.new_opportunity_id AND p.quote_id=d.quote_id)
), dimensioned AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT d.fact_id,d.quote_id,d.oa_no,d.new_product_id,d.cell_model,d.energy_kwh,d.approval,
 CASE WHEN d.approval='3' THEN d.approved_at ELSE d.submitted_at END AS fact_date,
 d.submitted_at,d.approved_at,o.d002,o.d003,COALESCE(o.ownerid,d.quote_owner)::text AS owner_id,
 o.d005,NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS d006
 FROM selected_details d LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a ON a.accountid=o.parentaccountid
), filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.* FROM dimensioned f
 WHERE (f.fact_date<=NOW() OR f.fact_date IS NULL)
 AND ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR f.fact_date IS NULL
 OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)))
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND (t."name"::text IN (:team_ids) OR t."teamid"::text IN (:team_ids))) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND (f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) OR
 (CASE f.d005 WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' ELSE f.d005 END) IN (:customer_levels)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND (f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) OR EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" af
 WHERE af.accountid::text IN (:customer_ids) AND NULLIF(btrim(af.name::text),'')=f.d006)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
), oa_quote_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(s.fdid::text),'') AS oa_no,
  NULLIF(btrim(s.material_code::text),'') AS material_code,
  NULLIF(btrim(s.spec_model::text),'') AS spec_model,
  NULLIF(btrim(s.quote_range::text),'') AS quote_range
 FROM ded_public.p_fm_energy_storage_quotation s
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM filtered f
  WHERE f.oa_no=NULLIF(btrim(s.fdid::text),''))
), oa_quote_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT oa_no,COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
  BOOL_OR(quote_range='红区') AS has_red,
  BOOL_AND(quote_range IS NOT NULL AND quote_range IN ('红区','黄区','绿区')) AS ranges_complete
 FROM oa_quote_rows GROUP BY oa_no
), required_product_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(f.new_product_id::text),'') AS match_key FROM filtered f
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(f.new_product_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT s.material_code FROM oa_quote_rows s WHERE s.material_code IS NOT NULL
), product_versions AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT p.productid::text AS product_id,
  NULLIF(btrim(p.productnumber::text),'') AS product_code,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.new_eveproductmodel::text),''),
           NULLIF(btrim(p.new_pro_model::text),'')) AS product_model,
  NULLIF(btrim(p.name::text),'') AS product_name
 FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb p
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (p.productid::text),(p.productnumber::text)) k(match_key)
 JOIN required_product_keys r ON r.match_key=k.match_key
), product_lookup AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT k.match_key,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_id)=1 THEN MIN(product_id) END AS product_id,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_model)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(product_model)
       THEN MIN(product_model) END AS product_model,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_name)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(product_name)
       THEN MIN(product_name) END AS product_name
 FROM product_versions p
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT DISTINCT v AS match_key
   FROM (VALUES (NULLIF(btrim(p.product_id),'')),(p.product_code)) x(v)
   WHERE v IS NOT NULL) k
 GROUP BY k.match_key
), oa_material_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.oa_no,s.material_code,p.product_id,
  COALESCE(s.spec_model,p.product_model,p.product_name) AS model_value
 FROM oa_quote_rows s LEFT JOIN product_lookup p ON p.match_key=s.material_code
), fact_material_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT f.fact_id,f.quote_id,f.new_product_id,
  s.material_code AS source_material,
  NULLIF(upper(btrim(s.model_value)),'') AS source_model,
  NULLIF(upper(btrim(COALESCE(p.product_model,f.cell_model,p.product_name))),'') AS fallback_model
 FROM filtered f
 LEFT JOIN product_lookup p ON p.match_key=NULLIF(btrim(f.new_product_id::text),'')
 LEFT JOIN oa_material_rows s ON s.oa_no=f.oa_no AND
  (s.material_code=NULLIF(btrim(f.new_product_id::text),'')
   OR (p.product_id IS NOT NULL AND s.product_id=p.product_id))
), material_classification AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT fact_id,quote_id,new_product_id,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(source_material)>0 THEN
    CASE WHEN COUNT(source_material)=COUNT(source_model)
      AND COUNT(DISTINCT (source_model ~ '(^|[^A-Z0-9])(LF280K|MB3)([^A-Z0-9]|$)'))=1
     THEN BOOL_OR(source_model ~ '(^|[^A-Z0-9])(LF280K|MB3)([^A-Z0-9]|$)') END
   WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT fallback_model)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(fallback_model)
   THEN BOOL_OR(fallback_model ~ '(^|[^A-Z0-9])(LF280K|MB3)([^A-Z0-9]|$)') END AS target_cell
 FROM fact_material_matches GROUP BY fact_id,quote_id,new_product_id
), checked AS (
 SELECT f.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY f.fact_id) AS fact_copies,
  m.target_cell,
  COALESCE(s.source_rows,0) AS range_source_rows,
  COALESCE(s.has_red,FALSE) AS quote_has_red,
  COALESCE(s.ranges_complete,FALSE) AS quote_range_known
 FROM filtered f
 LEFT JOIN material_classification m
  ON m.fact_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.fact_id AND m.quote_id=f.quote_id
  AND m.new_product_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.new_product_id
 LEFT JOIN oa_quote_summary s ON s.oa_no=f.oa_no
), policy AS (
 SELECT max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key='D021_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
 max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key='D021_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL' AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled AND dimension_code='YWLN_D021'
), classified AS (
 SELECT f.*,
 CASE WHEN f.approval IN ('2','3') AND f.submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND f.submitted_at<=NOW()
 AND (f.approved_at IS NULL OR f.approved_at BETWEEN f.submitted_at AND NOW())
 AND p.cycle_target_days>=0 AND p.imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND p.cycle_target_days THEN
 CASE WHEN f.approved_at IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-f.submitted_at::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN f.approved_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-f.submitted_at::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN f.approved_at IS NULL THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN f.approved_at::date-f.submitted_at::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed' ELSE 'normal_completed' END END AS helmet_status
 FROM checked f CROSS JOIN policy p
), scoped AS (
 SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM classified f
 
 WHERE TRUE
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D021*/ AND f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D021*/
)
SELECT
 CASE
 WHEN BOOL_OR(
        f.fact_id IS NULL OR f.fact_copies>1 OR f.fact_date IS NULL
        OR (f.energy_kwh<>0 AND f.target_cell IS NULL)
      ) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_kwh IS NOT NULL)
 THEN NULL
 ELSE COALESCE(
        SUM(f.energy_kwh) FILTER(
          WHERE f.energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND f.target_cell IS TRUE
        ),0
      ) / NULLIF(
        SUM(f.energy_kwh) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_kwh IS NOT NULL),0
      )
 END AS "YWLN_M0131",
 (
 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.new_quoteapplyid)::numeric
 FROM ded_public.p_fm_energy_storage_quotation s
 JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb q
   ON NULLIF(BTRIM(s.fdid::text),'')=NULLIF(BTRIM(q.new_oaquoteid::text),'')
 CROSS JOIN bounds b
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (
   CASE WHEN q.new_approvalstatus::text='3' THEN NULLIF(btrim(q.new_approved_time::text),'')::timestamp
        ELSE NULLIF(btrim(q.new_oasubmitdate::text),'')::timestamp END
 )) dt(fact_date)
 WHERE BTRIM(s.quote_range::text)='红区'
   AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR
        (dt.fact_date>=b.start_at AND dt.fact_date<b.end_at))
 ) AS "YWLN_M0137"
FROM scoped f GROUP BY ()

) AS __x360_gov_result

WITH source_product_period AS (
WITH __helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v
),
__first_ship AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT i2.new_ord_salesorder_id AS new_salesorderid,MIN(s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp) AS shipped_at FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s2 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i2 ON i2.new_ord_shipment_id=s2.new_ord_shipmentid WHERE TRUE AND s2.statecode=0 AND s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(i2.new_ord_salesorder_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i2.new_ord_salesorder_id
),
requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.energy_kwh)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((f.energy_issue),FALSE) OR (f.energy_kwh) IS NULL) AS invalid,(FALSE) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.helmet_status AS helmet_status FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text,'MISSING_LINE:'||s.new_ord_shipmentid::text) AS fact_id,
 s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS fact_date,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 COALESCE(o.ownerid,s.ownerid)::text AS owner_id,c.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_s.name::text),'') AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN ((so.statecode=0 AND NOT (so.statecode=2 OR COALESCE((so.new_changetype::text='4' AND so.new_changestatus::text='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)
 OR COALESCE(so.salesorderid IN (SELECT cx.new_salesorderid FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" cx
        WHERE TRUE AND cx.salesorderid<>cx.new_salesorderid
          AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)))) AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL OR (first_ship.shipped_at>=so.new_approval_time::timestamp AND first_ship.shipped_at<=NOW())) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM __helmet_cfg p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D024') AS helmet_status,
 i.new_qty*pr.new_system_energy AS energy_kwh,i.new_amount::numeric AS amount_yuan,
 (i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NULL) AS source_issue,
 (pr.new_system_energy IS NULL OR pr.new_system_energy<=0) AS energy_issue
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_s ON acc_s.accountid = s.new_account_id
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i ON i.new_ord_shipment_id=s.new_ord_shipmentid AND i.new_qty>0
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" pr ON pr.productnumber=i.new_productcode AND pr.new_system_energy>0
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so ON so.salesorderid = i.new_ord_salesorder_id
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=(SELECT MIN(d.new_opportunity_id) FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" d WHERE d.salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id)=1)
 LEFT JOIN __first_ship first_ship ON first_ship.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid

 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" c ON c.accountid=s.new_account_id
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=NOW()
) f WHERE TRUE
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_LEVEL_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d005::text IN (:customer_levels) OR (CASE f.d005::text WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' WHEN '战略大客户' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '重要大客户' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '一般客户' THEN '一般客户' WHEN 'BG大客户' THEN 'BG大客户' END) IN (:customer_levels)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_NAME_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d006::text IN (:customer_ids) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" customer_filter WHERE customer_filter.accountid::text=f.d006::text AND NULLIF(btrim(customer_filter.name::text),'') IN (:customer_ids))) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D024*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D024*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:shipment_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT f.d003 AS "D003", f.period_key AS "YWLN_D044", (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scoped x WHERE x.measure_tag='m0' AND x.poison_time AND x.d003 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.d003 AND to_char(x.fact_date,'YYYY-MM') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.period_key) OR COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0006" FROM (SELECT s.*, to_char(s.fact_date,'YYYY-MM') AS period_key FROM scoped s) f GROUP BY f.d003, f.period_key
)
SELECT source_product_period."YWLN_D044",
 CASE WHEN BOOL_OR(source_product_period."YWLN_M0006" IS NULL) THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(source_product_period."YWLN_M0006") END AS "YWLN_M0006"
FROM source_product_period
GROUP BY source_product_period."YWLN_D044"

WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH requested AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      start_at,
      end_at
    FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
  ), bounds AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
      MAX(end_at) AS end_at
    FROM requested
  ), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(accountid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
  ), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(teamid AS TEXT),
      CAST(name AS TEXT) AS team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
  ), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      t.team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
    JOIN __teams AS t
      ON t.teamid = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
    FROM __owner_team_candidates
    GROUP BY
      owner_id
  ), __remaining_opportunity_source AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunityid,
      ownerid,
      new_salesbg,
      new_accproducttype,
      new_accountlevel,
      parentaccountid,
      new_cellcapacity,
      new_cell_qty
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"
  ), __opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(opportunityid AS TEXT),
      CAST(ownerid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      CAST(parentaccountid AS TEXT)
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source
  ), __shipment_items AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
      CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CAST(s.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT)), ''),

      ) AS order_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" AS i
    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" AS s

    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b

      i.new_qty > 0

      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
          AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
        )
      )
  ), __selected_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT

  ), __direct_order_links AS MATERIALIZED (

    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      opportunity_id
    FROM __direct_order_links
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT),
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '')
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __direct_order_links AS d
        WHERE
          d.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __order_dimension_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      link.order_id,
      link.opportunity_id,
      o.ownerid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      teams.team_name
    FROM __order_links AS link
    LEFT JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_candidates AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), __order_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ownerid) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(ownerid)
        THEN MIN(ownerid)
      END AS owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d002) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d002) THEN MIN(d002) END AS d002,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d003) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d003) THEN MIN(d003) END AS d003,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_name)
        THEN MIN(team_name)
      END AS team_name
    FROM __order_dimension_candidates
    GROUP BY
      order_id
  ), __product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.new_system_energy) = 1
        THEN MIN(CAST(p.new_system_energy AS DECIMAL))
      END AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS p
    WHERE
      p.new_system_energy > 0
      AND EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __shipment_items AS i
        WHERE
          i.product_code = CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
      )
    GROUP BY
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
  ), __actual_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      i.fact_id,
      i.fact_date,
      i.qty * p.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      (
        i.fact_id IS NULL OR p.energy_kwh IS NULL
      ) AS invalid,
      d.d002,
      d.d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      d.team_name AS d004
    FROM __shipment_items AS i
    JOIN __product_energy AS p
      ON p.product_code = i.product_code
    LEFT JOIN __order_dimensions AS d
      ON d.order_id = i.order_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = i.account_id
  ), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
        t.new_year,
        CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
        CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
        CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
        t.new_month1_power,
        t.new_month2_power,
        t.new_month3_power,
        t.new_month4_power,
        t.new_month5_power,
        t.new_month6_power,
        t.new_month7_power,
        t.new_month8_power,
        t.new_month9_power,
        t.new_month10_power,
        t.new_month11_power,
        t.new_month12_power,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
          ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR t.new_year BETWEEN CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT) AND CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.end_at - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND') AS INT)
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.rn = 1
  ), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  ), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      t.target_id || ':' || CAST(v.month_no AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
        THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
      END AS fact_date,
      CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      FALSE AS invalid,
      t.d002,
      COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
            THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
          END
        FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
        WHERE
          CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
      ) AS d004
    FROM __target_latest AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1_power),
        (2, t.new_month2_power),
        (3, t.new_month3_power),
        (4, t.new_month4_power),
        (5, t.new_month5_power),
        (6, t.new_month6_power),
        (7, t.new_month7_power),
        (8, t.new_month8_power),
        (9, t.new_month9_power),
        (10, t.new_month10_power),
        (11, t.new_month11_power),
        (12, t.new_month12_power)
    ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
      ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = t.account_id
    WHERE
      t.target_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END >= b.start_at
          AND CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END < b.end_at
        )
      )
  ), __forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.fact_id,
      ranked.opportunity_id,
      ranked.fact_date,
      ranked.qty,
      ranked.energy_kwh
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
        CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
        CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST(m.new_shipforecast_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
        CAST(m.new_singlepower AS DECIMAL) AS energy_kwh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
          ORDER BY CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __remaining_month_latest_rn
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb" AS m
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          b.start_at IS NULL
          OR (
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
          )
        )
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__remaining_month_latest_rn = 1 AND ranked.fact_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
      END AS product_type,
      CAST(o.new_cellcapacity AS DECIMAL) AS cell_energy_kwh,
      CAST(o.new_cell_qty AS DECIMAL) AS cells_per_set
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source AS o
    WHERE
      EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __forecast_rows AS f
        WHERE
          f.opportunity_id = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_type) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(product_type)
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT cell_energy_kwh) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cell_energy_kwh)
        AND MIN(cell_energy_kwh) > 0
        THEN CASE
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = '电芯'
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = 'PACK'
          AND COUNT(DISTINCT cells_per_set) = 1
          AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cells_per_set)
          AND MIN(cells_per_set) > 0
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh) * MIN(cells_per_set)
        END
      END AS alternative_unit_kwh
    FROM __remaining_opp_energy_values
    GROUP BY
      opportunity_id
  ), __remaining_converted AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      f.fact_id,
      f.opportunity_id,
      f.fact_date,
      f.qty,
      CASE WHEN f.energy_kwh > 0 THEN f.energy_kwh ELSE e.alternative_unit_kwh END AS unit_kwh
    FROM __forecast_rows AS f
    LEFT JOIN __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS e
      ON e.opportunity_id = f.opportunity_id
  ), __forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('FORECAST' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      f.fact_id,
      f.fact_date,
      CASE
        WHEN f.qty = 0
        THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
        WHEN f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh > 0
        THEN f.qty * f.unit_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL)
      END AS value_gwh,
      (
        f.qty IS NULL OR f.qty < 0 OR (
          f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh IS NULL
        )
      ) AS invalid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      teams.team_name AS d004
    FROM __remaining_converted AS f
    JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = f.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = o.parentaccountid
    LEFT JOIN __owner_teams AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __actual_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __target_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __forecast_facts
  ), checked AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
    FROM facts AS f
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
    FROM checked AS f
    WHERE
      f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND f.d004 IN (:team_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND (
        f.d005 IN (:customer_levels)
        OR (
          CASE f.d005
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            ELSE f.d005
          END
        ) IN (:customer_levels)
      ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
  ), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      f.month_key AS "YWLN_D044",
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(
          BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.copies > 1 OR f.fact_id IS NULL) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL'),
          FALSE
        )
        THEN NULL
        ELSE SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
      END AS actual_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'FORECAST'
        AND f.fact_id IS NOT NULL
        AND f.copies = 1
        AND NOT COALESCE(f.invalid, TRUE)) AS remaining_gwh
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY
      f.month_key
  )
  SELECT
    a."YWLN_D044" AS "YWLN_D044",
    a.actual_gwh AS "YWLN_M0006",
    a.target_gwh AS "YWLN_M0007",
    a.actual_gwh / NULLIF(a.target_gwh, 0) AS "YWLN_M0008",
    a.actual_gwh + COALESCE(a.remaining_gwh, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)) AS "YWLN_M0011"
  FROM aggregated AS a
) AS __x360_period_result

WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __signed_order_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      sx.opportunityid || ''
    ) AS opportunityid,
    (
      sx.salesorderid || ''
    ) AS salesorderid,
    (
      sx.new_salesorderid || ''
    ) AS new_salesorderid,
    sx.statecode,
    sx.new_changetype,
    sx.new_changestatus,
    sx.new_approval_time
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS sx
), __signed_keys_0 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunityid
  FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113
), requested AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM requested
), measure_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
    CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
    CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
    CAST((
      f.amount_yuan
    ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
    (
      COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE)
      OR COALESCE((
        FALSE
      ), FALSE)
      OR (
        f.amount_yuan
      ) IS NULL
    ) AS invalid,
    (
      FALSE
    ) AS poison_time,
    f.d002,
    f.d003,
    f.owner_id,
    f.d005,
    f.d006,
    f.status_code,
    TO_JSONB(f) ->> 'helmet_status' AS helmet_status
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
        THEN NULL
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      (
        SELECT
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '')
        FROM __ont_accounts AS a
        WHERE
          CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT)
      ) AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(o.opportunityid IN (
          SELECT
            opportunityid
          FROM __signed_keys_0
        ), FALSE)
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS status_code,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN (
              TRUE
            )
            AND CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            AND (
              CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR (
                CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP)
                AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              )
            )
            AND p.enabled
            AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
            THEN CASE
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE)
              ) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
              THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE)
              ) > p.imminent_days
              THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS DATE) - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_completed'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS DATE) - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) <= p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'normal_completed'
            END
          END
        FROM (
          SELECT
            dimension_code,
            cycle_target_days,
            imminent_days,
            (
              cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
              AND cycle_target_days >= 0
              AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL
              AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days
            ) AS enabled
          FROM (
            SELECT
              dimension_code,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
            FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
            WHERE
              config_set = 'MOCK'
              AND period_key = 'GLOBAL'
              AND config_group = 'HELMET'
              AND enabled
            GROUP BY
              dimension_code
          ) AS v
        ) AS p
        WHERE
          p.dimension_code = 'YWLN_D020'
      ) AS helmet_status,
      (
        CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
        OR CAST(o.new_risklevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
      ) AS is_key,
      CAST((
        m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000
      ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
      m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan,
      TRUE AS amount_period_valid,
      FALSE AS source_issue
    FROM __ont_forecast AS m
    JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
  ) AS f
  WHERE
    f.status_code = 'signed_opportunity' AND TRUE AND f.amount_yuan IS NOT NULL
), checked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
  FROM measure_rows
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
  FROM checked AS f
  WHERE
    (
      (
        SELECT
          start_at
        FROM bounds
      ) IS NULL
      OR (
        f.fact_date >= (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM bounds
        )
        AND f.fact_date < (
          SELECT
            end_at
          FROM bounds
        )
      )
      OR f.poison_time
    )
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND  f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND  f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND  EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
      JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
        ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
      WHERE
        CAST(tm."systemuserid" AS TEXT) = f.owner_id
        AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) IN (:team_ids)
    ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND  f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND  f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/ AND  f.status_code IN (:sign_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D020*/ AND  f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D020*/
)
SELECT

  (
    SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
      f.measure_tag = 'm0')

  f.d003

), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (

  GROUP BY

), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __customer_target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      original.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), original.new_year
        ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __customer_target_rn
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    ranked.__customer_target_rn = 1
)
SELECT
  customer_target_result.*
FROM (
  WITH source_rows AS (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY new_targetid) AS id_count
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_rank.*
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __x360_base.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY COALESCE(
              NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
              CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
            ), __x360_base.new_year
            ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS version_rn
        FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
      ) AS __x360_rank
      WHERE
        __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
    ) AS t
    WHERE
      TRUE
  ), monthly AS (
    SELECT
      t.new_targetid,
      t.id_count,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999 AND t.new_year <> 0
        THEN MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1)
      END AS target_month,
      v.amount_yuan
    FROM source_rows AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1),
        (2, t.new_month2),
        (3, t.new_month3),
        (4, t.new_month4),
        (5, t.new_month5),
        (6, t.new_month6),
        (7, t.new_month7),
        (8, t.new_month8),
        (9, t.new_month9),
        (10, t.new_month10),
        (11, t.new_month11),
        (12, t.new_month12)
    ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan)
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM monthly
    WHERE
      target_month IS NOT NULL
      /*TIME_BEGIN*/ AND target_month >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP)))
      AND target_month < CASE
        WHEN CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP)) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
      END
  
/*TIME_END*/
)
  SELECT
    SUM(amount_yuan) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0002"
  FROM scoped
) AS customer_target_result

WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
