WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __signed_order_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      sx.opportunityid || ''
    ) AS opportunityid,
    (
      sx.salesorderid || ''
    ) AS salesorderid,
    (
      sx.new_salesorderid || ''
    ) AS new_salesorderid,
    sx.statecode,
    sx.new_changetype,
    sx.new_changestatus,
    sx.new_approval_time
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS sx
), __signed_keys_0 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunityid
  FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113
), requested AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM requested
), measure_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
    CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
    CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
    CAST((
      f.amount_yuan
    ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
    (
      COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE)
      OR COALESCE((
        FALSE
      ), FALSE)
      OR (
        f.amount_yuan
      ) IS NULL
    ) AS invalid,
    (
      FALSE
    ) AS poison_time,
    f.d002,
    f.d003,
    f.owner_id,
    f.d005,
    f.d006,
    f.status_code,
    TO_JSONB(f) ->> 'helmet_status' AS helmet_status
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
        THEN NULL
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      (
        SELECT
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '')
        FROM __ont_accounts AS a
        WHERE
          CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT)
      ) AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(o.opportunityid IN (
          SELECT
            opportunityid
          FROM __signed_keys_0
        ), FALSE)
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS status_code,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN (
              TRUE
            )
            AND CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            AND (
              CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR (
                CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP)
                AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              )
            )
            AND p.enabled
            AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
            THEN CASE
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE)
              ) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
              THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE)
              ) > p.imminent_days
              THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS DATE) - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_completed'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS DATE) - CAST(o.createdon AS DATE) <= p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'normal_completed'
            END
          END
        FROM (
          SELECT
            dimension_code,
            cycle_target_days,
            imminent_days,
            (
              cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
              AND cycle_target_days >= 0
              AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL
              AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days
            ) AS enabled
          FROM (
            SELECT
              dimension_code,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
            FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
            WHERE
              config_set = 'MOCK'
              AND period_key = 'GLOBAL'
              AND config_group = 'HELMET'
              AND enabled
            GROUP BY
              dimension_code
          ) AS v
        ) AS p
        WHERE
          p.dimension_code = 'YWLN_D020'
      ) AS helmet_status,
      (
        CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
        OR CAST(o.new_risklevel AS TEXT) IN ('1', '2')
      ) AS is_key,
      CAST((
        m.new_forecast_amt_rmb / NULLIF(m.new_whprice, 0) / 1000000
      ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_mwh,
      m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan,
      TRUE AS amount_period_valid,
      FALSE AS source_issue
    FROM __ont_forecast AS m
    JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
  ) AS f
  WHERE
    f.status_code = 'signed_opportunity' AND TRUE AND f.amount_yuan IS NOT NULL
), checked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
  FROM measure_rows
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
  FROM checked AS f
  WHERE
    (
      (
        SELECT
          start_at
        FROM bounds
      ) IS NULL
      OR (
        f.fact_date >= (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM bounds
        )
        AND f.fact_date < (
          SELECT
            end_at
          FROM bounds
        )
      )
      OR f.poison_time
    )
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND  f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND  f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND  EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
      JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
        ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
      WHERE
        CAST(tm."systemuserid" AS TEXT) = f.owner_id
        AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) IN (:team_ids)
    ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND  f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND  f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/ AND  f.status_code IN (:sign_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D020*/ AND  f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D020*/
)
SELECT
  f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005",
  (
    SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
      f.measure_tag = 'm0')
  ) AS "YWLN_M0198"
FROM scoped AS f
GROUP BY
  f.d005

WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  customer_rows.*
FROM (
  WITH __customer_target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        original.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
            CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
          ), original.new_year
          ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __customer_target_rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__customer_target_rn = 1
  )
  SELECT
    customer_target_result.*
  FROM (
    WITH __x360_gov_source_1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw."project_name",
        __x360_raw."input_time",
        __x360_raw."energy_mwh",
        __x360_raw."winner_announce_time",
        __x360_raw."remark",
        __x360_raw."seq_no" AS "bid_record_id"
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_bid_project_info" AS __x360_raw
    ), __x360_gov_source_7 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw."new_targetid",
        __x360_raw."ownerid",
        __x360_raw."owneridname",
        __x360_raw."statecode",
        __x360_raw."new_account_id",
        __x360_raw."new_marketing_center",
        __x360_raw."new_opportunity_id",
        __x360_raw."new_year",
        __x360_raw."new_month1_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month10_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month11_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month12_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month2_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month3_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month4_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month5_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month6_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month7_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month8_power",
        __x360_raw."new_month9_power",
        __x360_raw."new_target_type",
        __x360_raw."new_product_id",
        CAST(__x360_product_type."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) AS "new_accproducttype"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __x360_rank.*
        FROM (
          SELECT
            __x360_base.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY COALESCE(
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
                CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
              ), __x360_base.new_year
              ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
            ) AS version_rn
          FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
        ) AS __x360_rank
        WHERE
          __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
      ) AS __x360_raw
      LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS __x360_product_type
        ON __x360_product_type."new_product_typeid" = __x360_raw."new_producttype_id"
    )
    SELECT
      *
    FROM (
      WITH __request_period_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
          CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
        WHERE
          FALSE
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          start_at,
          end_at
        FROM __ont_bounds
      ), __monthly_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          (
            m.new_oppmonthid || ''
          ) AS new_oppmonthid,
          (
            m.new_opportunity_id || ''
          ) AS new_opportunity_id,
          CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_accountdate,
          m.__ont_energy_mwh,
          m.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
          m.new_whprice,
          m.new_year,
          m.new_month,
          m.statecode,
          m.new_approvalstatus
        FROM __ont_forecast AS m
        WHERE
          m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __request_period_once
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __request_period_once
              )
              AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM __request_period_once
              )
            )
          )
      ), __account_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          (
            a.accountid || ''
          ) AS accountid,
          (
            a.name || ''
          ) AS name,
          CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS new_accountlevel
        FROM __ont_accounts AS a
      ), __order_lines_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          (
            l.salesorderid || ''
          ) AS salesorderid,
          (
            l.salesorderdetailid || ''
          ) AS salesorderdetailid,
          l.quantity,
          l.new_changepostqty,
          l.new_dischargecapacity,
          l.new_effectivedate,
          l.new_expirydate,
          (
            l.quantity > 0
            AND l.new_changepostqty >= 0
            AND l.new_changepostqty < l.quantity
            AND (
              CAST(l.new_effectivedate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR CAST(l.new_effectivedate AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
            AND (
              CAST(l.new_expirydate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR CAST(l.new_expirydate AS TIMESTAMP) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
          ) AS is_change_line
        FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l
      ), __opportunity_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          (
            o.opportunityid || ''
          ) AS opportunityid,
          (
            o.parentaccountid || ''
          ) AS parentaccountid,
          (
            o.name || ''
          ) AS name,
          (
            o.new_opportunitystatus || ''
          ) AS new_opportunitystatus,
          (
            o.new_approvalstatus || ''
          ) AS new_approvalstatus,
          (
            o.owneridname || ''
          ) AS owneridname,
          (
            o.new_riskleveldescription || ''
          ) AS new_riskleveldescription,
          (
            o.new_salesbg || ''
          ) AS new_salesbg,
          (
            o.new_accproducttype || ''
          ) AS new_accproducttype,
          (
            o.ownerid || ''
          ) AS ownerid,
          (
            o.new_accountlevel || ''
          ) AS new_accountlevel,
          (
            o.new_risklevel || ''
          ) AS new_risklevel
        FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
        WHERE
          o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
      ), __order_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          (
            so.salesorderid || ''
          ) AS salesorderid,
          (
            so.new_salesorderid || ''
          ) AS new_salesorderid,
          (
            ord_line.new_opportunity_id || ''
          ) AS opportunityid,
          (
            so.customerid || ''
          ) AS customerid,
          (
            so.new_changetype || ''
          ) AS new_changetype,
          (
            so.new_changestatus || ''
          ) AS new_changestatus,
          so.createdon,
          (
            so.new_approval_time || ''
          ) AS new_approval_time,
          (
            so.new_ord_oa_state || ''
          ) AS new_ord_oa_state,
          (
            so.new_salesordertype || ''
          ) AS new_salesordertype,
          (
            so.new_order_category || ''
          ) AS new_order_category,
          so.statecode
        FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
        JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS ord_line
          ON ord_line.salesorderid = so.salesorderid
          AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(ord_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
      ), __cancel_changes_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          cx.new_salesorderid AS salesorderid
        FROM __order_source_once AS cx
        WHERE
          cx.salesorderid <> cx.new_salesorderid
      ), __order_flags_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          sx.*,
          COALESCE(
            sx.salesorderid IN (
              SELECT
                salesorderid
              FROM __cancel_changes_once
            ),
            FALSE
          ) AS has_cancel_change,
          (
            sx.new_changetype = '4' AND sx.new_changestatus = '8'
          ) AS own_cancel
        FROM __order_source_once AS sx
        WHERE
          sx.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
      ), __order_change_ids_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          sx.salesorderid
        FROM __order_flags_once AS sx
        WHERE
          NOT COALESCE(sx.statecode = 2 OR sx.own_cancel OR sx.has_cancel_change, FALSE)
          AND sx.salesorderid IN (
            SELECT
              l.salesorderid
            FROM __order_lines_once AS l
            WHERE
              l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL AND l.is_change_line
          )
      ), __opportunity_signed_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          sx.opportunityid,
          BOOL_OR(
            COALESCE(sx.statecode, 0) <> 2 AND NOT sx.own_cancel AND NOT sx.has_cancel_change
          ) AS broad_signed,
          BOOL_OR(
            NOT (
              sx.statecode = 2 OR COALESCE(sx.own_cancel, FALSE) OR sx.has_cancel_change
            )
          ) AS formal_signed
        FROM __order_flags_once AS sx
        WHERE
          TRUE
        GROUP BY
          sx.opportunityid
      ), __candidate_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          a.accountid,
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name,
          CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level
        FROM __account_source_once AS a
        WHERE
          a.accountid IS NOT NULL
          AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
          /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
          /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND (
            CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) IN (:customer_ids)
            OR NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '') IN (:customer_ids)
          ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
      ), __customer_current_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          o.parentaccountid,
          o.name
        FROM __opportunity_source_once AS o
        JOIN __candidate_customers AS c
          ON c.accountid = o.parentaccountid
        WHERE
          o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
      ), /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_IS_BIDDING*/ __customer_current_bid_projects AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          project_name,
          remark,
          winner_announce_time
        FROM (
          SELECT
            b.project_name,
            b.remark,
            b.winner_announce_time,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY b.project_name

                            ELSE f.fact_date < (
                              SELECT
                                end_at
                              FROM bounds
                            )
                          END
                        )
                        OR f.poison_time
                      )
                      AND (
                        NOT EXISTS(
                          SELECT
                            1
                          FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                          WHERE
                            value IS NOT NULL
                        )
                        OR (
                          f.d005 IN (
                            SELECT
                              value
                            FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
                          )
                        )
                      )
                      AND (
                        NOT EXISTS(
                          SELECT
                            1
                          FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                          WHERE
                            value IS NOT NULL
                        )
                        OR (
                          f.d006 IN (
                            SELECT
                              value
                            FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
                          )
                        )
                      )
                  )
                  SELECT
                    f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005",
                    f.d006 AS "YWLN_D006",
                    (
                      SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
                        f.measure_tag = 'm0')
                    ) AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
                    (
                      SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
                        f.measure_tag = 'm1')
                    ) AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
                  FROM scoped AS f
                  GROUP BY
                    f.d005,
                    f.d006
                ), __customer_gap_keys AS (
                  SELECT
                    "YWLN_D005",
                    "YWLN_D006"
                  FROM customer_signed
                  UNION
                  SELECT
                    "YWLN_D005",
                    "YWLN_D006"
                  FROM customer_unsigned
                  UNION
                  SELECT
                    "YWLN_D005",
                    "YWLN_D006"
                  FROM customer_energy
                )
                SELECT
                  CASE k."YWLN_D005"
                    WHEN '0'
                    THEN '核心大客户'
                    WHEN '1'
                    THEN '战略大客户'
                    WHEN '2'
                    THEN '重要大客户'
                    WHEN '3'
                    THEN '一般客户'
                    WHEN '4'
                    THEN 'BG大客户'
                    WHEN '战略大客户'
                    THEN '战略大客户'
                    WHEN '重要大客户'
                    THEN '重要大客户'
                    WHEN '一般客户'
                    THEN '一般客户'
                    WHEN 'BG大客户'
                    THEN 'BG大客户'
                    ELSE k."YWLN_D005"
                  END AS "YWLN_D005",
                  k."YWLN_D006",
                  ARRAY_REMOVE(
                    ARRAY[
                      CASE
                        WHEN customer_signed."YWLN_D006" IS NOT NULL
                        THEN CAST('signed_opportunity' AS TEXT)
                      END,
                      CASE
                        WHEN customer_unsigned."YWLN_D006" IS NOT NULL
                        THEN CAST('unsigned_opportunity' AS TEXT)
                      END
                    ],
                    NULL
                  ) AS __customer_sign_statuses,
                  customer_signed."YWLN_M0194",
                  customer_unsigned."YWLN_M0195",
                  (
                    customer_energy."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" - customer_energy."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY"
                  ) AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ENERGY_GAP",
                  CASE
                    WHEN customer_signed."YWLN_M0194" IS NULL AND customer_unsigned."YWLN_M0195" IS NULL
                    THEN NULL
                    ELSE COALESCE(customer_signed."YWLN_M0194", 0) + COALESCE(customer_unsigned."YWLN_M0195", 0)
                  END AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_GAP",
                  customer_energy."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY" AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
                  customer_energy."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
                FROM __customer_gap_keys AS k
                LEFT JOIN customer_signed
                  ON ARRAY[customer_signed."YWLN_D005", customer_signed."YWLN_D006"] = ARRAY[k."YWLN_D005", k."YWLN_D006"]
                LEFT JOIN customer_unsigned
                  ON ARRAY[customer_unsigned."YWLN_D005", customer_unsigned."YWLN_D006"] = ARRAY[k."YWLN_D005", k."YWLN_D006"]
                LEFT JOIN customer_energy
                  ON ARRAY[customer_energy."YWLN_D005", customer_energy."YWLN_D006"] = ARRAY[k."YWLN_D005", k."YWLN_D006"]
              ), customer_orders AS (
                WITH order_customer_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
                  SELECT
                    so.*,
                    c.customer_name
                  FROM __order_flags_once AS so
                  FULL JOIN __selected_customers AS c
                    ON c.accountid = so.customerid
                ), order_distinct AS (
                  SELECT DISTINCT
                    so.salesorderid AS fact_id,
                    CAST(so.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
                    CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
                    CASE
                      WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
                      THEN NULL
                      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
                      THEN '其他'
                      WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('1', '电芯')
                      THEN '电芯'
                      WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('2', 'PACK')
                      THEN 'PACK'
                      ELSE '其他'
                    END AS d003,
                    o.ownerid AS owner_id,
                    CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
                    so.customer_name AS d006,
                    CASE
                      WHEN so.statecode = 2 OR so.own_cancel OR so.has_cancel_change
                      THEN 'order_cancel'
                      WHEN TRUE
                      AND so.salesorderid IN (
                        SELECT
                          salesorderid
                        FROM __order_change_ids_once
                      )
                      THEN 'order_change'
                      WHEN TRUE
                      THEN 'normal_order'
                    END AS status_code
                  FROM order_customer_bridge AS so
                  LEFT JOIN __opportunity_source_once AS o
                    ON o.opportunityid = so.opportunityid
                  WHERE
                    so.customer_name IS NOT NULL AND so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
                ), orders AS (
                  SELECT
                    *,
                    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS copies
                  FROM order_distinct
                ), customer_order_line_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
                  SELECT
                    r.*,
                    l.salesorderdetailid,
                    l.quantity,
                    l.new_changepostqty,
                    l.new_dischargecapacity,
                    l.new_effectivedate,
                    l.new_expirydate,
                    l.is_change_line
                  FROM orders AS r
                  FULL JOIN __order_lines_once AS l
                    ON l.salesorderid = r.fact_id
                ), fact_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
                  SELECT DISTINCT
                    COALESCE(r.salesorderdetailid, 'MISSING_LINE:' || r.fact_id) AS fact_id,
                    r.fact_date,
                    r.status_code,
                    r.d002,
                    r.d003,
                    r.owner_id,
                    r.d005,
                    r.d006,
                    CASE
                      WHEN r.status_code = 'order_change' AND r.is_change_line
                      THEN r.new_dischargecapacity * r.new_changepostqty / NULLIF(r.quantity, 0)
                      ELSE r.new_dischargecapacity
                    END AS metric_value,
                    r.copies AS source_copies
                  FROM customer_order_line_bridge AS r
                  WHERE
                    r.fact_id IS NOT NULL
                    AND r.status_code IN ('normal_order', 'order_change')
                    AND COALESCE(
                      r.fact_id IN (
                        SELECT
                          salesorderid
                        FROM __order_flags_once
                        WHERE
                          TRUE
                      ),
                      FALSE
                    )
                    AND (
                      CAST(r.new_effectivedate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
                      OR CAST(r.new_effectivedate AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    )
                    AND (
                      CAST(r.new_expirydate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
                      OR CAST(r.new_expirydate AS TIMESTAMP) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    )
                ), metric_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
                  SELECT
                    *,
                    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS metric_copies
                  FROM fact_distinct
                  WHERE
                    fact_date IS NOT NULL AND fact_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                ), scoped AS (
                  SELECT
                    f.*,
                    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
                  FROM metric_facts AS f
                  WHERE
                    1 = 1
                    AND (
                      (
                        SELECT
                          start_at
                        FROM __customer_period
                      ) IS NULL
                      OR (
                        f.fact_date >= CAST((
                          SELECT
                            start_at
                          FROM __customer_period
                        ) AS TIMESTAMP)
                        AND f.fact_date < CAST((
                          SELECT
                            end_at
                          FROM __customer_period
                        ) AS TIMESTAMP)
                      )
                    )
                    AND (
                      NOT EXISTS(
                        SELECT
                          1
                        FROM __customer_ywln_d005
                        WHERE
                          value IS NOT NULL
                      )
                      OR (
                        f.d005 IN (
                          SELECT
                            value
                          FROM __customer_ywln_d005
                        )
                      )
                    )
                    AND (
                      NOT EXISTS(
                        SELECT
                          1
                        FROM __customer_ywln_d006
                        WHERE
                          value IS NOT NULL
                      )
                      OR (
                        f.d006 IN (
                          SELECT
                            value
                          FROM __customer_ywln_d006
                        )
                      )
                    )
                )
                SELECT
                  f.d005 AS "YWLN_D005",
                  f.d006 AS "YWLN_D006",
                  SUM(f.metric_value) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0032"
                FROM scoped AS f
                GROUP BY
                  f.d005,
                  f.d006
              ), customer_keys AS (
                SELECT
                  "YWLN_D005",
                  "YWLN_D006"
                FROM customer_base
                UNION
                SELECT
                  "YWLN_D005",
                  "YWLN_D006"
                FROM customer_orders
              )
              SELECT
                k."YWLN_D006",
                k."YWLN_D005",
                b.__customer_sign_statuses,
                b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
                b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY",
                b."YWLN_M0194",
                b."YWLN_M0195",
                b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_GAP",
                b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ENERGY_GAP",
                CASE WHEN o."YWLN_D006" IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL) ELSE o."YWLN_M0032" END AS "YWLN_M0032",
                CASE
                  WHEN b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" IS NULL
                  OR (
                    o."YWLN_D006" IS NOT NULL AND o."YWLN_M0032" IS NULL
                  )
                  THEN NULL
                  ELSE b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" - COALESCE(o."YWLN_M0032", CAST(0 AS DECIMAL))
                END AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ORDER_GAP",
                CASE
                  WHEN b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" IS NULL
                  OR b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" = 0
                  OR b."YWLN_M0194" IS NULL
                  THEN NULL
                  ELSE b."YWLN_M0194" / b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
                END AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_SIGNED_COVERAGE",
                CASE
                  WHEN b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" IS NULL
                  OR b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" = 0
                  OR b."YWLN_M0195" IS NULL
                  THEN NULL
                  ELSE b."YWLN_M0195" / b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
                END AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_UNSIGNED_COVERAGE",
                CASE
                  WHEN b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" IS NULL
                  OR b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" = 0
                  OR b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_GAP" IS NULL
                  THEN NULL
                  ELSE b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_GAP" / b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
                END AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_COVERAGE"
              FROM customer_keys AS k
              LEFT JOIN customer_base AS b
                ON ARRAY[b."YWLN_D005", b."YWLN_D006"] = ARRAY[k."YWLN_D005", k."YWLN_D006"]
              LEFT JOIN customer_orders AS o
                ON ARRAY[o."YWLN_D005", o."YWLN_D006"] = ARRAY[k."YWLN_D005", k."YWLN_D006"]
            ), __customer_attribute_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
              SELECT DISTINCT
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name,
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.owneridname AS TEXT)), '') AS sales_owner,
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_riskleveldescription AS TEXT)), '') AS risk_description
              FROM __account_source_once AS a
              JOIN __selected_customers AS selected_customer
                ON selected_customer.accountid = a.accountid
              JOIN __opportunity_source_once AS o
                ON o.parentaccountid = a.accountid
              WHERE
                a.accountid IS NOT NULL
                AND o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
                AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
            ), __customer_attributes AS (
              SELECT
                customer_name,
                STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sales_owner, '、'
                ORDER BY
                  sales_owner) AS sales_owners,
                STRING_AGG(DISTINCT risk_description, '、'
                ORDER BY
                  risk_description) AS risk_descriptions
              FROM __customer_attribute_rows
              GROUP BY
                customer_name
            )
            SELECT
              b."YWLN_D006",
              b."YWLN_D005",
              b.__customer_sign_statuses,
              a.sales_owners AS "YWLN_D048",
              a.risk_descriptions AS "YWLN_D_PROJECT_RISK_DESC",
              b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
              b."YWLN_M0194",
              b."YWLN_M0195",
              b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ENERGY_GAP",
              b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_COVERAGE",
              b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_GAP",
              b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ORDER_GAP",
              b."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY",
              b."YWLN_M0032" AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ORDER_ENERGY"
            FROM __customer_metric_base AS b
            LEFT JOIN __customer_attributes AS a
              ON a.customer_name = b."YWLN_D006"
            WHERE
              TRUE
              /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D048*/ AND (
                a.sales_owners IN (:sales_owners)
                OR EXISTS(
                  SELECT
                    1
                  FROM __customer_attribute_rows AS r
                  WHERE
                    r.customer_name = b."YWLN_D006" AND r.sales_owner IN (:sales_owners)
                )
              )
              /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D048*/  /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_PROJECT_RISK_DESC*/ AND  (
                a.risk_descriptions IN (:risk_descriptions)
                OR EXISTS(
                  SELECT
                    1
                  FROM __customer_attribute_rows AS r
                  WHERE
                    r.customer_name = b."YWLN_D006" AND r.risk_description IN (:risk_descriptions)
                )
              )
          
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_PROJECT_RISK_DESC*/
)
          SELECT
            *
          FROM __filter_result
          WHERE
            TRUE
            /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/ AND __filter_result.__customer_sign_statuses && CAST(ARRAY[:sign_statuses] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/
        ) AS view_rows
      )
      SELECT
        c.customer_name AS "YWLN_D006",
        CASE c.customer_level
          WHEN '0'
          THEN '核心大客户'
          WHEN '1'
          THEN '战略大客户'
          WHEN '2'
          THEN '重要大客户'
          WHEN '3'
          THEN '一般客户'
          WHEN '4'
          THEN 'BG大客户'
          ELSE c.customer_level
        END AS "YWLN_D005",
        m."YWLN_D048",
        m."YWLN_D_PROJECT_RISK_DESC",
        m."YWLN_M0194",
        m."YWLN_M0195",
        (
          m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" - m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY"
        ) AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ENERGY_GAP",
        CASE
          WHEN m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" IS NULL
          OR m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE (
            COALESCE(m."YWLN_M0194", 0) + COALESCE(m."YWLN_M0195", 0)
          ) / m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY"
        END AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_COVERAGE",
        CASE
          WHEN m."YWLN_M0194" IS NULL AND m."YWLN_M0195" IS NULL
          THEN NULL
          ELSE COALESCE(m."YWLN_M0194", 0) + COALESCE(m."YWLN_M0195", 0)
        END AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_OPPORTUNITY_GAP",
        CASE
          WHEN m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" IS NULL
          THEN NULL
          ELSE m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" - COALESCE(m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ORDER_ENERGY", 0)
        END AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ORDER_GAP",
        m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY",
        m."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ORDER_ENERGY"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          customer_name,
          CAST(MIN(CASE WHEN customer_level ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(customer_level AS INT) END) AS TEXT) AS customer_level
        FROM __selected_customers
        GROUP BY
          customer_name
      ) AS c
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          "YWLN_D006",
          MIN("YWLN_D005") AS "YWLN_D005",
          MIN("YWLN_D048") AS "YWLN_D048",
          MIN("YWLN_D_PROJECT_RISK_DESC") AS "YWLN_D_PROJECT_RISK_DESC",
          SUM("YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY") AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ACTUAL_ENERGY",
          SUM("YWLN_M0194") AS "YWLN_M0194",
          SUM("YWLN_M0195") AS "YWLN_M0195",
          SUM("YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY") AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY",
          SUM("YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ORDER_ENERGY") AS "YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_ORDER_ENERGY"
        FROM __customer_metrics
        GROUP BY
          "YWLN_D006"
      ) AS m
        ON m."YWLN_D006" = c.customer_name
      WHERE
        TRUE
        AND (
          c.customer_level IN ('1', '2')
          OR (
            c.customer_level = '3'
            AND LOWER(TRIM(c.customer_name)) IN ('mebutec bv', 'alghaem general trading co. (l.l.c)')
          )
        )
        /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/ AND m."YWLN_D006" IS NOT NULL /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/
        /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D048*/ AND m."YWLN_D006" IS NOT NULL /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D048*/
        /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_PROJECT_RISK_DESC*/ AND m."YWLN_D006" IS NOT NULL /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_PROJECT_RISK_DESC*/
      ORDER BY
        CASE LOWER(TRIM(c.customer_name))
          WHEN 'mebutec bv'
          THEN 0
          WHEN 'alghaem general trading co. (l.l.c)'
          THEN 1
          ELSE 2
        END,
        c.customer_name
    ) AS __x360_gov_result
  ) AS customer_target_result
) AS customer_rows
WHERE
  customer_rows."YWLN_M_CUSTOMER_TARGET_ENERGY" IS NOT NULL
  OR customer_rows."YWLN_M0194" IS NOT NULL
  OR customer_rows."YWLN_M0195" IS NOT NULL

    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)

    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)

  WITH requested AS (

      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
      CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      start_at,
      end_at
    FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
  ), bounds AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
      MAX(end_at) AS end_at
    FROM requested
  ), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(accountid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
  ), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(teamid AS TEXT),
      CAST(name AS TEXT) AS team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
  ), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      t.team_name
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
    JOIN __teams AS t
      ON t.teamid = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
    FROM __owner_team_candidates
    GROUP BY
      owner_id
  ), __remaining_opportunity_source AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunityid,
      ownerid,
      new_salesbg,
      new_accproducttype,
      new_accountlevel,
      parentaccountid,
      new_cellcapacity,
      new_cell_qty
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"
  ), __opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(opportunityid AS TEXT),
      CAST(ownerid AS TEXT),
      CAST(new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      CAST(parentaccountid AS TEXT)
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source
  ), __shipment_items AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
      CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CAST(s.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT)), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(s.new_salesorderid AS TEXT)), '')
      ) AS order_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" AS i
    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" AS s
      ON s.new_ord_shipmentid = i.new_ord_shipment_id
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE
      i.new_qty > 0
      AND s.statecode = 0
      AND s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL
      AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
          AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
        )
      )
  ), __selected_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      order_id
    FROM __shipment_items
    WHERE
      order_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __direct_order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') AS opportunity_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      opportunity_id
    FROM __direct_order_links
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT),
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '')
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l
    JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
      ON requested.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __direct_order_links AS d
        WHERE
          d.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __order_dimension_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      link.order_id,
      link.opportunity_id,
      o.ownerid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      teams.team_name
    FROM __order_links AS link
    LEFT JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_candidates AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), __order_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ownerid) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(ownerid)
        THEN MIN(ownerid)
      END AS owner_id,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d002) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d002) THEN MIN(d002) END AS d002,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d003) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d003) THEN MIN(d003) END AS d003,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_name)
        THEN MIN(team_name)
      END AS team_name
    FROM __order_dimension_candidates
    GROUP BY
      order_id
  ), __product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.new_system_energy) = 1
        THEN MIN(CAST(p.new_system_energy AS DECIMAL))
      END AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS p
    WHERE
      p.new_system_energy > 0
      AND EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __shipment_items AS i
        WHERE
          i.product_code = CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
      )
    GROUP BY
      CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
  ), __actual_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      i.fact_id,
      i.fact_date,
      i.qty * p.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      (
        i.fact_id IS NULL OR p.energy_kwh IS NULL
      ) AS invalid,
      d.d002,
      d.d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      d.team_name AS d004
    FROM __shipment_items AS i
    JOIN __product_energy AS p
      ON p.product_code = i.product_code
    LEFT JOIN __order_dimensions AS d
      ON d.order_id = i.order_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = i.account_id
  ), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
        t.new_year,
        CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
        CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
        CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
        CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
        t.new_month1_power,
        t.new_month2_power,
        t.new_month3_power,
        t.new_month4_power,
        t.new_month5_power,
        t.new_month6_power,
        t.new_month7_power,
        t.new_month8_power,
        t.new_month9_power,
        t.new_month10_power,
        t.new_month11_power,
        t.new_month12_power,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
          ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        b.start_at IS NULL OR t.new_year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT)
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.rn = 1
  ), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  ), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      t.target_id || ':' || CAST(v.month_no AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
        THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
      END AS fact_date,
      CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
      FALSE AS invalid,
      t.d002,
      COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
      c.customer_level AS d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
            THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
          END
        FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
        WHERE
          CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
      ) AS d004
    FROM __target_latest AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1_power),
        (2, t.new_month2_power),
        (3, t.new_month3_power),
        (4, t.new_month4_power),
        (5, t.new_month5_power),
        (6, t.new_month6_power),
        (7, t.new_month7_power),
        (8, t.new_month8_power),
        (9, t.new_month9_power),
        (10, t.new_month10_power),
        (11, t.new_month11_power),
        (12, t.new_month12_power)
    ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
      ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = t.account_id
    WHERE
      t.target_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        b.start_at IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at)
          AND CASE
            WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
            THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
          END < CASE
            WHEN b.end_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
          END
        )
      )
  ), __forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.fact_id,
      ranked.opportunity_id,
      ranked.fact_date,
      ranked.qty,
      ranked.energy_kwh
    FROM (
      SELECT
        CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
        CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
        CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
        CAST(m.new_shipforecast_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
        CAST(m.new_singlepower AS DECIMAL) AS energy_kwh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
          ORDER BY CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __remaining_month_latest_rn
      FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb" AS m
      CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          b.start_at IS NULL
          OR (
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
          )
        )
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__remaining_month_latest_rn = 1 AND ranked.fact_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
      END AS product_type,
      CAST(o.new_cellcapacity AS DECIMAL) AS cell_energy_kwh,
      CAST(o.new_cell_qty AS DECIMAL) AS cells_per_set
    FROM __remaining_opportunity_source AS o
    WHERE
      EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __forecast_rows AS f
        WHERE
          f.opportunity_id = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunity_id,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_type) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(product_type)
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT cell_energy_kwh) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cell_energy_kwh)
        AND MIN(cell_energy_kwh) > 0
        THEN CASE
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = '电芯'
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)
          WHEN MIN(product_type) = 'PACK'
          AND COUNT(DISTINCT cells_per_set) = 1
          AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(cells_per_set)
          AND MIN(cells_per_set) > 0
          THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh) * MIN(cells_per_set)
        END
      END AS alternative_unit_kwh
    FROM __remaining_opp_energy_values
    GROUP BY
      opportunity_id
  ), __remaining_converted AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      f.fact_id,
      f.opportunity_id,
      f.fact_date,
      f.qty,
      CASE WHEN f.energy_kwh > 0 THEN f.energy_kwh ELSE e.alternative_unit_kwh END AS unit_kwh
    FROM __forecast_rows AS f
    LEFT JOIN __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS e
      ON e.opportunity_id = f.opportunity_id
  ), __forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('FORECAST' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      f.fact_id,
      f.fact_date,
      CASE
        WHEN f.qty = 0
        THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
        WHEN f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh > 0
        THEN f.qty * f.unit_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL)
      END AS value_gwh,
      (
        f.qty IS NULL OR f.qty < 0 OR (
          f.qty > 0 AND f.unit_kwh IS NULL
        )
      ) AS invalid,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.d005,
      c.customer_name AS d006,
      teams.team_name AS d004
    FROM __remaining_converted AS f
    JOIN __opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = f.opportunity_id
    LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
      ON c.accountid = o.parentaccountid
    LEFT JOIN __owner_teams AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __actual_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __target_facts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __forecast_facts
  ), checked AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
    FROM facts AS f
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
    FROM checked AS f
    WHERE
      f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND f.d004 IN (:team_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND (
        f.d005 IN (:customer_levels)
        OR (
          CASE f.d005
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            ELSE f.d005
          END
        ) IN (:customer_levels)
      ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
  ), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      f.d004 AS "YWLN_D004",
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(
          BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.copies > 1 OR f.fact_id IS NULL) FILTER(WHERE
            kind = 'ACTUAL'),
          FALSE
        )
        THEN NULL
        ELSE SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
      END AS actual_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh,
      SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'FORECAST'
        AND f.fact_id IS NOT NULL
        AND f.copies = 1
        AND NOT COALESCE(f.invalid, TRUE)) AS remaining_gwh
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY
      f.d004
  )
  SELECT
    a."YWLN_D004" AS "YWLN_D004",
    a.actual_gwh AS "YWLN_M0006",
    a.target_gwh AS "YWLN_M0007",
    a.actual_gwh + COALESCE(a.remaining_gwh, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)) AS "YWLN_M0011"
  FROM aggregated AS a
) AS __x360_period_result

WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*

WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH fact_distinct AS (
    SELECT
      m."new_oppmonthid" AS fact_id,
      CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      CAST((
        m."new_forecast_amt_rmb" / NULLIF(m."new_whprice", 0) / 1000000
      ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_value,
      CASE
        WHEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP)) < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        THEN m.new_forecast_amt_rmb
        ELSE m."new_forecast_amt_rmb"
      END AS amount_value,
      (
        (
          m."new_forecast_amt_rmb" / NULLIF(m."new_whprice", 0) / 1000000
        ) IS NULL
      ) AS energy_missing,
      CAST(o."new_salesbg" AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o."new_accproducttype" IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT)) = ''
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      o."ownerid" AS owner_id,
      CAST(o."new_accountlevel" AS TEXT) AS d005,
      (
        SELECT
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.name AS TEXT)), '')
        FROM __ont_accounts AS a
        WHERE
          CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(o."parentaccountid" AS TEXT)
      ) AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
          WHERE
            __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
        )
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS d015,
      (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN (
              TRUE
            )
            AND o."opportunityid" IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            AND (
              CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              OR (
                CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(o."createdon" AS TIMESTAMP)
                AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              )
            )
            AND p.enabled
            AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
            THEN CASE
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE)
              ) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
              THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
              AND p.cycle_target_days - (
                CURRENT_DATE - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE)
              ) > p.imminent_days
              THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS DATE) - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) > p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'overdue_completed'
              WHEN CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(o."new_stage5enddate" AS DATE) - CAST(o."createdon" AS DATE) <= p.cycle_target_days
              THEN 'normal_completed'
            END
          END
        FROM (
          SELECT
            dimension_code,
            cycle_target_days,
            imminent_days,
            (
              cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL
              AND cycle_target_days >= 0
              AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL
              AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days
            ) AS enabled
          FROM (
            SELECT
              dimension_code,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
              MAX(config_value) FILTER(WHERE
                config_key = REPLACE(dimension_code, 'YWLN_', '') || '_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
            FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
            WHERE
              config_set = 'MOCK'
              AND period_key = 'GLOBAL'
              AND config_group = 'HELMET'
              AND enabled
            GROUP BY
              dimension_code
          ) AS v
        ) AS p
        WHERE
          p.dimension_code = 'YWLN_D020'
      ) AS d020
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __latest."new_accountdate",
        __latest.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
        __latest."new_oppmonthid",
        __latest."new_opportunity_id",
        __latest."new_whprice"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __raw."createdon",
          __raw."modifiedon",
          __raw."new_accountdate",
          __raw.new_forecast_amt_rmb,
          __raw."new_oppmonthid",
          __raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __raw."new_whprice",
          1 AS __x360_period_latest_rn
        FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              ))
              AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
            )
          )
      ) AS __latest
      WHERE
        __latest.__x360_period_latest_rn = 1
    ) AS m
    JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
      ON o."opportunityid" = m."new_opportunity_id"
    WHERE
      CAST(m."new_accountdate" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  ), fact_versions AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS fact_copies
    FROM fact_distinct
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
    FROM fact_versions AS f
    WHERE
      1 = 1
      AND (
        (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
        ) IS NULL
        OR (
          f.fact_date >= DATE_TRUNC(
            'MONTH',
            CAST((
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) AS TIMESTAMP)
          )
          AND f.fact_date < CAST((
            SELECT
              end_at
            FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
          ) AS TIMESTAMP)
        )
      )
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND  f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/ /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/
      AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/ /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/
      AND EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
        JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
          ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
        WHERE
          tm."systemuserid" = f.owner_id AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) IN (:team_ids)
      ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/ /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/
      AND f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/ /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/
      AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/ /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/
      AND f.d015 IN (:sign_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/ /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D020*/
      AND f.d020 IN (:status_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D020*/
  )
  SELECT
    SUM(f.energy_value) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0022",
    SUM(f.amount_value) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0023"
  FROM scoped AS f
) AS __x360_period_result

            PARTITION BY COALESCE(

          ) AS version_rn
        FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base

  ), __narrow_inline_5 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (

      ) AS "teamid",

  ), fact_distinct AS (

      f_pre.fact_date IS NOT NULL

        THEN f_pre.fact_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP))

      END

        WHEN f_pre.kind IN ('TARGET')
