          WHEN CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL

        ELSE f_pre.fact_date < CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP)

/*TIME_END*/
), __selected_order_ids AS MATERIALIZED (

    FROM __period_facts
    WHERE
      kind = 'ACTUAL' AND salesorder_id IS NOT NULL
  ), __direct_order_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      so.salesorderid AS salesorder_id,
      so.opportunityid
    FROM __narrow_inline_2 AS so

      ON requested.salesorder_id = so.salesorderid

      NULLIF(TRIM(so.opportunityid), '') IS NOT NULL
  ), __order_opportunity_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      salesorder_id,
      opportunityid
    FROM __direct_order_opportunities
    UNION
    SELECT
      CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT),

    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l

      ON requested.salesorder_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    WHERE
      NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM __direct_order_opportunities AS direct_link
        WHERE
          direct_link.salesorder_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
      )
  ), __owner_team_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      tm.systemuserid AS owner_id,
      CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_id
    FROM __narrow_inline_5 AS tm
    JOIN __narrow_inline_6 AS t
      ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  ), __actual_order_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      link.salesorder_id,
      link.opportunityid,
      CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(teams.team_id), '') IS NOT NULL THEN teams.team_id END AS team_id
    FROM __order_opportunity_links AS link
    LEFT JOIN __narrow_inline_3 AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunityid
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_names AS teams
      ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
  ), __actual_order_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      salesorder_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) AS team_count,
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_id)
        THEN MIN(team_id)
      END AS team_id
    FROM __actual_order_team_candidates
    GROUP BY
      salesorder_id
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      CASE WHEN f.kind = 'ACTUAL' THEN actual_team.team_id ELSE target_team.team_id END AS d004
    FROM __period_facts AS f
    LEFT JOIN __actual_order_teams AS actual_team
      ON f.kind = 'ACTUAL' AND actual_team.salesorder_id = f.salesorder_id
    LEFT JOIN __owner_team_names AS target_team
      ON f.kind = 'TARGET' AND target_team.owner_id = f.owner_id
    WHERE
      TRUE
      /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND (
        CASE WHEN f.kind = 'ACTUAL' THEN actual_team.team_id ELSE target_team.team_id END
      ) IN (:team_ids)
  
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      f.d004 AS "YWLN_D004",
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL') = COUNT(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
        AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL') = COUNT(fact_id) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
        AND NOT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(id_copies > 1) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL'), FALSE)
        THEN SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
      END AS numerator_yuan,
      SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'TARGET') AS target_yuan
    FROM scoped AS f
    GROUP BY
      f.d004
  )
  SELECT
    "YWLN_D004",
    numerator_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0001",
    target_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0002",
    numerator_yuan / NULLIF(target_yuan, 0) AS "YWLN_M0003"
  FROM aggregated
) AS customer_target_result

WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL

), __ont_owner_teams AS (

), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (

  ), requested_product_lines AS NOT MATERIALIZED (

  ), requested_product_types AS NOT MATERIALIZED (

      CAST(ARRAY[:product_types] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
  ), requested_team_ids AS NOT MATERIALIZED (

    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/

      CAST(ARRAY[:team_ids] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
  ), requested_customer_levels AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT[]) AS items
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/
    WHERE

    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      CAST(ARRAY[:customer_levels] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
  ), requested_customer_ids AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT[]) AS items
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      CAST(ARRAY[:customer_ids] AS TEXT[]) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
  ), requested_filters AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      pl.items AS product_lines,
      pt.items AS product_types,
      tm.items AS team_ids,
      cl.items AS customer_levels,
      cu.items AS customer_ids
    FROM requested_product_lines AS pl
    CROSS JOIN requested_product_types AS pt
    CROSS JOIN requested_team_ids AS tm
    CROSS JOIN requested_customer_levels AS cl
    CROSS JOIN requested_customer_ids AS cu
  ), opportunity_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        o.opportunityid || ''
      ) AS opportunityid,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time,
      (
        o.ownerid || ''
      ) AS ownerid,
      (
        o.new_salesbg || ''
      ) AS new_salesbg,
      (
        o.new_accproducttype || ''
      ) AS new_accproducttype,
      (

      ) AS new_accountlevel,
      (
        o.parentaccountidname || ''
      ) AS parentaccountidname,
      o.new_opportunitystatus,
      o.new_approvalstatus
    FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
    WHERE
      o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
  ), month_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        m.new_oppmonthid || ''
      ) AS new_oppmonthid,
      (
        m.new_opportunity_id || ''
      ) AS new_opportunity_id,
      CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS metric_value
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __latest."new_accountdate",
        __latest."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
        __latest."new_month",
        __latest."new_oppmonthid",
        __latest."new_opportunity_id",
        __latest."new_year"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __raw."createdon",
          __raw."modifiedon",
          __raw."new_accountdate",
          __raw."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
          __raw."new_month",
          __raw."new_oppmonthid",
          __raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __raw."new_year",
          1 AS __x360_period_latest_rn
        FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
              AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
            )
          )
      ) AS __latest
      WHERE
        __latest.__x360_period_latest_rn = 1
    ) AS m
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
  ), candidate_opportunity_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* Filter source opportunities on every static dimension before selecting fact IDs. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      o.opportunityid
    FROM opportunity_source_once AS o
    CROSS JOIN requested_filters AS r
    WHERE
      o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        r.product_lines IS NULL OR CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) = ANY(
          r.product_lines
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.product_types IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
            THEN '其他'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
            THEN '电芯'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
            THEN 'PACK'
            ELSE '其他'

        ) = ANY(
          r.product_types
        )
      )

        r.team_ids IS NULL

          SELECT

          FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
          JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
            ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
          WHERE
            tm."systemuserid" = o.ownerid AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) = ANY(
              r.team_ids
            )
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.customer_levels IS NULL
        OR CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) = ANY(
          r.customer_levels
        )
        OR (
          CASE CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT)
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            WHEN '战略大客户'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '重要大客户'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '一般客户'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN 'BG大客户'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
          END
        ) = ANY(
          r.customer_levels
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.customer_ids IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.parentaccountidname AS TEXT)), '') = ANY(
          r.customer_ids
        )
      )
  ), candidate_fact_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* Apply period and eligibility at the monthly source, before version windows. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      m.new_oppmonthid AS fact_id
    FROM month_source_once AS m
    JOIN candidate_opportunity_ids AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
    CROSS JOIN requested_period AS p
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND m.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        m.metric_value
      ) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        p.start_at IS NULL OR (
          m.fact_date >= p.start_at AND m.fact_date < p.end_at
        )
      )
  ), month_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* Only candidate primary keys are expanded to all eligible versions. */
    /* Conflicting versions outside the requested period still poison this fact ID. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      m.new_oppmonthid AS fact_id,
      m.new_opportunity_id AS opportunityid,
      m.fact_date AS fact_date,
      m.metric_value AS metric_value
    FROM month_source_once AS m
    JOIN candidate_fact_ids AS c
      ON c.fact_id = m.new_oppmonthid
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND m.fact_date IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        m.metric_value
      ) IS NOT NULL
  ), opportunity_month_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      o.*,
      candidate.opportunityid AS selected_opportunityid
    FROM opportunity_source_once AS o
    FULL JOIN (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        opportunityid
      FROM month_scope
    ) AS candidate
      ON candidate.opportunityid = o.opportunityid
  ), opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* Load all valid versions for the selected opportunity keys, never pick one. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      o.opportunityid,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_time,
      CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      o.ownerid AS owner_id,
      CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.parentaccountidname AS TEXT)), '') AS d006
    FROM opportunity_month_bridge AS o
    CROSS JOIN requested_filters AS r
    WHERE
      o.selected_opportunityid IS NOT NULL
      AND o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        r.product_types IS NULL
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
            THEN '其他'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
            THEN '电芯'
            WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
            THEN 'PACK'
            ELSE '其他'
          END
        ) = ANY(
          r.product_types
        )
      )
  ), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      o.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.opportunityid) AS source_copies
    FROM opportunity_distinct AS o
  ), fact_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    /* A primary key pointing to different opportunities is a grain conflict. */
    SELECT DISTINCT
      m.fact_id,
      m.opportunityid,
      m.fact_date,
      m.metric_value,
      o.source_copies,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.owner_id,
      o.d005,
      o.d006
    FROM month_scope AS m
    JOIN opportunities AS o

  ), metric_facts AS MATERIALIZED (

    /* Reapply display scope after global versions of candidate keys are checked. */
    SELECT
      f.*
    FROM metric_facts AS f
    CROSS JOIN requested_period AS p
    CROSS JOIN requested_filters AS r
    WHERE
      (
        p.start_at IS NULL OR (
          f.fact_date >= p.start_at AND f.fact_date < p.end_at
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.product_lines IS NULL OR f.d002 = ANY(
          r.product_lines
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.product_types IS NULL OR f.d003 = ANY(
          r.product_types
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.team_ids IS NULL
        OR EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
          JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
            ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
          WHERE
            tm."systemuserid" = f.owner_id AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) = ANY(
              r.team_ids
            )
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.customer_levels IS NULL
        OR CAST(f.d005 AS TEXT) = ANY(
          r.customer_levels
        )
        OR (
          CASE CAST(f.d005 AS TEXT)
            WHEN '0'
            THEN '核心大客户'
            WHEN '1'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '2'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '3'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN '4'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
            WHEN '战略大客户'
            THEN '战略大客户'
            WHEN '重要大客户'
            THEN '重要大客户'
            WHEN '一般客户'
            THEN '一般客户'
            WHEN 'BG大客户'
            THEN 'BG大客户'
          END
        ) = ANY(
          r.customer_levels
        )
      )
      AND (
        r.customer_ids IS NULL OR CAST(f.d006 AS TEXT) = ANY(
          r.customer_ids
        )
      )
  ), selected_facts AS (
    SELECT
      f.*
    FROM scoped_facts AS f
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D015*/
    WHERE
      FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      signed_scope.*
    FROM (
      WITH sign_order_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          (
            ord_line.new_opportunity_id || ''
          ) AS opportunityid,
          (
            so.salesorderid || ''
          ) AS salesorderid,
          (
            so.new_salesorderid || ''
          ) AS new_salesorderid,
          so.statecode,
          so.new_changetype,
          so.new_changestatus,
          so.new_approval_time,
          so.new_ord_oa_state,
          so.new_salesordertype,
          so.new_order_category
        FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
        JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS ord_line
          ON ord_line.salesorderid = so.salesorderid
          AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(ord_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
      ), sign_cancel_rows_once AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          so.*
        FROM sign_order_source_once AS so
        WHERE
          so.salesorderid <> so.new_salesorderid AND so.new_changestatus = '8'
      ), sign_order_opportunity_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          so.*,
          c.opportunityid AS selected_opportunityid
        FROM sign_order_source_once AS so
        FULL JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            opportunityid
          FROM scoped_facts
        ) AS c
          ON c.opportunityid = so.opportunityid
      ), candidate_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
        /* Only rendered when sign_statuses is present, orders never multiply facts. */
        SELECT
          (
            so.opportunityid || ''
          ) AS opportunityid,
          (
            so.salesorderid || ''
          ) AS salesorderid,
          so.statecode,
          so.new_changetype,
          so.new_changestatus,
          so.new_approval_time
        FROM sign_order_opportunity_bridge AS so
        WHERE
          so.selected_opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
      ), cancelled_order_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          cx.new_salesorderid AS salesorderid
        FROM sign_cancel_rows_once AS cx
        WHERE
          cx.salesorderid <> cx.new_salesorderid AND cx.new_changestatus = '8'
      ), signed_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          opportunityid
        FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113
      ), signed_scope_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          f.*,
          s.opportunityid AS signed_opportunityid
        FROM scoped_facts AS f
        FULL JOIN signed_opportunities AS s
          ON s.opportunityid = f.opportunityid
      )
      SELECT
        f.fact_id,
        f.opportunityid,
        f.fact_date,
        f.metric_value,
        f.source_copies,
        f.d002,
        f.d003,
        f.owner_id,
        f.d005,
        f.d006,
        f.fact_copies
      FROM signed_scope_bridge AS f
      WHERE
        f.fact_id IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          CASE
            WHEN f.signed_opportunityid IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'signed_opportunity'
            ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
          END
        ) IN (:sign_statuses)
    ) AS signed_scope
  
/*FILTER_END:YWLN_D015*/
)
  SELECT
    f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003",
    SUM(f.metric_value) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0023"
  FROM selected_facts AS f
  GROUP BY
    f.d003
) AS __x360_period_result

WITH __x360_gov_source_1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."project_name",__x360_raw."input_time",__x360_raw."energy_mwh",__x360_raw."is_awarded",__x360_raw."winner_announce_time",__x360_raw."remark",__x360_raw."seq_no" AS "bid_record_id" FROM ded_public."p_fm_bid_project_info" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        b.bid_record_id,
        b.project_name,
        b.input_time::timestamp,
        
        b.energy_mwh,
        b.is_awarded,
        b.winner_announce_time::timestamp,
        b.remark
    FROM __x360_gov_source_1 b
    WHERE b.project_name IS NOT NULL
      AND b.project_name ~ '[^[:space:]]'
      AND b.bid_record_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.input_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL
      AND b.input_time::timestamp <= NOW()
), ranked AS (
    SELECT eligible.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_name
               ORDER BY input_time::timestamp DESC, bid_record_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM eligible
), latest AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
), period_scope AS (
    SELECT * FROM latest
    WHERE 1 = 1
    /*TIME_BEGIN*/
      AND input_time::timestamp >= :start_date
      AND input_time::timestamp < :end_exclusive
    /*TIME_END*/
), classified AS (
    SELECT period_scope.*,
           COALESCE(remark, '') LIKE '%弃标%' AS is_abandoned
    FROM period_scope
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE NOT is_abandoned
          AND winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL
          AND winner_announce_time::timestamp <= NOW()
          AND is_awarded IN ('是', '1')
    )::numeric/NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "YWLN_M0030",
    COALESCE(SUM(energy_mwh) FILTER (
        WHERE energy_mwh IS NOT NULL AND energy_mwh > 0
          AND NOT is_abandoned
          AND winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL
          AND winner_announce_time::timestamp <= NOW()
          AND is_awarded IN ('否', '0')
    ), 0) / 1000::numeric AS "YWLN_M0170",
    COALESCE(SUM(energy_mwh) FILTER (
        WHERE energy_mwh IS NOT NULL AND energy_mwh > 0
          AND is_abandoned
    ), 0) / 1000::numeric AS "YWLN_M0171",
    (COALESCE(SUM(energy_mwh) FILTER (
        WHERE energy_mwh IS NOT NULL AND energy_mwh > 0
          AND NOT is_abandoned
          AND winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL
          AND winner_announce_time::timestamp <= NOW()
          AND is_awarded IN ('否', '0')
    ), 0) / 1000::numeric
     + COALESCE(SUM(energy_mwh) FILTER (
        WHERE energy_mwh IS NOT NULL AND energy_mwh > 0
          AND is_abandoned
    ), 0) / 1000::numeric) AS "YWLN_M0256"
FROM classified

) AS __x360_gov_result

WITH __helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
 AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
 max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
 max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
 AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v
),
requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/

WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), requested AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM requested
), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(accountid AS TEXT),
    CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT),
    CAST(name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    t.team_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
  JOIN __teams AS t
    ON t.teamid = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM __owner_team_candidates
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), __opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(opportunityid AS TEXT),
    CAST(ownerid AS TEXT),
    CAST(new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
      THEN '其他'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS d003,
    CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
    CAST(parentaccountid AS TEXT)
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"
), __shipment_items AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
    CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
    CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
    CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CAST(s.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT)), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(s.new_salesorderid AS TEXT)), '')
    ) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" AS i
  JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" AS s
    ON s.new_ord_shipmentid = i.new_ord_shipment_id
  CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
  WHERE
    i.new_qty > 0
    AND s.statecode = 0
    AND s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL
    AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL
      OR (
        CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
        AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
      )
    )
), __selected_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    order_id
  FROM __shipment_items
  WHERE
    order_id IS NOT NULL
), __direct_order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') AS opportunity_id
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
  JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
    ON requested.order_id = CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    opportunity_id
  FROM __direct_order_links
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT),
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '')
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l
  JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
    ON requested.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM __direct_order_links AS d
      WHERE
        d.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    )
), __order_dimension_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    link.order_id,
    link.opportunity_id,
    o.ownerid,
    o.d002,
    o.d003,
    teams.team_name
  FROM __order_links AS link
  LEFT JOIN __opportunities AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunity_id
  LEFT JOIN __owner_team_candidates AS teams
    ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
), __order_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ownerid) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(ownerid)
      THEN MIN(ownerid)
    END AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d002) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d002) THEN MIN(d002) END AS d002,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d003) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d003) THEN MIN(d003) END AS d003,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_name)
      THEN MIN(team_name)
    END AS team_name
  FROM __order_dimension_candidates
  GROUP BY
    order_id
), __product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.new_system_energy) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(p.new_system_energy AS DECIMAL))
    END AS energy_kwh
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS p
  WHERE
    p.new_system_energy > 0
    AND EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM __shipment_items AS i
      WHERE
        i.product_code = CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
), __actual_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
    i.fact_id,
    i.fact_date,
    i.qty * p.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
    (
      i.fact_id IS NULL OR p.energy_kwh IS NULL
    ) AS invalid,
    d.d002,
    d.d003,
    c.customer_level AS d005,
    c.customer_name AS d006,
    d.team_name AS d004
  FROM __shipment_items AS i
  JOIN __product_energy AS p
    ON p.product_code = i.product_code
  LEFT JOIN __order_dimensions AS d
    ON d.order_id = i.order_id
  LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
    ON c.accountid = i.account_id
), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*

    SELECT
      CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
      t.new_year,
      CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
      t.new_month1_power,
      t.new_month2_power,
      t.new_month3_power,
      t.new_month4_power,
      t.new_month5_power,
      t.new_month6_power,
      t.new_month7_power,
      t.new_month8_power,
      t.new_month9_power,
      t.new_month10_power,
      t.new_month11_power,
      t.new_month12_power,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
        ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE
      b.start_at IS NULL OR t.new_year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT)
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    ranked.rn = 1
), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
      THEN '其他'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS d003
  FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,

    CASE
      WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
      THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
    END AS fact_date,
    CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
    FALSE AS invalid,
    t.d002,
    COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
    c.customer_level AS d005,
    c.customer_name AS d006,
    (
      SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
          THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
        END
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
      WHERE
        CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
    ) AS d004
  FROM __target_latest AS t
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
  CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
  LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
    ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
  LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
    ON c.accountid = t.account_id
  WHERE
    t.target_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL
      OR (
        CASE
          WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
          THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
        END >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at)
        AND CASE
          WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
          THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
        END < CASE
          WHEN b.end_at IS NOT NULL
          THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
        END
      )
    )
), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __actual_facts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __target_facts
), checked AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
  FROM facts AS f
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
  FROM checked AS f
  WHERE
    f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND f.d004 IN (:team_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND (
      f.d005 IN (:customer_levels)
      OR (
        CASE f.d005
          WHEN '0'
          THEN '核心大客户'
          WHEN '1'
          THEN '战略大客户'
          WHEN '2'
          THEN '重要大客户'
          WHEN '3'
          THEN '一般客户'
          WHEN '4'
          THEN 'BG大客户'
          ELSE f.d005
        END
      ) IN (:customer_levels)
    ) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
    /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
), aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(
        BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.copies > 1 OR f.fact_id IS NULL) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL'),
        FALSE
      )
      THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'ACTUAL')
    END AS actual_gwh,
    SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh
  FROM scoped AS f
)
SELECT
  a.actual_gwh / NULLIF(a.target_gwh, 0) AS "YWLN_M0008"
FROM aggregated AS a

SELECT * FROM (
WITH requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)

, fulfillment_orders_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS order_id,so.createdon::timestamp AS fact_date,
  o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
  CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
   WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
  o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS d006,

 FROM __x360_gov_source_11 so
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=so.opportunityid
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a ON a.accountid=so.customerid
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.new_salesordertype::text='1' AND so.new_order_category::text IN ('1','3')
  AND so.statecode=0 AND so.new_ord_oa_state::text='5'
  AND so.createdon::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND so.createdon::timestamp<=NOW()
  AND ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR so.createdon::timestamp>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds))

  AND NOT COALESCE(TRUE AND so.new_changestatus::text='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW(),FALSE)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_gov_source_11 cx WHERE cx.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND cx.salesorderid<>so.salesorderid
   AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW())
), fulfillment_orders AS MATERIALIZED (

), fulfillment_shipments_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS shipment_item_id,s.new_salesorderid::text AS order_id,i.new_amount::numeric AS amount_yuan
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s

), fulfillment_shipments AS (

), fulfillment_shipped_by_order AS MATERIALIZED (

 FROM fulfillment_shipments GROUP BY order_id
)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.order_id AS fact_id,f.fact_date,
 COALESCE(s.amount_yuan,0)/100000000::numeric AS metric_value,
 (f.source_copies>1 OR COALESCE(s.invalid,FALSE)) AS invalid,FALSE AS poison_time,
 f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,NULL::text AS status_code,NULL::text AS helmet_status
FROM fulfillment_orders f LEFT JOIN fulfillment_shipped_by_order s ON s.order_id=f.order_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'm1'::text AS measure_tag,f.order_id AS fact_id,f.fact_date,
 f.amount_yuan/100000000::numeric AS metric_value,
 (f.source_copies>1 OR f.amount_yuan IS NULL) AS invalid,FALSE AS poison_time,
 f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,NULL::text AS status_code,NULL::text AS helmet_status
FROM fulfillment_orders f
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_LEVEL_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d005::text IN (:customer_levels) OR (CASE f.d005::text WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' WHEN '战略大客户' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '重要大客户' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '一般客户' THEN '一般客户' WHEN 'BG大客户' THEN 'BG大客户' END) IN (:customer_levels)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_NAME_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d006::text IN (:customer_ids) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" customer_filter WHERE customer_filter.accountid::text=f.d006::text AND NULLIF(btrim(customer_filter.name::text),'') IN (:customer_ids))) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
)
SELECT ((CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END))/NULLIF(((CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m1'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m1') END)),0) AS "YWLN_M0037" FROM scoped f GROUP BY ()
) AS __x360_gov_result

SELECT * FROM (

 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.amount_yuan)::numeric/100000000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR (f.amount_yuan) IS NULL) AS invalid,(FALSE) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,to_jsonb(f)->>'helmet_status' AS helmet_status FROM (

)
 SELECT DISTINCT b.bid_record_id::text AS fact_id,b.input_time::timestamp AS fact_date,b.input_time::timestamp,b.winner_announce_time::timestamp,
 b.energy_mwh,CASE WHEN (to_jsonb(b)->>'bid_amount') ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (to_jsonb(b)->>'bid_amount')::numeric END AS amount_yuan,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,

 (SELECT CASE WHEN (TRUE) AND b.input_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.input_time::timestamp<=NOW()

WITH __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_risk_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_risk_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH __customer_target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      ranked.*
    FROM (
      SELECT
        original.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
            CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
          ), original.new_year
          ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS __customer_target_rn
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE
      ranked.__customer_target_rn = 1
  )
  SELECT
    customer_target_result.*
  FROM (
    WITH __x360_gov_source_7 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw."new_targetid",
        __x360_raw."ownerid",
        __x360_raw."createdon",
        __x360_raw."statecode",
        __x360_raw."new_month1",
        __x360_raw."new_month10",
        __x360_raw."new_month11",
        __x360_raw."new_month12",
        __x360_raw."new_month2",
        __x360_raw."new_month3",
        __x360_raw."new_month4",
        __x360_raw."new_month5",
        __x360_raw."new_month6",
        __x360_raw."new_month7",
        __x360_raw."new_month8",
        __x360_raw."new_month9",
        __x360_raw."new_opportunity_id",
        __x360_raw."new_year",
        __x360_raw."new_target_type",
        CAST(__x360_product_type."new_accproducttype" AS TEXT) AS "new_accproducttype"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __x360_rank.*
        FROM (
          SELECT
            __x360_base.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY COALESCE(
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
                CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
              ), __x360_base.new_year
              ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
            ) AS version_rn
          FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
        ) AS __x360_rank
        WHERE
          __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
      ) AS __x360_raw
      LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS __x360_product_type
        ON __x360_product_type."new_product_typeid" = __x360_raw."new_producttype_id"
    )
    SELECT
      *
    FROM (
      WITH common_period AS (
        SELECT
          CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
          CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
        WHERE
          FALSE
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          start_at,
          end_at
        FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
      ), gap_result AS (
        WITH selected_period AS (
          SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
            CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
          WHERE
            FALSE
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            start_at,
            end_at
          FROM common_period
        ), forecast_distinct AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            m.new_oppmonthid,
            CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP),
            m.__ont_energy_mwh,
            m.new_year,
            m.new_month,
            m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS amount_yuan
          FROM (
            SELECT
              __latest."new_accountdate",
              __latest.__ont_energy_mwh,
              __latest."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
              __latest."new_month",
              __latest."new_oppmonthid",
              __latest."new_opportunity_id",
              __latest."new_year"
            FROM (
              SELECT
                __raw."createdon",
                __raw."modifiedon",
                __raw."new_accountdate",
                __raw.__ont_energy_mwh,
                __raw."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
                __raw."new_month",
                __raw."new_oppmonthid",
                __raw."new_opportunity_id",
                __raw."new_year",
                1 AS __x360_risk_period_latest_rn
              FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
              WHERE
                NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
                AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
                AND (
                  (
                    SELECT
                      start_at
                    FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
                  ) IS NULL
                  OR (
                    CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                      SELECT
                        start_at
                      FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
                    )
                    AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                      SELECT
                        end_at
                      FROM __x360_risk_selected_prediction_bounds
                    )
                  )
                )
            ) AS __latest
            WHERE
              __latest.__x360_risk_period_latest_rn = 1
          ) AS m
          WHERE
            TRUE
            AND m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
            AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
            AND EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
              WHERE
                o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
            )
        ), forecast_unique AS (
          SELECT
            *,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY new_oppmonthid) AS id_copies
          FROM forecast_distinct
        ), forecast_scope AS (
          SELECT
            *
          FROM forecast_unique
          WHERE
            (
              (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR CAST(new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              )
            )
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR CAST(new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM selected_period
              )
            )
        ), forecast_agg AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket,
            SUM(__ont_energy_mwh) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0022",
            SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
              TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE AND amount_yuan IS NOT NULL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0023"
          FROM forecast_scope
        ), opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            o.opportunityid,
            CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP)
          FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
          WHERE
            TRUE AND TRUE AND o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND TRUE
        ), opportunity_unique AS (
          SELECT
            *,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY opportunityid) AS id_copies
          FROM opportunity_distinct
        ), opportunity_scope AS (
          SELECT
            *
          FROM opportunity_unique
          WHERE
            (
              (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL OR TRUE
            )
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL OR TRUE
            )
        ), opportunity_agg AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket,
            CASE WHEN BOOL_OR(id_copies > 1) THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT opportunityid) END AS "YWLN_M0024"
          FROM opportunity_scope
        ), source_rows AS (
          SELECT
            t.*,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY new_targetid) AS id_count
          FROM __x360_gov_source_7 AS t
          /* 当前接入范围：类型1销售目标、系统有效状态0。 */
          /* 类型4及客户开发目标不自动纳入，后续确认后再扩展。 */
          WHERE
            TRUE
        ), monthly AS (
          SELECT
            t.new_targetid,
            t.id_count,
            CASE
              WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999 AND t.new_year <> 0
              THEN MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1)
            END AS target_month,
            v.amount_yuan
          FROM source_rows AS t
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            VALUES
              (1, t.new_month1),
              (2, t.new_month2),
              (3, t.new_month3),
              (4, t.new_month4),
              (5, t.new_month5),
              (6, t.new_month6),
              (7, t.new_month7),
              (8, t.new_month8),
              (9, t.new_month9),
              (10, t.new_month10),
              (11, t.new_month11),
              (12, t.new_month12)
          ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan)
        ), scoped AS (
          SELECT
            *
          FROM monthly
          WHERE
            target_month IS NOT NULL
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR target_month >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM selected_period
              )))
            )
            AND (
              (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM selected_period
              ) IS NULL
              OR target_month < CASE
                WHEN (
                  SELECT
                    end_at
                  FROM selected_period
                ) IS NOT NULL
                THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', (
                  SELECT
                    start_at
                  FROM selected_period
                )) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
              END
            )
        ), target_agg AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket,
            SUM(amount_yuan) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0002"
          FROM scoped
        ), buckets AS (
          SELECT
            CAST('_TOTAL_' AS TEXT) AS bucket
        )
        SELECT
          t."YWLN_M0002" - f."YWLN_M0023" AS "YWLN_M0140"
        FROM buckets AS b
        LEFT JOIN forecast_agg AS f
          ON f.bucket = b.bucket
        LEFT JOIN target_agg AS t
          ON t.bucket = b.bucket
      ), customer_result AS (
/*X360_R09_ONTOLOGY_ALIGN_20261114*/
WITH __x360_r09_accounts_ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT a.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.accountid
  ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS __x360_r09_rn
 FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb a
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(a.accountid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
), __x360_r09_accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM __x360_r09_accounts_ranked WHERE __x360_r09_rn=1
), __x360_r09_opportunities_ranked AS MATERIALIZED (

 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
), __x360_r09_opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (

), fact_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT a.accountid AS fact_id,a.createdon::timestamp AS fact_date,
  NULL::numeric AS metric_value,FALSE AS needs_snapshot,
  o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
  CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL

  o.ownerid AS owner_id,a.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,
  NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS d006
 FROM __x360_r09_accounts a
 LEFT JOIN __x360_r09_opportunities o ON o.parentaccountid::text=a.accountid::text
 WHERE a.new_accountlevel::text='1' AND o.opportunityid IS NULL
), scoped AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.fact_id) AS "YWLN_M0257" FROM scoped f
)
      SELECT
        g."YWLN_M0140",
        c."YWLN_M0257"
      FROM gap_result AS g
      CROSS JOIN customer_result AS c
    ) AS __x360_gov_result
  ) AS customer_target_result

filter_contract: {"YWLN_D002": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "product_lines", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D003": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "product_types", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D004": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "team_ids", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D005": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "customer_levels", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D006": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "customer_ids", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D021": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "status_codes", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D035": {"op": "BETWEEN", "to": "end_exclusive", "from": "start_date", "type": "DATE", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D045": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "anomaly_flags", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D_PROJECT_NUMBER": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "project_numbers", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "quote_abnormal_flags", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "project_blockers", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "project_next_steps", "optional": true}}
sql_text:
WITH __x360_gov_source_6 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."new_productpower",__x360_raw."new_quoteapply_id",__x360_raw."new_product_id",__x360_raw."new_opportunity_id",__x360_raw."new_accproducttype",__x360_raw."ownerid",__x360_raw."createdon",__x360_raw."modifiedon",__x360_raw."new_quoteapply_id"::text AS "new_quoteapplydetailid" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH __helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v
),
requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.energy_kwh)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((FALSE),FALSE) OR (f.energy_kwh) IS NULL) AS invalid,(f.approval='6' AND f.fact_date IS NULL) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.helmet_status AS helmet_status FROM (
WITH linked_pick AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.new_opportunity_id) d.new_opportunity_id,q.new_quoteapplyid
 FROM __x360_gov_source_6 d
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb" q ON q.new_quoteapplyid=d.new_quoteapply_id
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_o ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 WHERE q.new_approvalstatus::text IN ('2','3','6') AND q.createdon::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND d.new_opportunity_id IS NOT NULL AND o.new_opportunitystatus::text='0' AND o.new_approvalstatus::text='3'
 ORDER BY d.new_opportunity_id,q.createdon::timestamp DESC,q.new_quoteapplyid DESC
), chosen AS (
 SELECT d.*,q.new_approvalstatus::text AS approval,q.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp,q.new_approved_time::timestamp,q.createdon::timestamp AS quote_created,
 q.new_quoteapplyid AS quote_id,q.ownerid AS quote_owner
 FROM __x360_gov_source_6 d JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb" q ON q.new_quoteapplyid=d.new_quoteapply_id
 WHERE d.new_quoteapplydetailid IS NOT NULL
 AND q.new_approvalstatus::text IN ('2','3','6') AND q.createdon::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (d.new_opportunity_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM linked_pick p WHERE p.new_quoteapplyid=q.new_quoteapplyid AND p.new_opportunity_id=d.new_opportunity_id))
)
 SELECT DISTINCT d.new_quoteapplydetailid::text AS fact_id,
 CASE WHEN d.approval='3' THEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp ELSE d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp END AS fact_date,
 d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp,d.new_approved_time::timestamp,d.quote_created,d.quote_id::text,d.approval,
 d.new_productpower::numeric AS energy_kwh,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 COALESCE(o.ownerid,d.quote_owner)::text AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_o.name::text),'') AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN ((d.approval='2' AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL) OR (d.approval='3' AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL)) AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL OR (d.new_approved_time::timestamp>=d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp AND d.new_approved_time::timestamp<=NOW())) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_approved_time::date-d.new_oasubmitdate::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN d.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND d.new_approved_time::date-d.new_oasubmitdate::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM __helmet_cfg p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D021') AS helmet_status,
 (o.new_accountlevel::text IN ('1','2') OR o.new_risklevel::text IN ('1','2')) AS is_key,
 pr.material_type,COALESCE(pr.matches,0)<>1 OR pr.material_type IS NULL AS material_issue,
 (d.approval='6' AND d.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NULL) AS source_issue,
 (CURRENT_DATE-d.new_oasubmitdate::date) AS elapsed_days
 FROM chosen d LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_o ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches,MIN(p.new_productype::text) AS material_type
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT productid,new_productype FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" WHERE productid::text=d.new_product_id::text) p) pr ON TRUE
) f WHERE f.energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND (f.approval='6' OR (f.approval='3' AND f.new_approved_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND f.new_approved_time::timestamp<=NOW()) OR (f.approval='2' AND f.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND f.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp<=NOW()))
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
project_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT d.new_quoteapplydetailid::text AS fact_id,
 MIN(o.opportunityid::text) AS opportunity_id,MIN(NULLIF(btrim(o.new_itemnumber::text),'')) AS project_number,
 COUNT(DISTINCT ROW(o.opportunityid,o.new_itemnumber))>1 AS metadata_issue
 FROM __x360_gov_source_6 d
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=d.new_opportunity_id
 GROUP BY d.new_quoteapplydetailid::text
), team_names AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT tm."systemuserid"::text AS owner_id,string_agg(DISTINCT t."name"::text,'、' ORDER BY t."name"::text) AS team_names
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid" GROUP BY 1
), enriched AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,p.opportunity_id,p.project_number,p.metadata_issue,t.team_names AS d004,
 progress.project_blocker,progress.project_next_step,CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_uncompleted','overdue_completed') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('imminent_uncompleted','normal_uncompleted','normal_completed') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_flag
 FROM checked f LEFT JOIN project_metadata p ON p.fact_id=f.fact_id
 LEFT JOIN team_names t ON t.owner_id=f.owner_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(pp.new_question_resource::text),'') AS project_blocker,NULLIF(btrim(pp.new_actionplan::text),'') AS project_next_step
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_projectprocess_esb" pp
 WHERE pp.new_opportunity_id::text=p.opportunity_id AND pp.new_projectprocessid IS NOT NULL
 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(pp.modifiedon::text),''),NULLIF(btrim(pp.createdon::text),''))::timestamp<=NOW()
 ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(pp.modifiedon::text),''),NULLIF(btrim(pp.createdon::text),''))::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,pp.new_projectprocessid DESC LIMIT 1
 ) progress ON TRUE
), scoped AS (SELECT f.* FROM enriched f WHERE TRUE
 AND ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid" WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND f.d005 IN (SELECT CASE v WHEN '战略大客户' THEN '1' WHEN '重要大客户' THEN '2' WHEN '一般客户' THEN '3' WHEN 'BG大客户' THEN '4' ELSE v END FROM unnest(ARRAY[:customer_levels]::text[]) AS selected(v)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D021*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D021*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:quote_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D045*/ AND f.anomaly_flag IN (:anomaly_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D045*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_PROJECT_NUMBER*/ AND f.project_number IN (:project_numbers) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_PROJECT_NUMBER*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER*/ AND f.project_blocker IN (:project_blockers) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP*/ AND f.project_next_step IN (:project_next_steps) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP*/)
SELECT f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003",f.d004 AS "YWLN_D004",f.d006 AS "YWLN_D006",f.project_blocker AS "YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER",f.project_next_step AS "YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP",f.project_number AS "YWLN_D_PROJECT_NUMBER",CASE WHEN bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1 OR COALESCE(f.metadata_issue,FALSE)) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) END AS "YWLN_M0031" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.d003,f.d004,f.d006,f.project_blocker,f.project_next_step,f.project_number,f.opportunity_id
) AS __x360_gov_result
description: 报价电量项目明细组合；沿用报价有效性、最新报价、分支归期、单位及重复数据保护；支持是否异常、中文办理状态及客户等级筛选。异常条件由请求选择，不固定排除正常记录。；有效报价取主表审核状态2/3/6；无需审批按已有提交日期归期，日期缺失继续留空；产品主键关联。

sql_text: SELECT code AS "YWLN_D022" FROM (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('overdue_uncompleted','逾期未完成',1),('imminent_uncompleted','临期未完成',2),('normal_uncompleted','正常未完成',3),('overdue_completed','逾期完成',4),('normal_completed','正常完成',5)) e(code,label,sort_order)) e ORDER BY sort_order

WITH source_values AS (
 SELECT config_key,config_value,period_key,
  CASE WHEN length(period_key)=4 THEN to_date(period_key||'-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD')
       ELSE to_date(period_key||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD') END AS snapshot_date
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND enabled AND config_group='FINANCE'
  AND config_key IN ('GROSS_MARGIN_ACTUAL','GROSS_MARGIN_TARGET') AND length(period_key)=7
), scoped AS (
 SELECT * FROM source_values WHERE 1=1
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ AND snapshot_date>=CAST(:start_date AS date)
 AND snapshot_date<CAST(:end_exclusive AS date) /*TIME_END*/
), snapshots AS (
 SELECT period_key,snapshot_date,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key='GROSS_MARGIN_ACTUAL') AS actual_value,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key='GROSS_MARGIN_TARGET') AS target_value
 FROM scoped GROUP BY period_key,snapshot_date
)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT period_key)=1 THEN max(actual_value) END AS "M0013", CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT period_key)=1 THEN max(target_value) END AS "M0014" FROM snapshots
