WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    start_at,
    end_at
  FROM __ont_bounds
), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request
)
SELECT
  __x360_period_result.*
FROM (
  WITH order_source_once AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        so.salesorderid || ''
      ) AS salesorderid,
      (
        so.new_salesorderid || ''
      ) AS new_salesorderid,
      (
        ord_line.new_opportunity_id || ''
      ) AS opportunityid,
      so.statecode,
      so.new_changetype,
      so.new_changestatus,
      so.new_approval_time,
      so.new_ord_oa_state,
      so.new_salesordertype,
      so.new_order_category
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
    JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS ord_line
      ON ord_line.salesorderid = so.salesorderid
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(ord_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    WHERE
      so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
  ), cancelled_order_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      cx.new_salesorderid AS salesorderid
    FROM order_source_once AS cx
    WHERE
      cx.salesorderid <> cx.new_salesorderid
  ), signed_opportunity_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      opportunityid
    FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113
  ), opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      (
        o.opportunityid || ''
      ) AS opportunityid,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP),
      (
        o.new_salesbg || ''
      ) AS d002,
      CASE
        WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
        THEN NULL
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
        THEN '其他'
        WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS d003,
      (
        o.ownerid || ''
      ) AS owner_id,
      (
        o.new_accountlevel || ''
      ) AS d005,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT
            1
          FROM __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS __sign_match
          WHERE
            __sign_match.opportunityid = CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)
        )
        THEN 'signed_opportunity'
        ELSE 'unsigned_opportunity'
      END AS status_code
    FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
    LEFT JOIN signed_opportunity_ids AS signed
      ON signed.opportunityid = o.opportunityid
    LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
      ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
    WHERE
      o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL
  ), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      *,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY opportunityid) AS copies
    FROM opportunity_distinct
  ), month_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        m.new_opportunity_id || ''
      ) AS month_opportunity_id,
      (
        m.new_oppmonthid || ''
      ) AS fact_id,
      CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS metric_value
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __latest."new_accountdate",
        __latest."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
        __latest."new_month",
        __latest."new_oppmonthid",
        __latest."new_opportunity_id",
        __latest."new_year"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __raw."createdon",
          __raw."modifiedon",
          __raw."new_accountdate",
          __raw."new_forecast_amt_rmb",
          __raw."new_month",
          __raw."new_oppmonthid",
          __raw."new_opportunity_id",
          __raw."new_year",
          1 AS __x360_period_latest_rn
        FROM __ont_forecast AS __raw
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
              AND CAST(__raw.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
              )
            )
          )
      ) AS __latest
      WHERE
        __latest.__x360_period_latest_rn = 1
    ) AS m
    WHERE
      m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        (
          SELECT
            start_at
          FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
        ) IS NULL
        OR (
          CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST((
            SELECT
              start_at
            FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
          ) AS TIMESTAMP)
          AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < CAST((
            SELECT
              end_at
            FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds
          ) AS TIMESTAMP)
        )
      )
      AND (
        m.new_forecast_amt_rmb
      ) IS NOT NULL
      AND TRUE
      AND TRUE
  ), month_opportunity_bridge AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      m.fact_id,
      m.fact_date,
      m.metric_value,
      m.month_opportunity_id,
      o.opportunityid AS source_opportunity_id,
      o.copies AS source_copies,
      o.status_code,
      o.d002,
      o.d003,
      o.owner_id,
      o.d005,
      o.d006
    FROM month_filtered AS m
    FULL JOIN opportunities AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = m.month_opportunity_id
  ), fact_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      fact_id,
      fact_date,
      metric_value,
      source_copies,
      status_code,
      d002,
      d003,
      owner_id,
      d005,

 CASE WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-b.input_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-b.input_time::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-b.input_time::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'

 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_LEVEL_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d005::text IN (:customer_levels) OR (CASE f.d005::text WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' WHEN '战略大客户' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '重要大客户' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '一般客户' THEN '一般客户' WHEN 'BG大客户' THEN 'BG大客户' END) IN (:customer_levels)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_NAME_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d006::text IN (:customer_ids) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" customer_filter WHERE customer_filter.accountid::text=f.d006::text AND NULLIF(btrim(customer_filter.name::text),'') IN (:customer_ids))) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D021*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D021*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:quote_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_QUOTE_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT f.helmet_status AS "YWLN_D021", (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scoped x WHERE x.measure_tag='m0' AND x.poison_time AND x.helmet_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.helmet_status) OR COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0031" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.helmet_status
) AS __x360_gov_result

WITH __repl_product AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT r."createdon",r."modifiedon",r."name",r."new_capacity",(r."new_capacity"::numeric/1000::numeric) AS "new_electricquantity",r."productid",r."statecode" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" r)
SELECT __repl_result.* FROM (
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT max(config_value) FILTER (WHERE config_key='D024_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
           max(config_value) FILTER (WHERE config_key='D024_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
    FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
    WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL' AND config_group='HELMET'
      AND dimension_code='YWLN_D024' AND enabled
), cancelled_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT new_salesorderid::text AS order_id
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb"
    WHERE TRUE AND salesorderid<>new_salesorderid
      AND TRUE AND new_changestatus::text='8'
      AND new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()
), order_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS fact_id,so.ordernumber::text AS order_no,(SELECT MIN(d.new_opportunity_id) FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" d WHERE d.salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id)=1)::text AS opportunity_id,
           so.new_approval_time::timestamp AS started_at,
           o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
           CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
                WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
                WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK'
                ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
           COALESCE(o.ownerid,so.ownerid)::text AS owner_id,
           COALESCE(c.new_accountlevel::text,o.new_accountlevel::text) AS d005,
           NULLIF(btrim(c.name::text),'') AS d006
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so
    LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=(SELECT MIN(d.new_opportunity_id) FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" d WHERE d.salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id)=1)
    LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" c ON c.accountid=so.customerid
    WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.new_salesordertype::text='1'
      AND so.new_order_category::text IN ('1','3') AND so.statecode=0
      AND so.new_ord_oa_state::text='5'
      AND NOT COALESCE(TRUE AND so.new_changestatus::text='8'
                       AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW(),FALSE)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cancelled_orders x WHERE x.order_id=so.salesorderid::text)
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS id_copies FROM order_distinct
), line_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderid::text AS order_id,l.salesorderdetailid::text AS line_id,
           l.new_dischargecapacity::numeric AS energy_kwh
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
    WHERE l.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.fact_id=l.salesorderid::text)
      AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=NOW())
      AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>NOW())
), lines_checked AS (
    SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id,line_id) AS copies FROM line_distinct
), line_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN bool_or(copies>1 OR energy_kwh IS NULL) THEN NULL
                        ELSE sum(energy_kwh) END AS energy_kwh
    FROM lines_checked GROUP BY order_id
), first_shipment AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.new_salesorderid::text AS order_id,min(s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp) AS finished_at
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
    WHERE s.statecode=0 AND TRUE AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.fact_id=s.new_salesorderid::text)
    GROUP BY s.new_salesorderid::text
), source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT o.*,l.energy_kwh,s.finished_at FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN line_totals l ON l.order_id=o.fact_id
    LEFT JOIN first_shipment s ON s.order_id=o.fact_id
), classified AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT f.*,CASE
        WHEN f.id_copies=1 AND f.started_at IS NOT NULL AND f.started_at<=NOW()
         AND (f.finished_at IS NULL OR (f.finished_at>=f.started_at AND f.finished_at<=NOW()))
         AND p.cycle_target_days>=0 AND p.imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND p.cycle_target_days
        THEN CASE
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-f.started_at::date>p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-f.started_at::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days
                THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-f.started_at::date)>p.imminent_days
                THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND f.finished_at::date-f.started_at::date>p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'overdue_completed'
            WHEN f.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND f.finished_at::date-f.started_at::date<=p.cycle_target_days
                THEN 'normal_completed'
        END END AS status_code
    FROM source_rows f CROSS JOIN parameters p
), selected_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,CASE WHEN f.status_code IN ('overdue_uncompleted','overdue_completed') THEN '是' WHEN f.status_code IN ('imminent_uncompleted','normal_uncompleted','normal_completed') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_flag,
 GREATEST(COALESCE(f.finished_at::date,CURRENT_DATE)-f.started_at::date-p.cycle_target_days,0)::numeric AS overdue_days
 FROM classified f CROSS JOIN parameters p WHERE f.status_code IS NOT NULL
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ AND f.started_at>=CAST(:start_date AS timestamp) AND f.started_at<CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D049*/ AND f.order_no IN (:order_numbers) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D049*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D024*/ AND f.status_code IN (:status_codes) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D024*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.status_code IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.status_code IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:shipment_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D045*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.status_code IN ('overdue_uncompleted','overdue_completed') THEN '是' WHEN f.status_code IN ('imminent_uncompleted','normal_uncompleted','normal_completed') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:anomaly_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D045*/
), shipments_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT s.new_ord_shipmentid::text AS fact_id,s.new_salesorderid::text AS order_id,
 s.new_totalqty::numeric*p.new_electricquantity::numeric AS energy_kwh,s.new_money::numeric AS amount_yuan,
 (s.new_totalqty IS NULL OR s.new_totalqty<0 OR p.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR p.new_electricquantity<=0) AS energy_issue
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
 LEFT JOIN __repl_product p ON p.productid=s.new_product_id
 WHERE s.statecode=0 AND s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected_orders x WHERE x.fact_id=s.new_salesorderid::text)
), shipments_checked AS (
 SELECT *,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS copies FROM shipments_distinct
), shipment_amounts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,CASE WHEN bool_or(copies>1 OR energy_issue) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(energy_kwh)/1000000::numeric END AS energy_gwh,
 CASE WHEN bool_or(copies>1 OR amount_yuan IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_yuan)/100000000::numeric END AS amount_yi
 FROM shipments_checked GROUP BY order_id
), detailed AS (
 SELECT f.*,progress.project_blocker,progress.project_next_step,s.energy_gwh,s.amount_yi,s.order_id AS shipment_order
 FROM selected_orders f LEFT JOIN shipment_amounts s ON s.order_id=f.fact_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT NULLIF(btrim(pp.new_question_resource::text),'') AS project_blocker,NULLIF(btrim(pp.new_actionplan::text),'') AS project_next_step
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_projectprocess_esb" pp WHERE pp.new_opportunity_id::text=f.opportunity_id
 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(pp.modifiedon::text),''),NULLIF(btrim(pp.createdon::text),''))::timestamp<=NOW()
 ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(pp.modifiedon::text),''),NULLIF(btrim(pp.createdon::text),''))::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,pp.new_projectprocessid DESC LIMIT 1
 ) progress ON TRUE
), filtered AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM detailed f WHERE TRUE
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER*/ AND f.project_blocker IN (:project_blockers) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP*/ AND f.project_next_step IN (:project_next_steps) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP*/
)
SELECT f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003",f.d006 AS "YWLN_D006",f.order_no AS "YWLN_D049",
 f.project_blocker AS "YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER",f.project_next_step AS "YWLN_D_PROJECT_NEXT_STEP",
 CASE WHEN f.shipment_order IS NULL THEN 0::numeric ELSE f.energy_gwh END AS "YWLN_M0035",
 CASE WHEN f.shipment_order IS NULL THEN 0::numeric ELSE f.amount_yi END AS "YWLN_M0036",
 f.overdue_days AS "YWLN_M_ORDER_OVERDUE_DAYS"
FROM filtered f
) __repl_result
description: 发货异常清单：与发货头盔相同的订单办理状态，逾期未完成/逾期完成为异常；审批到首次发货的周期判断，不再限制客户等级/风险等级或待出货数量。超期天数为超标杆天数，未发订单实际发货量/金额为0。

filter_contract: {"YWLN_D002": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "product_lines", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D003": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "product_types", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D004": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "team_ids", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D005": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "customer_levels", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D006": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "customer_ids", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D024": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "status_codes", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D028": {"op": "BETWEEN", "to": "end_exclusive", "from": "start_date", "type": "DATE", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D045": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "anomaly_flags", "optional": true}, "YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL": {"op": "IN", "type": "STRING", "param": "shipment_abnormal_flags", "optional": true}}

WITH __repl_product AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT r."name",r."new_capacity",(r."new_capacity"::numeric/1000::numeric) AS "new_electricquantity",r."productid",r."statecode" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" r)
SELECT __repl_result.* FROM (
WITH __source_0 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."enabled",t."config_value",t."updated_at",t."config_group",t."indicator_code",t."dimension_code",t."config_set",t."value_unit",t."notes",t."period_key",t."config_key",t."config_label" FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config" t),
__source_1 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."new_money",t."new_totalqty",t."statecode",(t."new_product_id"||'') AS "new_product_id",(t."new_salesorderid"||'') AS "new_salesorderid",(t."ownerid"||'') AS "ownerid",(t."new_ord_shipmentid"||'') AS "new_ord_shipmentid",(t."new_account_id"||'') AS "new_account_id",t."new_shipping2_date" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" t),
__source_2 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."statecode",t."new_changestatus",(t."salesorderid"||'') AS "salesorderid",(t."new_salesorderid"||'') AS "new_salesorderid",(t."opportunityid"||'') AS "opportunityid",t."new_approval_time",t."new_changetype" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" t),
__source_3 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."new_accountlevel",(t."accountid"||'') AS "accountid",(t."name"||'') AS "name" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" t),
__source_4 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."new_electricquantity",(t."productid"||'') AS "productid" FROM __repl_product t),
__source_5 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."new_salesbg",(t."ownerid"||'') AS "ownerid",(t."opportunityid"||'') AS "opportunityid",t."new_accproducttype",t."new_risklevel" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" t),
__source_6 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (t."teamid"||'') AS "teamid",(t."systemuserid"||'') AS "systemuserid" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" t),
__source_7 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (t."teamid"||'') AS "teamid",(t."name"||'') AS "name" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t),
__helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM __source_0
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v
),
__first_ship AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT s2.new_salesorderid,MIN(s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp) AS shipped_at
 FROM __source_1 s2
 WHERE TRUE AND s2.statecode=0 AND s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY s2.new_salesorderid
),
requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.amount_yuan)::numeric/100000000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((FALSE),FALSE) OR (f.amount_yuan) IS NULL) AS invalid,(FALSE) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.helmet_status AS helmet_status,CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_uncompleted','overdue_completed') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('imminent_uncompleted','normal_uncompleted','normal_completed') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_flag FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT s.new_ord_shipmentid::text AS fact_id,s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS fact_date,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 COALESCE(o.ownerid,s.ownerid)::text AS owner_id,c.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_s.name::text),'') AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 /*YWLN_TWO_NODE_ANOMALY_V1*/ CASE WHEN COALESCE((c.new_accountlevel::text IN ('1','2') OR o.new_risklevel::text IN ('1','2')),FALSE) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS anomaly_flag,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN ((so.statecode=0 AND NOT (so.statecode=2 OR COALESCE((so.new_changetype::text='4' AND so.new_changestatus::text='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)
 OR COALESCE(so.salesorderid IN (SELECT cx.new_salesorderid FROM __source_2 cx
        WHERE TRUE AND cx.salesorderid<>cx.new_salesorderid
          AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)))) AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL OR (first_ship.shipped_at>=so.new_approval_time::timestamp AND first_ship.shipped_at<=NOW())) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM __helmet_cfg p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D024') AS helmet_status,
 s.new_totalqty*pr.new_electricquantity AS energy_kwh,s.new_money::numeric AS amount_yuan,
 (s.new_totalqty IS NULL OR s.new_totalqty<0 OR pr.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR pr.new_electricquantity<=0) AS energy_issue,
 FALSE AS source_issue
 FROM __source_1 s LEFT JOIN __source_3 acc_s ON acc_s.accountid = s.new_account_id
 LEFT JOIN __source_4 pr ON pr.productid=s.new_product_id
 LEFT JOIN __source_2 so ON so.salesorderid=s.new_salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __source_5 o ON o.opportunityid=so.opportunityid
 LEFT JOIN __first_ship first_ship ON first_ship.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid

 LEFT JOIN __source_3 c ON c.accountid=s.new_account_id
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=NOW()
) f WHERE TRUE
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,team.team_id AS d004 FROM checked f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT tm."systemuserid" AS owner_id, t."name"::text AS team_id FROM __source_6 tm JOIN __source_7 t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid" WHERE 1=1 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/) team ON team.owner_id = f.owner_id
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D045*/ AND f.anomaly_flag IN (:anomaly_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D045*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
  
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D024*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D024*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:shipment_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT f.d004 AS "YWLN_D004", (CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0036" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.d004
) __repl_result

WITH __x360_gov_source_1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."project_name",__x360_raw."input_time",__x360_raw."energy_mwh",__x360_raw."is_awarded",__x360_raw."winner_announce_time",__x360_raw."remark",__x360_raw."seq_no" AS "bid_record_id",__x360_raw."bid_amount" AS "bid_amount" FROM ded_public."p_fm_bid_project_info" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH __helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v
),
requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.energy_mwh)::numeric/1000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((FALSE),FALSE) OR (f.energy_mwh) IS NULL) AS invalid,(FALSE) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.helmet_status AS helmet_status FROM (
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT b.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_name ORDER BY input_time::timestamp DESC,bid_record_id DESC) AS rn
 FROM __x360_gov_source_1 b WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name ~ '[^[:space:]]'
 AND bid_record_id IS NOT NULL AND input_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND input_time::timestamp<=NOW()
), linked AS (
 SELECT b.*,mx.matches,mx.opportunity_id FROM ranked b
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches,MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunity_id
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT opportunityid FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" p WHERE p.name=b.project_name AND p.opportunityid IS NOT NULL) z) mx ON TRUE
 WHERE b.rn=1
)
 SELECT DISTINCT b.bid_record_id::text AS fact_id,b.input_time::timestamp AS fact_date,b.input_time::timestamp,b.winner_announce_time::timestamp,
 b.energy_mwh,CASE WHEN (to_jsonb(b)->>'bid_amount') ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (to_jsonb(b)->>'bid_amount')::numeric END AS amount_yuan,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_o.name::text),'') AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN (TRUE) AND b.input_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.input_time::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL OR (b.winner_announce_time::timestamp>=b.input_time::timestamp AND b.winner_announce_time::timestamp<=NOW())) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-b.input_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-b.input_time::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-b.input_time::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.winner_announce_time::date-b.input_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND b.winner_announce_time::date-b.input_time::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM __helmet_cfg p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D022') AS helmet_status,
 FALSE AS source_issue,b.matches AS opportunity_matches,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" sx WHERE sx.opportunityid=o.opportunityid AND sx.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND sx.new_salesordertype::text='1' AND sx.new_order_category::text IN ('1','3') AND (sx.statecode=0 AND NOT (sx.statecode=2 OR COALESCE((TRUE AND sx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND sx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)
 OR COALESCE(sx.salesorderid IN (SELECT cx.new_salesorderid FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" cx
        WHERE TRUE AND cx.salesorderid<>cx.new_salesorderid
          AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE))) AND sx.new_ord_oa_state::text='5' AND sx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()) AS has_signed,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') LIKE '%弃标%') AS abandoned,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%' AND b.winner_announce_time::timestamp<=NOW() AND b.is_awarded IN ('是','1')) AS won,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%' AND b.winner_announce_time::timestamp<=NOW() AND b.is_awarded IN ('否','0')) AS lost,
 (COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%' AND (b.winner_announce_time::timestamp IS NULL OR b.winner_announce_time::timestamp>NOW())) AS in_progress
 FROM linked b LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_o ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid ON o.opportunityid=b.opportunity_id AND b.matches=1
) f WHERE f.energy_mwh>0 AND f.in_progress
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_LEVEL_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d005::text IN (:customer_levels) OR (CASE f.d005::text WHEN '1' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '2' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '3' THEN '一般客户' WHEN '4' THEN 'BG大客户' WHEN '战略大客户' THEN '战略大客户' WHEN '重要大客户' THEN '重要大客户' WHEN '一般客户' THEN '一般客户' WHEN 'BG大客户' THEN 'BG大客户' END) IN (:customer_levels)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND /*YWLN_CUSTOMER_NAME_FILTER_V1*/ (f.d006::text IN (:customer_ids) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" customer_filter WHERE customer_filter.accountid::text=f.d006::text AND NULLIF(btrim(customer_filter.name::text),'') IN (:customer_ids))) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D022*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D022*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_BID_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:bid_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_BID_ABNORMAL*/
)
SELECT (CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0172" FROM scoped f GROUP BY ()
) AS __x360_gov_result

WITH __repl_product AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT r."name",r."new_capacity",(r."new_capacity"::numeric/1000::numeric) AS "new_electricquantity",r."productid",r."statecode" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" r)
SELECT __repl_result.* FROM (
WITH __source_0 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."enabled",t."config_value",t."updated_at",t."config_group",t."indicator_code",t."dimension_code",t."config_set",t."value_unit",t."notes",t."period_key",t."config_key",t."config_label" FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config" t),
__source_1 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."new_money",t."new_totalqty",t."statecode",(t."new_product_id"||'') AS "new_product_id",(t."new_salesorderid"||'') AS "new_salesorderid",(t."ownerid"||'') AS "ownerid",(t."new_ord_shipmentid"||'') AS "new_ord_shipmentid",(t."new_account_id"||'') AS "new_account_id",t."new_shipping2_date" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" t),
__source_2 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."statecode",t."new_changestatus",(t."salesorderid"||'') AS "salesorderid",(t."new_salesorderid"||'') AS "new_salesorderid",(t."opportunityid"||'') AS "opportunityid",t."new_approval_time",t."new_changetype" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" t),
__source_3 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."new_accountlevel",(t."accountid"||'') AS "accountid",(t."name"||'') AS "name" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" t),
__source_4 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."new_electricquantity",(t."productid"||'') AS "productid" FROM __repl_product t),
__source_5 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t."new_salesbg",(t."ownerid"||'') AS "ownerid",(t."opportunityid"||'') AS "opportunityid",t."new_accproducttype",t."new_risklevel" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" t),
__source_6 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (t."teamid"||'') AS "teamid",(t."systemuserid"||'') AS "systemuserid" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" t),
__source_7 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (t."teamid"||'') AS "teamid",(t."name"||'') AS "name" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" t),
__helmet_cfg AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM __source_0
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v
),
__first_ship AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT s2.new_salesorderid,MIN(s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp) AS shipped_at
 FROM __source_1 s2
 WHERE TRUE AND s2.statecode=0 AND s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY s2.new_salesorderid
),
__order_cycle_once_1 AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT so.salesorderid,CASE WHEN __cycle_cfg_1.dimension_code IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ((so.statecode=0 AND NOT (so.statecode=2 OR COALESCE((so.new_changetype::text='4' AND so.new_changestatus::text='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)
 OR COALESCE(so.salesorderid IN (SELECT cx.new_salesorderid FROM __source_2 cx
        WHERE TRUE AND cx.salesorderid<>cx.new_salesorderid
          AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()),FALSE)))) AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=NOW()
 AND (first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL OR (first_ship.shipped_at>=so.new_approval_time::timestamp AND first_ship.shipped_at<=NOW())) AND __cycle_cfg_1.enabled AND __cycle_cfg_1.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date>__cycle_cfg_1.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND __cycle_cfg_1.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date) BETWEEN 0 AND __cycle_cfg_1.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND __cycle_cfg_1.cycle_target_days-(CURRENT_DATE-so.new_approval_time::date)>__cycle_cfg_1.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date>__cycle_cfg_1.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date<=__cycle_cfg_1.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END END AS helmet_status
 FROM __source_2 so
 LEFT JOIN __first_ship first_ship ON first_ship.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid
  LEFT JOIN __helmet_cfg __cycle_cfg_1 ON __cycle_cfg_1.dimension_code='YWLN_D024'
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.salesorderid IN (
  SELECT s.new_salesorderid FROM __source_1 s
  WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0
    AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=NOW()
 )
),
requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
 /*TIME_BEGIN*/ WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(:start_date AS timestamp),CAST(:end_exclusive AS timestamp) /*TIME_END*/
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.amount_yuan)::numeric/100000000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((FALSE),FALSE) OR (f.amount_yuan) IS NULL) AS invalid,(FALSE) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.helmet_status AS helmet_status,CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_uncompleted','overdue_completed') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('imminent_uncompleted','normal_uncompleted','normal_completed') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_flag FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT s.new_ord_shipmentid::text AS fact_id,s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS fact_date,
 o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
 COALESCE(o.ownerid,s.ownerid)::text AS owner_id,c.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(c.name::text),'') AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 /*YWLN_TWO_NODE_ANOMALY_V1*/ CASE WHEN COALESCE((c.new_accountlevel::text IN ('1','2') OR o.new_risklevel::text IN ('1','2')),FALSE) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS anomaly_flag,
 __order_cycle_value_1.helmet_status AS helmet_status,
 s.new_totalqty*pr.new_electricquantity AS energy_kwh,s.new_money::numeric AS amount_yuan,
 (s.new_totalqty IS NULL OR s.new_totalqty<0 OR pr.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR pr.new_electricquantity<=0) AS energy_issue,
 FALSE AS source_issue
 FROM __source_1 s 
 LEFT JOIN __source_4 pr ON pr.productid=s.new_product_id
 LEFT JOIN __source_2 so ON so.salesorderid=s.new_salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __source_5 o ON o.opportunityid=so.opportunityid
 

 LEFT JOIN __source_3 c ON c.accountid=s.new_account_id
  LEFT JOIN __order_cycle_once_1 __order_cycle_value_1 ON __order_cycle_value_1.salesorderid=so.salesorderid
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=NOW()
) f WHERE TRUE
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D045*/ AND f.anomaly_flag IN (:anomaly_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D045*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D002*/ AND f.d002 IN (:product_lines) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D002*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D003*/ AND f.d003 IN (:product_types) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D003*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D004*/ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM __source_6 tm JOIN __source_7 t ON t."teamid"=tm."teamid"
 WHERE tm."systemuserid"::text=f.owner_id AND t."name"::text IN (:team_ids)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D004*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D005*/ AND f.d005 IN (:customer_levels) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D005*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D006*/ AND f.d006 IN (:customer_ids) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D006*/
 /*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D024*/ AND (f.helmet_status IN (:status_codes) OR (CASE f.helmet_status WHEN 'overdue_uncompleted' THEN '逾期未完成' WHEN 'imminent_uncompleted' THEN '临期未完成' WHEN 'normal_uncompleted' THEN '正常未完成' WHEN 'overdue_completed' THEN '逾期完成' WHEN 'normal_completed' THEN '正常完成' END) IN (:status_codes)) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D024*//*FILTER_BEGIN:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/ AND (CASE WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('overdue_completed','overdue_uncompleted') THEN '是' WHEN f.helmet_status IN ('normal_completed','normal_uncompleted','imminent_uncompleted') THEN '否' ELSE NULL END) IN (:shipment_abnormal_flags) /*FILTER_END:YWLN_D_SHIPMENT_ABNORMAL*/

   s.amount_yuan/100000000::numeric AS amount_value,
   (COALESCE(s.new_totalqty IS NULL OR s.new_totalqty<0 OR p.new_electricquantity IS NULL OR p.new_electricquantity<=0,FALSE)
      OR (s.new_totalqty*p.new_electricquantity) IS NULL) AS energy_invalid,

 FROM active_shipments s LEFT JOIN product_energy p ON p.productid=s.new_product_id
 UNION ALL

   (i.new_qty*__actual_energy.new_system_energy)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS energy_value,

   (COALESCE(__actual_energy.new_system_energy IS NULL OR __actual_energy.new_system_energy<=0,FALSE)

WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT

            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d004
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              EXISTS(
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
                JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
                  ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
                WHERE
                  tm."systemuserid" = f.owner_id
                  AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) IN (
                    SELECT
                      value
                    FROM __energy_share_ywln_d004
                  )
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d005
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              f.d005 IN (
                SELECT
                  value
                FROM __energy_share_ywln_d005
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d006
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              (
                CAST(f.d006 AS TEXT) IN (
                  SELECT
                    value
                  FROM __energy_share_ywln_d006
                )
                OR EXISTS(
                  SELECT
                    1
                  FROM __ont_accounts AS customer_filter
                  WHERE
                    CAST(customer_filter.accountid AS TEXT) = CAST(f.d006 AS TEXT)
                    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(customer_filter.name AS TEXT)), '') IN (
                      SELECT
                        value
                      FROM __energy_share_ywln_d006
                    )
                )
              )
            ) /* YWLN_CUSTOMER_NAME_FILTER_V1 */
          )
      )
      SELECT
        SUM(f.metric_value / NULLIF(f.metric_copies, 0)) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0032"
      FROM scoped AS f
      GROUP BY
        ()
    ), __energy_share_second AS (
      WITH requested AS (
        SELECT
          CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
          CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
        WHERE
          FALSE
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          CAST((
            SELECT
              start_at
            FROM __energy_share_period
          ) AS TIMESTAMP),
          CAST((
            SELECT
              end_at
            FROM __energy_share_period
          ) AS TIMESTAMP)
      ), bounds AS (
        SELECT
          MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
          MAX(end_at) AS end_at
        FROM requested
      ), measure_rows AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          CAST('m0' AS TEXT) AS measure_tag,
          CAST(f.fact_id AS TEXT),
          CAST(f.fact_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
          CAST((
            f.energy_mwh
          ) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS metric_value,
          (
            COALESCE(f.source_issue, FALSE) OR (
              f.energy_mwh
            ) IS NULL
          ) AS invalid,
          (
            FALSE
          ) AS poison_time,
          f.d002,
          f.d003,
          f.owner_id,
          f.d005,
          f.d006,
          f.status_code,
          f.helmet_status AS helmet_status
        FROM (
          WITH opportunity_link_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
            SELECT
              CAST(name AS TEXT) AS linked_project_name,
              COUNT(DISTINCT opportunityid) AS matches,
              MIN(opportunityid) AS opportunity_id
            FROM __ont_opportunity
            WHERE
              opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY
              CAST(name AS TEXT)
          ), ranked AS (
            SELECT
              b.*,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY project_name
                ORDER BY CAST(input_time AS TIMESTAMP) DESC, bid_record_id DESC
              ) AS rn
            FROM __x360_gov_source_1 AS b
            WHERE
              project_name IS NOT NULL
              AND project_name ~ '[^[:space:]]'
              AND bid_record_id IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(input_time AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(input_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          ), linked AS (
            SELECT
              b.*,
              COALESCE(mx.matches, 0) AS matches,
              mx.opportunity_id
            FROM ranked AS b
            LEFT JOIN opportunity_link_summary AS mx
              ON mx.linked_project_name = CAST(b.project_name AS TEXT)
            WHERE
              b.rn = 1
          )
          SELECT DISTINCT
            CAST(b.bid_record_id AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
            CAST(b.input_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
            CAST(b.input_time AS TIMESTAMP),
            CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP),
            b.energy_mwh,
            CASE
              WHEN (
                (
                  TO_JSONB(b."bid_amount") #>> '{}'
                )
              ) ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              THEN CAST((
                (
                  TO_JSONB(b."bid_amount") #>> '{}'
                )
              ) AS DECIMAL)
            END AS amount_yuan,
            CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
            CASE
              WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
              THEN NULL
              WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
              THEN '其他'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
              THEN '电芯'
              WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
              THEN 'PACK'
              ELSE '其他'
            END AS d003,
            CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
            CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
            NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS status_code,
            CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS helmet_status,
            FALSE AS source_issue,
            b.matches AS opportunity_matches,
            COALESCE(o.opportunityid IN (
              SELECT
                opportunityid
              FROM __signed_keys_0
            ), FALSE) AS has_signed,
            (
              COALESCE(b.remark, '') LIKE '%弃标%'
            ) AS abandoned,
            (
              COALESCE(b.remark, '') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
              AND CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              AND b.is_awarded IN ('是', '1')
            ) AS won,
            (
              COALESCE(b.remark, '') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
              AND CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              AND b.is_awarded IN ('否', '0')
            ) AS lost,
            (
              COALESCE(b.remark, '') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
              AND (
                CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
                OR CAST(b.winner_announce_time AS TIMESTAMP) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
              )
            ) AS in_progress
          FROM linked AS b
          LEFT JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
            ON o.opportunityid = b.opportunity_id AND b.matches = 1
          LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
            ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
        ) AS f
        WHERE
          f.energy_mwh > 0 AND f.won AND NOT f.has_signed
      ), checked AS (
        SELECT
          *,
          COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY measure_tag, fact_id) AS fact_copies
        FROM measure_rows
      ), scoped AS (
        SELECT
          f.*,
          CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
        FROM checked AS f
        WHERE
          (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM bounds
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              f.fact_date >= (
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM bounds
              )
              AND f.fact_date < (
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM bounds
              )
            )
            OR f.poison_time
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d002
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              f.d002 IN (
                SELECT
                  value
                FROM __energy_share_ywln_d002
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d003
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              f.d003 IN (
                SELECT
                  value
                FROM __energy_share_ywln_d003
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d004
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              EXISTS(
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
                JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
                  ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
                WHERE
                  CAST(tm."systemuserid" AS TEXT) = f.owner_id
                  AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) IN (
                    SELECT
                      value
                    FROM __energy_share_ywln_d004
                  )
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d005
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              f.d005 IN (
                SELECT
                  value
                FROM __energy_share_ywln_d005
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d006
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              f.d006 IN (
                SELECT
                  value
                FROM __energy_share_ywln_d006
              )
            )
          )
      )
      SELECT
        (
          CASE
            WHEN EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM scoped AS x
              WHERE
                x.measure_tag = 'm0' AND x.poison_time
            )
            OR COALESCE(
              BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies > 1) FILTER(WHERE
                f.measure_tag = 'm0'),
              FALSE
            )
            THEN NULL
            ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE
              f.measure_tag = 'm0')
          END
        ) AS "YWLN_M0142"
      FROM scoped AS f
      GROUP BY
        ()
    ), __funnel_energy_keys AS (
      SELECT
        1 AS only_row
    )
    SELECT
      n1."YWLN_M0032" + n2."YWLN_M0142" AS "YWLN_M_ORDER_FUNNEL_ENERGY"
    FROM __funnel_energy_keys AS k
    LEFT JOIN __energy_share_first AS n1
      ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN __energy_share_second AS n2
      ON TRUE
  ), __dashboard_metric_4 AS (
    WITH __energy_share_period AS (
      SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
      WHERE
        FALSE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        CAST((
          SELECT

        ) AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST((
          SELECT
            end_at
          FROM __dashboard_combo_period
        ) AS TIMESTAMP)
    ), __energy_share_ywln_d002 AS (
      SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
      WHERE
        FALSE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        UNNEST((
          SELECT
            ARRAY_AGG(value)
          FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d002
        ))
    ), __energy_share_ywln_d003 AS (
      SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
      WHERE
        FALSE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        UNNEST((
          SELECT
            ARRAY_AGG(value)
          FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d003
        ))
    ), __energy_share_ywln_d004 AS (
      SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
      WHERE
        FALSE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        UNNEST((
          SELECT
            ARRAY_AGG(value)
          FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d004
        ))
    ), __energy_share_ywln_d005 AS (
      SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
      WHERE
        FALSE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        UNNEST((
          SELECT
            ARRAY_AGG(value)
          FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d005
        ))
    ), __energy_share_ywln_d006 AS (
      SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS value
      WHERE
        FALSE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        UNNEST((
          SELECT
            ARRAY_AGG(value)
          FROM __dashboard_combo_ywln_d006
        ))
    ), __energy_share_denominator AS MATERIALIZED (
      WITH opportunity_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          o.opportunityid,
          CAST(o.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP),
          CAST(o.new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
          CASE
            WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
            THEN '其他'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('1', '电芯')
            THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('2', 'PACK')
            THEN 'PACK'
            ELSE '其他'
          END AS d003,
          o.ownerid AS owner_id,
          CAST(o.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(acc_o.name AS TEXT)), '') AS d006,
          CASE
            WHEN EXISTS(

                1

              LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_so
                ON acc_so.accountid = so.customerid
              WHERE
                so.opportunityid = o.opportunityid

                      OR COALESCE(

                          WHERE
                            TRUE
                            AND cx.salesorderid <> cx.new_salesorderid
                            AND TRUE
                            AND cx.new_changestatus = '8'
                            AND CAST(cx.new_approval_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                        ),
                        FALSE
                      )
                    ),
                    FALSE
                  )
                )
                AND so.new_ord_oa_state = '5'
                AND CAST(so.new_approval_time AS TIMESTAMP) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
            THEN 'signed_opportunity'

        FROM __ont_opportunity AS o
        LEFT JOIN __ont_accounts AS acc_o
          ON acc_o.accountid = o.parentaccountid
        WHERE
          o.opportunityid IS NOT NULL AND TRUE AND TRUE
      ), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT
          *,
          COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY opportunityid) AS copies
        FROM opportunity_distinct
      ), fact_distinct AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          m.new_oppmonthid AS fact_id,
          CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
          m.__ont_energy_mwh AS metric_value,
          o.copies AS source_copies,

          o.d002,
          o.d003,
          o.owner_id,
          o.d005,
          o.d006
        FROM __ont_forecast AS m
        JOIN opportunities AS o
          ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
        WHERE
          m.new_oppmonthid IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          AND TRUE
          AND TRUE
          AND (
            m.__ont_energy_mwh
          ) IS NOT NULL
      ), metric_facts AS (
        SELECT
          *,
          COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_id) AS copies
        FROM fact_distinct
      ), scoped AS (
        SELECT
          f.*,
          CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
        FROM metric_facts AS f
        WHERE
          1 = 1
          AND (
            (
              SELECT
                start_at
              FROM __energy_share_period
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
              f.fact_date >= CAST((
                SELECT
                  start_at
                FROM __energy_share_period
              ) AS TIMESTAMP)
              AND f.fact_date < CAST((
                SELECT
                  end_at
                FROM __energy_share_period
              ) AS TIMESTAMP)
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d002
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              f.d002 IN (
                SELECT
                  value
                FROM __energy_share_ywln_d002
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d003
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              f.d003 IN (
                SELECT
                  value
                FROM __energy_share_ywln_d003
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d004
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              EXISTS(
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
                JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
                  ON t."teamid" = tm."teamid"
                WHERE
                  tm."systemuserid" = f.owner_id
                  AND CAST(t."name" AS TEXT) IN (
                    SELECT
                      value
                    FROM __energy_share_ywln_d004
                  )
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d005
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              f.d005 IN (
                SELECT
                  value
                FROM __energy_share_ywln_d005
              )
            )
          )
          AND (
            NOT EXISTS(
              SELECT
                1
              FROM __energy_share_ywln_d006
              WHERE
                value IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
              f.d006 IN (
                SELECT
                  value
                FROM __energy_share_ywln_d006
              )
            )
          )
      )
      SELECT
        SUM(f.metric_value) / CAST(1000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0022"
      FROM scoped AS f
      GROUP BY
        ()
    ), __energy_share_keys AS (
      SELECT
        1 AS only_row
    )
    SELECT
      (
        SELECT
          "YWLN_M_ORDER_FUNNEL_ENERGY"
        FROM __dashboard_metric_3
      ) / NULLIF(d."YWLN_M0022", 0) AS "YWLN_M_ORDER_RECEIPT_ENERGY_PCT"
    FROM __energy_share_keys AS k
    LEFT JOIN __energy_share_denominator AS d

  SELECT
    __dashboard_metric_1."YWLN_M0179" AS "YWLN_M0179",

    __dashboard_metric_3."YWLN_M_ORDER_FUNNEL_ENERGY" AS "YWLN_M_ORDER_FUNNEL_ENERGY",

sql_text:
WITH __ont_request AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  /*TIME_BEGIN*/
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST(:end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP) /*TIME_END*/
), __ont_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM __ont_request
), __ont_accounts_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __ont_accounts_ranked
  WHERE
    __ont_rn = 1
), __ont_opportunity_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
      ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __ont_opportunity AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM __ont_opportunity_ranked AS o
  WHERE
    o.__ont_rn = 1
), __ont_forecast_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL), 0) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS __ont_energy_mwh,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS __ont_rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND m.new_accountdate IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
    )
    AND (
      b.end_at IS NULL OR CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
    )
), __ont_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    m.*
  FROM __ont_forecast_ranked AS m
  JOIN __ont_opportunity AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = m.new_opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN __ont_bounds AS b
  WHERE
    m.__ont_rn = 1
    AND (
      o.createdon IS NULL
      OR CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) <= LEAST(
        COALESCE(b.end_at, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)),
        CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )
), __ont_owner_teams AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS ownerid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '')) = 1
      THEN MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), ''))
    END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
    ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_signed_via_order_lines_20261113 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunityid
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS __sign_line
  JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb AS __sign_order
    ON __sign_order.salesorderid = __sign_line.salesorderid
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__sign_line.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND __sign_order.salesorderid IS NOT NULL
), __signed_order_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      sx.opportunityid || ''
    ) AS opportunityid,
